SkipVLA: Skipping VLA Steps with Classical Planning for Fast Robot Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action models classical motion planning hybrid policy robot manipulation latency reduction

简要说明：SkipVLA 是一种混合策略，将预训练的 VLA 与经典运动规划器结合，利用规划器处理自由空间运动，仅对接触丰富的技能（如抓取和放置）查询 VLA，在 LIBERO 基准和真实机器人拾放任务上实现了高达 2.5 倍的任务完成加速，且不降低成功率。

TLDR: SkipVLA is a hybrid policy that pairs a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills, achieving 2.5x faster task completion on LIBERO benchmarks and real-robot pick-and-place tasks without sacrificing success rate.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是一类通用机器人策略，直接将摄像头图像和语言指令映射为机器人动作。尽管前景广阔，但这些模型在测试时推理速度较慢，尤其是在需要频繁查询策略的长周期任务中。近期研究通过蒸馏小型模型、重叠异步动作块或将VLA与快速底层策略配对来降低VLA延迟，但仍在整个任务过程中运行学习到的策略。与VLA不同，经典运动规划器能够快速找到无碰撞运动路径，但需要明确的目标且不具备对任务的语义理解。在本工作中，我们提出SkipVLA，一种将预训练VLA与经典运动规划器相结合的混合策略，利用规划器处理自由空间运动，仅在抓取和放置等接触密集型技能中查询VLA。SkipVLA复用VLA冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络来预测每次规划运动的目標位姿，并通过利用大型VLA已学到的知识来学习该预测器，无需向系统中引入额外的演示数据。我们在仿真中的13个LIBERO任务以及物理6自由度YAM机械臂上的三个抓取-放置任务中，使用三种VLA对SkipVLA进行了评估，结果表明任务完成速度提升最高达2.5倍，能耗显著降低，同时保持相同的任务成功率。

Authors: Kaivalya Agrawal, Md Ashiqur Rahman, Raymond A. Yeh, Zachary Kingston

GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies VLA

adaptive action chunking flow matching VLA policies prediction reliability manipulation

简要说明：GeoAAC 利用流匹配去噪轨迹的几何特征反映预测可靠性，从而在基于流的 VLA 策略中自适应调整动作视界，在仿真和真实世界操控任务中均提升了性能。

TLDR: GeoAAC adaptively adjusts the action horizon in flow-based VLA policies using geometric features of denoising trajectories to reflect prediction reliability, improving manipulation performance in simulation and real world.

Abstract: Action chunking is widely used for action generation and execution in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, yet existing approaches commonly use a fixed action horizon. During a rollout, different task stages may require different levels of action continuity, control precision, and closed-loop feedback, making a fixed horizon unable to accommodate changing control requirements. We propose \textbf{GeoAAC}, a geometry-based adaptive action chunking method for flow-based VLA policies that adjusts the action horizon according to the reliability of the current action prediction. We show that the geometry of Flow Matching denoising trajectories provides process-level information for characterizing prediction reliability, with geometric variation across action prefixes remaining positively correlated with predictive uncertainty. GeoAAC uses this prefix-wise geometry to construct a horizon-wise geometric profile and adaptively determine the action horizon from a single generation without additional training. Experiments with GR00T N1.5 and π0.5 on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation tasks show consistent improvements over fixed-action-horizon baselines and existing adaptive methods, including up to 8.7 percentage points in simulation and an increase in average real-world success rate from 53.3\% to 74.4\%.

摘要（中文）：动作分块（Action chunking）被广泛用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中的动作生成与执行，然而现有方法通常采用固定动作视界（fixed action horizon）。在 rollout 过程中，不同任务阶段可能对动作连续性、控制精度和闭环反馈提出不同要求，使得固定视界无法适应不断变化的控制需求。我们提出\textbf{GeoAAC}，一种基于几何的自适应动作分块方法，适用于基于流的VLA策略，该方法根据当前动作预测的可靠性动态调整动作视界。我们证明，Flow Matching 去噪轨迹的几何特性能够提供用于刻画预测可靠性的过程级信息，其中动作前缀上的几何变化与预测不确定性保持正相关。GeoAAC利用这种逐前缀的几何信息构建逐视界的几何轮廓，并在无需额外训练的情况下，通过单次生成自适应地确定动作视界。在GR00T N1.5和π0.5上的实验，涵盖LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365以及真实世界操控任务，显示出相对于固定动作视界基线和现有自适应方法的一致改进，其中在仿真中最高提升8.7个百分点，真实世界平均成功率从53.3\%提升至74.4\%。

Authors: Xin Chen, Sen Chen, Yujuan Ding, Jian Liu, Guoqing Wang, Wei Ye, Heng Tao Shen, Yi Bin

MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models Manipulation

World Action Models future motion prediction Mixture-of-Transformer inference-time scaling robot manipulation

简要说明：MoWAM 通过用紧凑的未来运动预测取代显式的未来视频生成，在不进行推理时视频生成的情况下，实现了高效的推理时扩展，在 LIBERO 和真实世界任务中取得了更强的分布内性能、更好的分布外鲁棒性和更高的真实世界成功率。

TLDR: MoWAM improves World Action Models for robot manipulation by replacing explicit future video generation with a compact future motion prediction, removing inference-time video generation while enabling efficient inference-time scaling via multiple candidate sampling. It achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher real-world success on LIBERO and real-world benchmarks.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过融入未来动态信息提升了机器人策略学习的效果，然而在推理阶段显式生成未来视频会带来可观的计算开销。取消未来视频生成虽能提升效率，但未来动态信息只能隐式地编码在观测特征中，这可能在分布偏移情况下限制模型的鲁棒性。我们提出MoWAM，一种将未来视频生成替换为显式未来运动预测的高效世界动作模型。不同于重建完整的未来场景，MoWAM将结构化机器人运动建模为未来的紧凑抽象表示，捕捉机器人在当前场景和交互约束下预期如何演化。通过混合 Transformer 架构，模型在训练阶段学习未来视觉动态，同时联合预测运动与动作，从而在推理阶段完全移除视频生成，同时保留未来的显式表示。紧凑的运动表示进一步支持高效的推理时扩展，通过采样多组运动-动作候选对，并利用运动感知的任务进展验证器从中择优。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus以及真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，MoWAM在分布内性能、分布外鲁棒性以及真实世界平均成功率方面均优于具有代表性的世界动作模型基线。此外，随着候选数量的增加，性能持续提升，验证了显式未来运动为推理时扩展提供了有效且高效的支撑。

Authors: Jiayu Wang, Bin Zhu, Yue Yu, Jingjing Chen

TraceFlow: Guiding Frozen Flow-Matching Robot Policies with Success and Failure Traces VLA

test-time adaptation flow matching robot policy success/failure traces retrieval guidance

简要说明：TraceFlow 提出一种进度对齐的引导场，利用成功与失败轨迹在测试时修正冻结的流匹配 VLA 策略，无需更新权重即可提升真实机器人装箱和仿真任务成功率。

TLDR: TraceFlow introduces a progress-aligned guidance field that uses success and failure traces to correct frozen flow-matching VLA policies at test time, improving real-robot packing and simulation task success without weight updates.

Abstract: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a flow-matching action expert generates each action chunk (a short command sequence) by integrating a learned velocity field; once its weights are fixed, the success or failure of an earlier rollout cannot change the chunk generated now. Concurrent test-time methods give a frozen policy such an input from retrieved successes, a learned critic, a verifier, or a dynamics model, but none uses the robot's own failed rollouts as negative evidence with nothing but a terminal outcome bit. We introduce TraceFlow, a progress-aligned guidance field that turns the action densities of retrieved successful and failed rollouts into a bounded correction to a frozen flow-matching action expert, using one terminal outcome bit per rollout and no other label. Its TraceBank stores traces, time-ordered state-action records with a terminal label, starts from the target-task training traces, and later admits the deployed robot's own rollouts. On an ordered real-robot packing task the base completes 21 of 50 trials in order, TraceFlow 39, and one stacking round without any weight update 47, with wrong-sequence episodes falling from 20 to 0. In simulation the gain is selective: with per-suite selected settings, TraceFlow raises RoboMemArena Sequence from 78.92\% to 91.50\% task success and Transferring from 54.41\% to 62.00\% at stacking round 2, leaves the 26-task aggregate unchanged, lowers Counting and Occlusion by 1.12 and 1.42 points, and changes LIBERO-Plus (Long) by +1.27 points (p = 0.0733). Stacking gains are finite, every branch peaking before round ten, and the bank's success-to-failure ratio predicts no retrieval allocation.

摘要（中文）：一种结合流匹配动作专家的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，通过对学习到的速度场进行积分来生成每个动作块（一段短指令序列）；一旦其权重固定，先前 rollout 的成功或失败无法改变当前生成的块。现有的测试时方法为冻结策略提供来自检索成功样本、学习到的评判器、验证器或动力学模型的输入，但没有任何方法利用机器人自身的失败 rollout 作为负面证据，且仅使用一个终端结果位。我们提出 TraceFlow，一种进度对齐的引导场，将检索到的成功与失败 rollout 的动作密度转化为对冻结流匹配动作专家的有界修正，每个 rollout 仅使用一个终端结果位，无需其他标签。其 TraceBank 存储轨迹，即带有终端标签的按时间排序的状态-动作记录，初始来源于目标任务训练轨迹，随后接纳部署机器人自身的 rollout。在有序的真实机器人装箱任务中，基础模型在 50 次试验中按顺序完成 21 次，TraceFlow 完成 39 次，并且在不进行任何权重更新的情况下，一个堆叠轮次内完成 47 次，错误顺序片段从 20 次降至 0 次。在仿真中，增益具有选择性：在按套件选定的设置下，TraceFlow 在堆叠轮次 2 时将 RoboMemArena Sequence 的任务成功率从 78.92\% 提升至 91.50\%，将 Transferring 从 54.41\% 提升至 62.00\%，同时保持 26 个任务的整体性能不变，Counting 和 Occlusion 分别下降 1.12 和 1.42 个百分点，LIBERO-Plus（Long）变化为 +1.27 个百分点（p = 0.0733）。堆叠增益是有限的，每个分支在第十轮之前达到峰值，而银行中的成功-失败比例无法预测检索分配。

Authors: Jiaxuan Zhang, Ruizhe Liu, Yu Zhang, Yanchao Yang

Towards High-DoF Dexterous Manipulation through VLA Post-Training VLA

VLA post-training dexterous manipulation hand-action codec residual reinforcement learning DAgger

简要说明：本文提出了一个针对VLA基础模型的四步后训练流程，以实现高自由度灵巧操作，包括时间手部动作编解码器、监督微调、DAgger和残差强化学习，在五个真实世界任务上实现了100%的成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents a four-step post-training pipeline for VLA foundation models to achieve high-DoF dexterous manipulation, including a temporal hand-action codec, supervised fine-tuning, DAgger, and residual reinforcement learning, achieving 100% success on five real-world tasks.

Abstract: Imitation-learned vision--language--action (VLA) foundation models acquire broad manipulation capabilities by scaling robot data across tasks and embodiments, but reliable deployment on a specific downstream task and hardware platform still requires post-training. Dexterous hands make this adaptation particularly difficult: their broad behavioural repertoire and high degree of freedom create a large and structured action space. Three obstacles are central: open-source VLAs do not natively provide an action interface for high-DoF hands; gesture mismatch during human-gated DAgger takeover creates command discontinuities and contaminates corrective trajectories; and reinforcement learning in the raw joint space is sample-inefficient. We present a unified four-step post-training pipeline comprising a learned temporal hand-action codec, supervised fine-tuning, DAgger, and real-world residual reinforcement learning. The codec adapts a pretrained VLA to absolute dexterous-hand commands. Buffered rollback, pose alignment, and smooth command blending enable continuous, task-relevant DAgger corrections, while latent residual RL confines exploration to coordinated hand motions captured by the codec. We evaluate the pipeline on five diverse real-world tasks spanning bimanual transfer, in-hand reorientation, and tool use. Within the reported post-training budgets, the resulting policies achieve 100\% success on every evaluated task over 20 trials per task. These results provide a practical path for adapting VLA foundation models to reliable real-world dexterous manipulation.

摘要（中文）：通过学习模仿获得的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型，通过跨任务和跨载体扩展机器人数据，获得了广泛的操作能力，但在特定下游任务和硬件平台上的可靠部署仍需进行后训练。灵巧手使得这种适配尤为困难：其广泛的行为 repertoire 和高自由度构成了一个庞大且结构化的动作空间。其中存在三个关键障碍：开源VLA天然不具备针对高自由度手的动作接口；在人工门控DAgger接管过程中，手势不匹配会导致指令中断并污染纠正轨迹；在原始关节空间中进行强化学习样本效率低下。我们提出了一种统一的四步后训练流程，包括学习型时域手部动作编解码器、监督微调、DAgger以及真实环境残差强化学习。该编解码器将预训练的VLA适配为绝对灵巧手指令。缓冲回滚、姿态对齐和平滑指令混合技术可实现连续且任务相关的DAgger纠正，而潜在残差强化学习则将探索范围限制在编解码器捕获的协调手部动作中。我们在五项涵盖双手传递、掌内重定向和工具使用的多样化真实世界任务上评估了该流程。在报告的后训练预算内，所得策略在每项任务的20次试验中均达到了100%的成功率。这些结果为将VLA基础模型适配至可靠的现实世界灵巧操作提供了一条实用路径。

Authors: Junlei Zhu, Shenzhe Yao, Chaogui Huang, Wenkai Zhu, Jingwei Peng, Guanqi He, Soren Schwertfeger, Jiahao Chen, Yide Liu

Recovering Aggressively Pruned Vision-Language-Action Models with Offline Hidden-State Distillation VLA

structured pruning hidden-state distillation OpenVLA-OFT CogACT efficient inference

简要说明：本文通过离线隐藏状态蒸馏，恢复了被大幅剪枝的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在显著减少GPU训练时间的同时，使性能接近教师模型，并实现更快的机器人端推理。

TLDR: This paper recovers aggressively pruned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models using offline hidden-state distillation, achieving performance close to the teacher model while significantly reducing GPU hours and enabling faster on-robot inference.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models let robots follow language instructions, but their language backbones of several billion parameters are the main obstacle to running them on robot hardware. Structured pruning reduces that backbone, and removing 63% of it from OpenVLA-OFT drops LIBERO-Long success from 93.2% to 0.8%. A recent approach restores such a model with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, which needs online rollouts and hundreds of GPU-hours. We recover most of the lost success entirely offline. Width pruning narrows the blocks but keeps the residual stream at its original size, so teacher and student hidden states have the same shape and are matched directly, without a projector. Training against a cache built in one teacher pass lifts the 63%-reduced student to within 3.5 points of the teacher in about 8 GPU-hours. A sweep over nine ratios locates where the recovery objective starts to matter. Up to 45% reduction the two do not differ significantly on OpenVLA-OFT. Hidden-state distillation then adds +2.1 to +4.5 points there between 63% and 87%, and +9.4 to +22.1 points on CogACT from 63% onward. At 81% on CogACT, a tripled recovery budget narrows the distilled student's gap to the teacher to 3.9 points on average, while supervised recovery stays more than 20 points below. At matched compression, width pruning yields higher success and depth pruning lower latency. On a 6-DoF manipulator, the distilled student at 72% reduction reaches 77.5% success against 59.5% for supervised recovery, runs 2.23x faster on-board than the teacher, and uses 62% less memory.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使机器人能够遵循语言指令，但其数十亿参数的语言骨干网络是将其部署于机器人硬件上的主要障碍。结构化剪枝可缩减该骨干网络，而从OpenVLA-OFT中移除63%的参数会使LIBERO-Long的成功率从93.2%骤降至0.8%。近期一种方法通过监督微调 followed by 强化学习来恢复此类模型，但该方法需要在线 rollout 和数百GPU小时的算力。我们完全以离线方式恢复了大部分性能损失。宽度剪枝收窄了网络块，但保持残差流的原始尺寸，因此教师和学生模型的隐藏状态形状相同，可直接进行匹配，无需投影器。利用单次教师前向传播构建的缓存进行训练，可在约8个GPU小时内将剪枝63%的学生模型恢复至与教师模型相差3.5个百分点以内。对九种剪枝比例的扫描确定了恢复目标开始发挥作用的临界点。在OpenVLA-OFT上，剪枝比例不超过45%时，两种方法没有显著差异。在此之后，隐藏状态蒸馏在63%至87%剪枝区间额外带来+2.1至+4.5个百分点的提升，而在CogACT上从63%剪枝起提升幅度为+9.4至+22.1个百分点。在CogACT上剪枝81%时，将恢复预算增加三倍可使蒸馏学生模型与教师模型的平均差距缩小至3.9个百分点，而监督恢复仍落后20个百分点以上。在同等压缩率下，宽度剪枝在成功率上更优，而深度剪枝在延迟上更低。在六自由度机械臂上，剪枝72%的蒸馏学生模型达到77.5%的成功率（监督恢复为59.5%），机载运行速度比教师模型快2.23倍，且内存占用减少62%。

Authors: Chiyoung Kim, Sanghyuk Roy Choi, Minhyeok Lee

Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation Manipulation

obstacle-aware safe robot manipulation coding agents route planning collision avoidance

简要说明：本文发现用于机器人操作的编码代理优先考虑任务完成而忽视安全约束，并提出了SafeHarness障碍感知框架用于路径规划和接触执行，显著提高了避碰和任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper identifies that coding agents for robot manipulation prioritize task completion over safety constraints and introduces SafeHarness, an obstacle-aware harness for route planning and contact execution, significantly improving collision avoidance and task success.

Abstract: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.

摘要（中文）：编码智能体已成为机器人操作领域的一种新兴范式：语言模型将机器人控制器编写为程序，以此方式构建的智能体无需针对机器人进行专门训练即可操作机器人。然而，这一范式是否安全尚未被探讨。我们在安全约束条件下对编码智能体进行了评估，其中每项任务都将操作目标与机器人不得触碰的障碍物配对。智能体追求目标，但在大多数情况下会与障碍物发生碰撞，将任务完成作为其唯一目标而忽视安全。智能体在其推理轨迹中会考虑障碍物，且提示中已明确禁止触碰障碍物，因此感知和指令均无过错；问题在于规划环节——所述约束从未成为优先事项。通过将操作分解为路径阶段和接触密集时刻，我们定位了失败根源。沿路径行进时，模型无法将安全约束置于优先位置，既没有畅通路径的概念，也没有在选定路径不可行时进行重新规划的能力。在接触时刻，它意识不到接触执行同样受该约束的限制。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了SafeHarness，为模型配备了两种障碍物感知的安全装置，使其能够优先考虑安全约束。障碍物感知的路径规划将物体表示为边界框，并在其上绘制候选路径作为航点序列。智能体随后预先规划路径、验证路径、必要时重新规划，然后才执行。障碍物感知的接触执行则通过选择接触位置，使接触本身避开障碍物。SafeHarness实现了71.9%的任务成功率和87.5%的碰撞避免率，分别比之前的SOTA提高了6.5%和27.0%。这些结果分别是未配备安全装置的同一智能体的2.3倍和1.5倍。

Authors: Bingxin Xu, Yuzhang Shang, Zhen Dong, Emilio Ferrara

Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision Manipulation

robotic memory VLM distillation latent memory long-horizon manipulation saliency-driven supervision

简要说明：本文提出了一种轻量级潜在记忆表示，即工作区令牌，通过在训练时从昂贵的VLM查询中蒸馏任务关键信息进行训练。该令牌可在部署时作为观测的直接替代品，使记忆密集型机器人操作无需循环VLM推理即可完成，同时提升策略性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a lightweight latent memory representation, the workspace token, trained by distilling task-salient information from expensive VLM queries at train-time. This token serves as a drop-in replacement for observations at deployment, enabling memory-intensive robotic manipulation without in-the-loop VLM reasoning while improving policy performance.

Abstract: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop. Interestingly, we found that workspace tokens are not only more lightweight but also lead to better policy performance.

摘要（中文）：复杂的机器人操控任务通常需要对过往事件和动作具备长期记忆能力。然而，若以完整历史记录作为策略的调节条件，策略容易受到虚假相关性的影响，从而降低性能。为此，许多策略记忆方法通过循环中调用昂贵的视觉语言模型（VLM）查询来压缩历史信息，仅处理与任务相关的显著信息。本文提出了一种替代方案：在训练期间进行计算密集型的VLM查询，以学习一种轻量级的潜在记忆表示，该表示可在部署时高效查询。我们将这一表示称为\textbf{工作空间令牌}（workspace token），并通过以下两步进行训练：（1）利用VLM识别完成任务所需的当前及历史信息；（2）通过集合重建解码器损失将这些信息蒸馏到工作空间令牌中。在仿真和硬件实验中，我们展示了工作空间令牌可作为部署时观测数据的直接替代品，使策略无需在循环中依赖VLM推理即可解决记忆密集型任务。有趣的是，我们发现工作空间令牌不仅更加轻量，还能带来更好的策略性能。

Authors: Nitish Dashora, Douglas Chen, Idan Shenfeld, John Marangola, Pulkit Agrawal, Max Simchowitz

Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control Manipulation

world action model tactile sensing flow matching contact-rich manipulation multi-horizon prediction

简要说明：本文提出了Agile-WAM，一种通过视觉-触觉到动作的流匹配过程联合预测未来世界状态和机器人动作的触觉世界动作模型，在接触丰富的操作任务上实现了高速度和强性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces Agile-WAM, a tactile world action model that jointly predicts future world states and robot actions via a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, achieving high speed and strong performance on contact-rich manipulation tasks.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$. These results demonstrate that multimodal WAM can be achieved with an agile architecture suitable for precise and high-frequency robot control. More details are available on our project page: https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合预测未来世界状态和机器人动作，超越了传统的视觉运动策略，使策略能够学习支持有效控制的物理动力学。然而，近期基于触觉的WAMs通常依赖大规模预训练生成骨干网络来捕捉接触丰富的物理动力学，这限制了其推理效率和灵活部署。本文提出了一种用于接触丰富机器人控制的敏捷触觉世界动作模型\ABBR{}。\ABBR{}将视觉和触觉观测编码为共享潜表示，作为直接视觉-触觉到动作流匹配过程的源，可联合生成动作块及未来视觉/触觉潜表示的潜在表征。一个关键观察是，视觉和触觉信号在本质上以不同的时间尺度演化：相邻视觉帧通常高度相似，而触觉信号在接触时可能发生突变。因此，我们在\ABBR{}中引入多时域多模态预测，在较大时间偏移处对视觉潜表示提供监督，同时预测下一帧触觉潜表示以捕捉细粒度接触动态。在九个仿真和五个真实世界接触丰富操作任务中，\ABBR{}表现出强健且稳定的性能，在成功率上优于最强基线，同时保持低推理延迟。特别地，在五个真实世界实验中，\ABBR{}在整体成功率上取得了\textbf{29.4\%}的相对提升，同时实现\textbf{11.9 ms}的推理延迟。这些结果表明，多模态世界动作模型可以通过适用于高精度高频机器人控制的敏捷架构实现。更多详情请访问我们的项目页面：https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/。

Authors: Hanchu Zhou, Brendan Lynch, Raman Goyal, Dechen Gao, Begum Kasap, Boqi Zhao, Junshan Zhang

OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher AutonomousDriving

end-to-end driving RL fine-tuning privileged teacher closed-loop render-free

简要说明：OPTED 通过使用在矢量输入上训练的特权教师来监督预训练学生在闭环中的微调，将RL与端到端驾驶策略的后训练解耦，在两种基于摄像头的模型上将驾驶分数提高了1.6倍和9.5倍，且所需的模拟器交互远少于直接RL。

TLDR: OPTED decouples RL from end-to-end driving policy post-training by using a privileged teacher trained on vectorized inputs to supervise a pre-trained student in closed-loop, improving driving scores by 1.6x and 9.5x on two camera-based models with far fewer simulator interactions than direct RL.

Abstract: As scaling pre-training data alone yields diminishing returns, post-training is becoming increasingly important across physical AI domains such as autonomous driving. End-to-end driving policies are pre-trained in open loop with behavior cloning on human demonstrations. However, compounding errors during closed-loop deployment can take the vehicle outside the training data distribution, increasing the risk of safety-critical incidents. Closed-loop post-training can mitigate this risk but requires costly simulation for sensor-based policies. We propose OPTED (on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving) which decouples reinforcement learning from the post-training of the end-to-end policy: a privileged teacher is trained using RL on vectorized inputs (HD-map and bounding boxes). This teacher then provides supervision to the pre-trained student during closed-loop post-training. We apply OPTED to two camera-based models, TransFuser and VaVAM, and fine-tune them in AlpaSim, using neural reconstructions (3DGS) of real driving logs. Driving scores increase by factors of 1.6$\times$ and 9.5$\times$, respectively. In controlled experiments OPTED matches closed-loop performance with approximately three orders of magnitude fewer simulator interactions than direct RL post-training, while staying closer to the human prior. Project page: https://01dami23.github.io/opted/

摘要（中文）：仅扩展预训练数据带来的收益日益递减，因此后训练在自动驾驶等物理人工智能领域中正变得愈发重要。端到端驾驶策略通过人类示范的行为克隆在开环条件下进行预训练。然而，闭环部署中的复合误差可能使车辆偏离训练数据分布，从而增加安全关键事件的风险。闭环后训练可以缓解这一风险，但对于基于传感器的策略而言，需要代价高昂的仿真支持。我们提出了OPTED（端到端驾驶的在线策略微调）方法，将强化学习与端到端策略的后训练解耦：一个特权教师模型利用矢量输入（高精地图和边界框）通过强化学习进行训练。该教师随后在闭环后训练期间为预训练的学生模型提供监督。我们将OPTED应用于两个基于摄像头的模型——TransFuser和VaVAM，并在AlpaSim中使用真实驾驶日志的神经重建（3DGS）对其进行微调。驾驶得分分别提升了1.6倍和9.5倍。在受控实验中，OPTED实现了与直接强化学习后训练相当的闭环性能，但所需的仿真交互次数减少了约三个数量级，同时更贴近人类先验。项目页面：https://01dami23.github.io/opted/

Authors: Damiano Da Col, Maximilian Igl, Peter Karkus, Kashyap Chitta, Boris Ivanovic, Marco Pavone, Konrad Schindler, Christos Sakaridis

MILER: Semantic Mid-Level Representation for Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning in Unstructured Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

sim-to-real reinforcement learning semantic mid-level representation BEVFusion unstructured autonomous driving

简要说明：MILER提出了一种用于非结构化自动驾驶的零样本仿真到现实强化学习框架，利用语义中层表示模拟器和基于BEVFusion的感知，在真实测试赛道上实现了17.3公里的自动驾驶。

TLDR: MILER presents a zero-shot sim-to-real RL framework for unstructured autonomous driving, using a semantic mid-level representation simulator and BEVFusion-based perception to achieve 17.3 km of autonomous driving on a real test track.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning constitutes a promising approach owing to its potential for superhuman performance and self-learned policies. However, its application to real-world autonomous driving remains scarce, particularly in unstructured environments, because of the challenges associated with sim-to-real transfer for unstructured environments. In this work, we present MILER, an end-to-end policy framework with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. During offline training, we employ a custom semantic mid-level representation (MLR) simulator and train the policy network using reinforcement learning, with its control outputs applied directly to a bicycle model. During deployment on the real vehicle, camera and LiDAR data are processed by BEVFusion to generate a semantic bird's-eye-view representation consistent with that of the MLR simulator. The actions generated by the policy network are not applied directly to the real vehicle. Instead, we employ a trajectory-alignment strategy that enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of both perception and control. We extensively evaluate the proposed framework on a diverse test track comprising numerous challenges, including various obstacles, hairpin curves, velocities of up to 33.6 km/h, and off-road sections. In total, we drove 17.3 km with two different vehicles on a 3.0 km test track without human intervention, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, the entire software stack runs on a Jetson AGX Orin.

摘要（中文）：强化学习因其具有超人类表现和自主学习策略的潜力，成为一种前景广阔的方法。然而，其在真实世界自动驾驶中的应用仍然较少，尤其是在非结构化环境中，这主要是因为非结构化环境下的模拟到现实迁移面临诸多挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了MILER，一种具备零样本模拟到现实迁移能力的端到端策略框架。在离线训练阶段，我们采用自定义语义中层表示（MLR）模拟器，并使用强化学习训练策略网络，其控制输出直接应用于自行车模型。在真实车辆部署阶段，摄像头和激光雷达数据由BEVFusion处理，生成与MLR模拟器一致的语义鸟瞰图表示。策略网络生成的动作并非直接作用于真实车辆，而是采用轨迹对齐策略，实现感知和控制的零样本模拟到现实迁移。我们在包含众多挑战的多样化测试赛道上对该框架进行了广泛评估，这些挑战包括各类障碍物、发卡弯、最高时速33.6公里以及越野路段。总计而言，我们在一条3.0公里的测试赛道上，使用两辆不同的车辆，在无人干预的情况下行驶了17.3公里，从而验证了所提方法的有效性。此外，整个软件栈运行于Jetson AGX Orin平台之上。

Authors: Thomas Steinecker, Denis Trescher, Alexander Bienemann, Thorsten Luettel, Mirko Maehlisch

Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies Manipulation

3D diffusion policies Movement Trend Guidance foresight manipulation policy learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种运动趋势引导方法，通过紧凑的潜在表征为3D扩散策略提供面向未来的条件，在不使用显式轨迹规划的情况下提升操作性能，并在模拟和真实机器人基准上实现了一致改进。

TLDR: This paper introduces Movement Trend Guidance, a method that adds a compact latent representation of interaction evolution to 3D diffusion policies, providing future-oriented conditioning for action generation without explicit trajectory planning, and demonstrates consistent improvement over DP3 across simulation and real-robot benchmarks.

Abstract: 3D diffusion policies are strong at generating geometrically grounded actions from current observations, but successful manipulation requires not only knowing what motion is feasible now, but also anticipating where the interaction is heading. Existing policies largely leave such foresight to emerge implicitly from action learning. We introduce Movement Trend Guidance, a simple but effective way to provide this foresight without introducing an explicit plan. From a short observation history, the policy learns a compact latent representation of interaction evolution. During training, sparse future gripper states supervise this representation; at inference, only the latent is retained as future-oriented conditioning alongside the current observation. The latent provides global conditioning for action generation, while an additional gated FiLM branch is used only at the UNet bottleneck. Despite adding only 3.52% more parameters to DP3, our method preserves the original dense-action and receding-horizon formulation and consistently improves upon DP3 across RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-40, and DexArt. It reaches 62.8% vs. 56.1% in 50-task RoboTwin2.0 mixed training, 71.93% vs. 37.08% on LIBERO-40, and 72.0% vs. 49.0% on five real-robot tasks. These results show that a diffusion policy can benefit substantially from knowing where an interaction is heading, without being told exactly where to move.

摘要（中文）：三维扩散策略在根据当前观测生成几何上可行的动作方面表现强劲，但成功的操作不仅需要知道当前什么动作可行，还需要预判交互的发展方向。现有策略大多让这种预见性隐式地通过动作学习涌现。我们引入了运动趋势引导（Movement Trend Guidance），这是一种简单而有效的方法，能够在无需显式规划的情况下提供这种预见性。该策略从一段较短的观测历史中学习交互演化的紧凑潜在表征。训练过程中，稀疏的未来夹爪状态监督这一表征；推理时，仅保留该潜在表征作为面向未来的条件，与当前观测一起使用。该潜在表征为动作生成提供全局条件，而额外的门控FiLM分支仅在UNet瓶颈层使用。尽管相比DP3仅增加了3.52%的参数，我们的方法保留了原有的稠密动作和后退时域（receding-horizon）公式，并在RoboTwin2.0、LIBERO-40和DexArt上持续优于DP3。在50个任务的RoboTwin2.0混合训练中达到62.8%（对比56.1%），在LIBERO-40上达到71.93%（对比37.08%），在五个真实机器人任务上达到72.0%（对比49.0%）。这些结果表明，扩散策略能够从知晓交互的走向中显著获益，而无需被告知精确的运动目标。

Authors: Zhongbo Zhang, Zaibin Zhang, Yifan Wang, Changbo Yan, Lijun Wang, Huchuan Lu

HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface VLA

human-in-the-loop post-training Universal Manipulation Interface advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning policy-guided data collection

简要说明：本文提出HIL-UMI，一种无机器人在环的VLA模型后训练框架，通过策略引导的数据采集和优势条件的行为克隆，在真实操控任务上优于标准SFT。

TLDR: This paper introduces HIL-UMI, a robot-free human-in-the-loop post-training framework for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that uses policy-guided data collection and advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning to improve manipulation performance over standard SFT.

Abstract: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.

摘要（中文）：大规模视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人操作提供了强大的先验知识，但将其适配到特定部署场景仍具挑战性。基于任务特定示范的监督微调（SFT）为部署迈出了一步，却面临两个持续存在的局限：静态数据对分布外状态的覆盖有限，且标准模仿目标无法区分有进展的行为与价值较低的数据。交互式后训练可以解决这些局限，但通常需要在物理机器人上重复执行策略并进行人工干预。我们提出HIL-UMI，一种基于策略引导的通用操作接口（UMI）框架，用于无机器人在环的VLA后训练。在手持UMI示范过程中，HIL-UMI在同一观测流上查询当前策略，但不执行其预测。能量分数（Energy Score）将人类动作轨迹与策略推断进行比较，当二者差异指示分布外区域时触发数据采集。在另一条独立的反馈回路中，低在线优势预测识别关键片段，用于优化基于进展的优势估计器。更新后的估计器随后引导基于优势条件的行为克隆，使用基础示范与新策略数据的平衡混合。该设计保留了人在回路学习的迭代性和策略感知特性，同时将数据采集与机器人部署解耦。在涵盖长时程和精细操作的四个真实世界任务上的实验表明，HIL-UMI相较于SFT实现了一致的改进，并同时受益于定向采集和优势优化。此外，HIL-UMI在Clean Up Table任务上优于HG-DAgger，且每帧采集时间更低，表明其在跨操作者和跨地点VLA后训练中具有可扩展的路径。

Authors: Zimu Han, Yiming Zeng, Jiyao Zhang, Zihao Zhao, Yuanfei Wang, Yixiang Jin, Shiqi Li, Shuangben Chen, Wei Huang, Ruodai Li, Hui Shen, Hao Dong

DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation Manipulation

action-conditioned world model tactile sensing human-to-robot scaling dexterous manipulation contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：DexTouch-WM 提出了一种动作条件下的触觉世界模型，利用可扩展的人类触觉数据（通过共享压阻阵列和动作重定向）来预测灵巧机器人操作的 RGB 和触觉动态，从而改进预测和策略学习。

TLDR: DexTouch-WM introduces an action-conditioned tactile world model that leverages scalable human touch data, via shared piezoresistive arrays and motion retargeting, to predict RGB and tactile dynamics for dexterous robot manipulation, improving prediction and policy learning.

Abstract: Learning predictive models of contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires dense tactile interaction, but such data are costly to scale on real robots and remain tied to embodiment-specific sensors. We introduce DexTouch-WM, an action-conditioned world model that learns from scalable human touch to jointly predict future RGB observations and bilateral tactile dynamics. Our insight is that human and robot manipulation share transferable contact dynamics when their tactile observations and action spaces are made compatible. We deploy flexible piezoresistive arrays with a shared sensing layout on both human and dexterous robot hands, and retarget human motion into the robot action space so that human interaction can supervise the same dynamics model used for real-robot prediction. DexTouch-WM couples a pretrained video expert with a lightweight tactile expert using anatomy-aware tactile tokens and aligned action conditioning. In human-to-robot scaling experiments, we keep five hours of real-robot supervision fixed while increasing human interaction from 0 to 100 hours, and observe substantial improvements in held-out robot-domain visual, geometric, and contact prediction despite disjoint human and robot task sets. Beyond prediction, we evaluate the world models as surrogate environments for policy evaluation and as generators of synthetic trajectories for real-robot policy learning, showing that scalable human interaction provides a complementary data axis for learning dexterous robot world models.

摘要（中文）：学习接触丰富的灵巧操作的预测模型需要密集的触觉交互，但此类数据在真实机器人上扩展成本高昂，且始终受制于特定于具体构型的传感器。我们提出 DexTouch-WM，一种动作条件世界模型，可从可扩展的人类触觉中学习，同时预测未来 RGB 观测和双侧触觉动力学。我们的核心洞见在于，当人类与机器人的触觉观测及动作空间彼此兼容时，二者在操作中共享可迁移的接触动力学。我们在人类和灵巧机器人手上部署了具有共享传感布局的柔性压阻阵列，并将人类动作重定向至机器人动作空间，从而使人类交互能够监督用于真实机器人预测的同一动力学模型。DexTouch-WM 将预训练的视频专家与轻量级触觉专家相结合，利用解剖感知触觉令牌和对齐的动作条件。在从人类到机器人的扩展实验中，我们将真实机器人监督数据固定为五小时，同时将人类交互数据从 0 小时增至 100 小时，观察到在留出的机器人域视觉、几何和接触预测中均有显著提升，尽管人类与机器人的任务集并不重叠。除预测之外，我们还将该世界模型评估为策略评估的替代环境，以及用于真实机器人策略学习的合成轨迹生成器，结果表明可扩展的人类交互为学习灵巧机器人世界模型提供了互补的数据维度。

Authors: Yan Qin, Yue Chen, Wenwei Lin, Shujia Liu, Chuqiao Lyu, Kailun Su, Chenze Yu, Ping Luo, Wenbo Ding, Tianxing Chen, Renjing Xu

SmellDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Quadruped Navigation with Olfactory Scene Graphs VLA

quadruped navigation diffusion-based trajectory generation olfactory scene graph gas source localization Gazebo simulation

简要说明：SmellDiffusion 提出了一种用于四足机器人气体源导航的仿真流程，利用嗅觉场景图和基于扩散的规划器，并带有几何门控进行源修正，在仿真和 Gazebo 中展示了与经典规划器相当的性能。

TLDR: SmellDiffusion introduces a simulation pipeline for quadruped navigation to gas sources, using an olfactory scene graph and a diffusion-based planner with a geometric gate for source correction, demonstrating comparable performance to classical planners in simulation and Gazebo.

Abstract: A robot sent to a named gas leak must preserve gas identity, estimate the source, and navigate to the resulting goal. We present SmellDiffusion, a simulation pipeline that represents species-specific gas zones in an open-vocabulary olfactory scene graph and shares the selected goal between classical and diffusion planners. Its key components are a peak-local geometric gate for selective source correction and diffusion-based, gas-guided trajectory generation. Among 424 unique source-wind configurations in solved flow, 28 have a concentration peak displaced more than 0.5m from the source. A source-independent geometric gate, calibrated only on the training split and evaluated at the observed peak, detects 9 of 10 held-out displacements at 0.64 precision. Gating a precomputed forward-matching correction reduces mean error on the displaced cases from 1.468m to 0.592m (60%), using matching for only 14/204 cases. All-case mean error falls from 0.205m to 0.180m. All planners receive the same scene-graph source estimate as their goal. In a controlled comparison, best-of-ten diffusion achieves mean gas exposure comparable to gas-guided A* (0.0476 versus 0.0455). A single diffusion proposal takes 41.7ms, compared with 72.3ms for gas-guided A*, although best-of-ten sequential sampling increases total runtime. Plain A* also reaches the same goal and remains the fastest and shortest-path method. Six matched Gazebo runs give mean robot-to-source errors of 0.39m for A* and 0.31m for diffusion.

摘要（中文）：派往已知气体泄漏点的机器人必须保持气体身份识别、估算泄漏源位置，并导航至由此生成的目标点。我们提出SmellDiffusion，一种模拟管线，其在开放词汇表 olfactory 场景图中表示物种特定的气体区域，并在经典规划器与扩散规划器之间共享选定目标。其关键组件包括用于选择性源修正的峰值局部几何门控，以及基于扩散的气体引导轨迹生成。在已求解流场中的424种独特源-风配置中，有28种浓度峰值偏离源位置超过0.5米。仅基于训练集校准并在观测峰值处评估的、与源无关的几何门控，能以0.64的精确度检测出10个保留位移中的9个。对预计算前向匹配修正进行门控处理，可将位移情况下的平均误差从1.468米降至0.592米（减少60%），且仅需对204个案例中的14个使用匹配算法。所有案例的平均误差从0.205米降至0.180米。所有规划器均接收相同的场景图源估计作为其目标。在受控对比中，最佳十次扩散的平均气体暴露量与气体引导A*相当（0.0476对0.0455）。单次扩散提案耗时41.7毫秒，而气体引导A*为72.3毫秒，尽管最佳十次顺序采样增加了总运行时间。普通A*同样到达相同目标，且仍是最快和最短路径的方法。六次匹配的Gazebo运行中，A*的机器人到源平均误差为0.39米，扩散为0.31米。

Authors: Faith Ogunwoye, Iana Zhura, Hajira Amjad, Timofei Kozlov, Didar Seyidov, Dmitrii Plotnikov, Fedor Fedorov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

INSPECT: Learning Robot View Selection from Assistant Use Manipulation

view selection assembly inspection egocentric assistant robot policy learning calibration

简要说明：INSPECT 从智能眼镜助手的装配任务使用记录中学习机器人视角选择策略，通过新颖的校准和监督方法，在无需目标域视角标签的情况下提高了验证成功率。

TLDR: INSPECT learns robot view selection policies from smart-glasses assistant usage records during assembly tasks, using novel calibration and supervision methods to improve verification success without needing target-domain view labels.

Abstract: Robots inspecting an assembly must determine which parts are present and whether they are correctly installed. During egocentric assembly assistance, head motion and workpiece handling reveal evidence for these checks, while spoken state confirmations link observations to procedural outcomes. We introduce INSPECT, which learns robot view preferences from records of a smart-glasses assistant that answers part queries and provides next-step guidance. Presence-Invariant TwinSwap (PI-TwinSwap) calibrates object evidence through paired identity interventions. Claim-indexed supervision separates evidence requirements from camera-reproducible observation changes. Object-centered calibration adapts relative view preferences to robot poses, while clause-level screening checks predicted evidence. The robot selects views using only its current observation and known poses, without candidate images. Evaluation uses annotated assistant-video replay to simulate state feedback, without target-domain view labels for policy training. On images of physical gearbox assemblies, INSPECT achieves the highest view utility among the compared non-oracle policies and raises human-rated full verifiability from 34.8% to 41.7% compared with keeping the current view. On commercial angle-grinder recordings in IMPACT, the transferred relative-view selector increases the correct decision rate from 50.6% to 54.3% with a frozen perception head. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT.

摘要（中文）：检查装配体的机器人必须确定哪些零件存在以及它们是否安装正确。在自我中心式装配辅助过程中，头部运动和工件操作可提供这些检查的证据，而口头状态确认则将观察结果与程序性结果联系起来。我们提出了INSPECT，它从智能眼镜助手的记录中学习机器人的视角偏好，该助手能够回答零件查询并提供下一步指导。存在不变双子交换（PI-TwinSwap）通过配对的身份干预来校准物体证据。声明索引监督将证据需求与相机可复现的观察变化分离开来。以物体为中心的校准将相对视角偏好适应于机器人姿态，而子句级筛选则检查预测的证据。机器人仅使用当前观察和已知姿态来选择视角，无需候选图像。评估使用标注的助手视频回放来模拟状态反馈，无需目标域视角标签用于策略训练。在物理齿轮箱组件的图像上，INSPECT在非神谕策略中实现了最高的视角效用，并将人工评定的完全可验证性从34.8%提升到41.7%，相比之下保持当前视角时仅为34.8%。在IMPACT中的商用角磨机记录上，迁移后的相对视角选择器在冻结感知头的情况下将正确决策率从50.6%提高到54.3%。源代码可在https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT获取。

Authors: Di Wen, Kailun Yang, Wenhao Guo, Yitian Shi, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Ruiping Liu, Jiale Wei, Rania Rayyes, Kunyu Peng

V2-STRep: VLM-Grounded Structured Task Representations for Reusable Robot Skills Acquired from Generated Videos Manipulation

zero-shot structured task representations video generation robot skills trajectory optimization

简要说明：V2-STRep是一个零样本框架，通过VLM基础的结构化任务表示，将生成视频中的运动转换为可复用的机器人技能，实现真实操作任务中的跨场景迁移和指令适应。

TLDR: V2-STRep is a zero-shot framework that converts motion from generated videos into reusable robot skills using VLM-grounded structured task representations, enabling cross-scene transfer and instruction adaptation on real manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Human manipulation videos provide rich motion and interaction cues for acquiring robot skills without robot demonstrations. Video generation models synthesize such demonstrations from an initial scene image and task instruction, avoiding the need to record demonstrations for each task. However, the recovered motion captures only one scene-specific realization, leaving task structure, geometric relations, and constraints implicit. We present V2-STRep, a zero-shot framework that converts generated video motion into reusable robot skills through VLM-grounded structured task representations. The representation specifies motion phases, references, and task-relevant constraints, with targets described by minimal geometric structures: points, point-normals, axes, planes, and full 6D poses. VLM-provided 2D image-space cues are lifted into 3D using RGB-D observations to reconstruct task geometry and candidate grasp poses. Geometry-specific rules transfer motion to new scenes, while task-constrained trajectory optimization couples grasp selection with complete robot motion planning. It preserves task requirements while using remaining rotational freedom to accommodate joint limits. Updating deployment grounding and constraints enables reuse under new compatible instructions without generating another video. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved execution success over baselines, reliable cross-scene transfer of successfully acquired skills, and adaptation to changed deployment instructions.

摘要（中文）：人类操作视频为获取机器人技能提供了丰富的运动和交互线索，而无需机器人演示。视频生成模型能够从初始场景图像和任务指令中合成此类演示，从而避免为每个任务录制演示的必要。然而，恢复出的运动仅捕捉到单一场景下的具体实现，任务结构、几何关系及约束仍隐含其中。我们提出V2-STRep，一种零样本框架，通过基于VLM的结构化任务表示，将生成的视频运动转化为可复用的机器人技能。该表示明确了运动阶段、参考对象及任务相关约束，目标由最小几何结构描述：点、点-法线、轴、平面及完整六自由度位姿。利用RGB-D观测，将VLM提供的二维图像空间线索提升至三维，以重建任务几何和候选抓取位姿。几何特定规则将运动迁移至新场景，而任务约束的轨迹优化将抓取选择与完整机器人运动规划相结合。该方法在保留任务要求的同时，利用剩余旋转自由度以适应关节限位。更新部署基准与约束，即可在新兼容指令下复用技能，而无需重新生成视频。在六项真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，该方法在执行成功率上优于基线方法，成功获取的技能具备可靠的跨场景迁移能力，并能适应部署指令的变化。

Authors: Yexin Hu, Dongheui Lee

Learning Slope-Adaptive Whole-Body Locomotion for Humanoid Robots in Roofing Construction HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid locomotion scene-grounded learning reinforcement learning whole-body control construction robotics

简要说明：本文提出了一种任务语义场景引导的框架，用于在屋顶施工中学习人形机器人的坡度自适应全身运动，通过结合人类演示重定向、轨迹优化和强化学习，使机器人能够在倾斜屋顶上执行瓦工风格的动作。

TLDR: This paper presents a task-semantic scene-grounded framework for learning slope-adaptive whole-body locomotion for humanoid robots in roofing construction, combining human demonstration retargeting, trajectory optimization, and reinforcement learning to enable the robot to perform roofer-style motions on pitched roofs.

Abstract: Roofing requires workers to coordinate locomotion, balance, and work-related body motions on pitched surfaces, creating a challenging application for humanoid robots. Directly retargeted human demonstrations, however, may preserve motion appearance while placing the robot's feet or hands incorrectly relative to the roof. This study presents a task-semantic scene-grounded framework for learning roofer-style whole-body motions on a Unitree G1. Human demonstrations are captured using a tracking system and retargeted to the robot, while a metric roof model supplies the spatial reference unavailable from the tracking system. A trajectory-level optimization grounds inferred support contacts and annotated work relations to the roof, and execution-aware reinforcement learning encourages the resulting policy to preserve these relations under dynamic tracking errors. The framework is evaluated through a multi-motion tracking study, a roof-pitch coverage matrix, a five-way nailgun ablation, cross-task experiments on hammering and lateral pushing, and comparisons with pure reinforcement learning and zero-shot teleoperation. Our method enables the robot to satisfy support, work-clearance, and nonpenetration criteria across all evaluated seeds. Across nailgun, hammering, and pushing, it achieves work-clearance errors between 0.256 and 0.531 cm and 3/3 successful evaluations per task. Physical experiments reproduce uphill walking, nailgun, hammering, and bending motions with mean base-frame motion errors below 80 mm. These findings establish scene-grounded human motion learning as a promising basis for construction-oriented humanoid motion primitives.

摘要（中文）：屋顶作业要求工人在倾斜表面上协调移动、保持平衡并进行与工作相关的身体动作，这为人形机器人带来了具有挑战性的应用场景。然而，直接重定向的人类示教虽能保留动作外观，却可能使机器人的脚或手相对于屋顶的位置不准确。本研究提出了一种基于任务语义场景锚定的框架，用于在Unitree G1上学习屋顶工风格的全身动作。通过追踪系统捕捉人类示教并将其重定向至机器人，同时利用度量屋顶模型提供追踪系统无法获取的空间参考。轨迹级优化将推断出的支撑接触点和标注的工作关系锚定至屋顶，而执行感知的强化学习则鼓励所得策略在动态追踪误差下保持这些关系。该框架通过多项动作追踪研究、屋顶坡度覆盖矩阵、五向射钉枪消融实验、锤击与侧向推挤的跨任务实验，以及与纯强化学习和零样本遥操作的对比进行评估。我们的方法使机器人在所有评估种子下均满足支撑、工作间隙和非穿透准则。在射钉枪、锤击和推挤任务中，工作间隙误差介于0.256至0.531厘米之间，且每个任务均获得3/3的成功评估。物理实验复现了上坡行走、射钉枪、锤击和弯腰动作，平均基座框架运动误差低于80毫米。这些发现确立了场景锚定的人类运动学习作为面向施工的人形运动基元的有效基础。

Authors: Songyang Liu, Shuai Li

Worst-Case Hidden-Vehicle Trajectory Search in Spatiotemporal Occlusion Regions AutonomousDriving

occlusion reasoning trajectory search minimax optimization autonomous driving safety

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的最坏情况隐藏车辆轨迹搜索算法（HC-MTS），该算法结合时间遮挡推理与双层极小极大优化，以找到使自车最佳驾驶分数最小化的合法隐藏车辆轨迹，并在Waymo开放运动数据集场景中展示了保留隐藏种子数量的显著减少。

TLDR: This paper introduces a worst-case hidden-vehicle trajectory search algorithm (HC-MTS) for autonomous driving, which combines temporal occlusion reasoning with a bilevel minimax optimization to find legal hidden-vehicle trajectories that minimize the ego vehicle's best possible driving score, demonstrating significant reductions in retained hidden-seed counts on Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios.

Abstract: Occlusion creates fundamental uncertainty in autonomous driving. Existing methods often propagate frame-wise hypotheses or optimize ego behavior against prescribed hidden-agent predictions, leaving the worst history-consistent interaction unexplored. We introduce History-Conditioned Minimax Trajectory Search (HC-MTS), which combines temporal occlusion reasoning with response-aware search. First, HC-MTS constructs finite hidden-state modes, each certified by a backward witness satisfying multi-frame visibility, occupancy, semantic-map support, and class-specific kinematic constraints. It then solves a bilevel minimax problem: an inner finite oracle maximizes the ego driving score over destination attainment and ride comfort, while the outer search selects the legal hidden-vehicle trajectory that minimizes this best-response value. Across eight Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios, increasing the visibility-memory horizon from K=1 to K=20 reduces the mean per-scenario vehicle, pedestrian, and total retained hidden-seed counts by 18.12%, 21.67%, and 18.45%, respectively. HC-MTS identifies six avoidable counterexamples, while no legal collision-producing attacker is found in the remaining two scenes within the finite search budget.

摘要（中文）：遮挡在自动驾驶中造成了根本性的不确定性。现有方法通常传播逐帧假设，或针对预设的隐藏智能体预测来优化自车行为，却未探索最坏情况下与历史一致的交互。我们提出了历史条件极小极大轨迹搜索（HC-MTS），将时序遮挡推理与响应感知搜索相结合。首先，HC-MTS构建有限的隐藏状态模式，每个模式由满足多帧可见性、占用、语义地图支持及类别特定运动学约束的后向见证者认证。随后，它求解一个双层极小极大问题：内层有限预言机在目的地达成度和乘坐舒适性上最大化自车驾驶得分，而外层搜索则选择使该最优响应值最小化的合法隐藏车辆轨迹。在Waymo开放运动数据集的八个场景中，将可见性记忆范围从K=1增加到K=20，使得每个场景的车辆、行人和总保留隐藏种子平均数量分别降低18.12%、21.67%和18.45%。HC-MTS识别出六个可避免的反例，而在剩余两个场景的有限搜索预算内，未发现任何合法且能产生碰撞的攻击者。

Authors: Ruichen Tan, Zengxiang Lei, Satish Ukkusuri

Visual Sim-to-Real Learning for Robotic Insertion under Geometric Variations: Application to Rebar Installation Manipulation

visual sim-to-real teacher-student distillation domain randomization robotic insertion construction robotics

简要说明：RebarSim 提出了一种纯仿真训练的视觉仿真到现实系统，通过教师-学生蒸馏和域随机化，在真实工厂零件上实现了91.3%的零样本机器人钢筋插入成功率。

TLDR: RebarSim presents a visual sim-to-real system that trains a multi-view policy purely in simulation for robotic rebar insertion, achieving 91.3% zero-shot success on real factory parts through teacher-student distillation and domain randomization.

Abstract: Rebar insertion is among the most repetitive and physically demanding tasks on construction sites, and a contact-rich problem at 1.4 mm clearance. The parts, however, vary at two levels: a nominal design per structural member, and fabrication tolerance around each nominal design. Real-world data therefore has to be re-collected as designs and batches change. We present RebarSim, a visual sim-to-real system trained entirely in simulation. A privileged state-based teacher is trained with reinforcement learning over procedurally generated rebar geometries, then distilled into a multi-view student that maps raw RGB and proprioception directly to actions under extensive domain randomization. The student transfers to the real world zero-shot, seating rebars taken from a real factory production run in 91.3% of real-robot rollouts. Underlying that result, geometry diversity and pretraining both bring benefits. Training across a diverse set of nominal designs rather than one lifts the zero-shot success of both the teacher and the student on unseen designs, and the student policy outperforms a single-design specialist on that specialist's own design. A pretrained student then adapts to a new design with 4--6x fewer distillation samples than one trained from scratch. Visual sim-to-real transfer depends on appearance randomization and the DAgger mixture: removing either one sharply lowers success. Videos, code, and task assets are available at https://rebarsim.github.io.

摘要（中文）：钢筋插入是建筑工地上最重复且体力要求最高的任务之一，同时也是在1.4毫米间隙下进行的接触密集型问题。然而，构件存在两个层面的变化：每个结构构件的标称设计，以及围绕每个标称设计的制造公差。因此，随着设计和批次的改变，现实世界的数据必须重新采集。我们提出了RebarSim，一种完全在仿真中训练的视觉仿真到现实系统。我们通过强化学习在程序化生成的钢筋几何形状上训练一个基于特权状态的教师模型，然后将其蒸馏为多视角学生模型，该模型在广泛的域随机化下直接将原始RGB图像和本体感觉映射为动作。学生模型零样本迁移到现实世界，在真实机器人试验中，从实际工厂生产批次中取出的钢筋的安装成功率达到91.3%。在支撑这一结果的因素中，几何多样性和预训练均带来了益处。在多样化的标称设计集合上训练（而非单一设计）提升了教师模型和学生模型在未见设计上的零样本成功率，并且学生策略在某个单一设计专家的自身设计上表现优于该专家。经过预训练的学生模型适应新设计所需的蒸馏样本比从零开始训练的模型少4至6倍。视觉仿真到现实的迁移依赖于外观随机化和DAgger混合策略：移除其中任意一个都会显著降低成功率。视频、代码和任务资源可在https://rebarsim.github.io获取。

Authors: Tao Sun, Beining Han, Patrick Yin, Rui Xu, Harry He, Abhishek Gupta, Szymon Rusinkiewicz, Yi Shao

Imagine-TAMP: Imagination-Guided Task and Motion Planning in Partial Observability Manipulation

Task and Motion Planning Partial Observability Vision-Language Model Generative Scene Model Belief Shaping

简要说明：Imagine-TAMP 提出了一种任务与运动规划框架，利用视觉语言模型和生成式场景模型在部分可观测环境中想象场景并评估观测与操作策略，提高了成功率并减少了真实机器人的规划时间。

TLDR: Imagine-TAMP introduces a task and motion planning framework that uses a vision-language model and a generative scene model to imagine scenes and evaluate observation-versus-manipulation strategies in partially observable environments, improving success rates and reducing planning time on real robots.

Abstract: Robots operating in cluttered environments must often manipulate objects whose locations are only partially observable. A central challenge is deciding whether to acquire another observation or to first manipulate objects that may occlude the target. Conventional task and motion planning (TAMP) approaches typically make this decision using symbolic action costs or expensive geometric planning, neither of which adequately captures how likely an observation is to reveal an occluded target. We introduce Imagine-TAMP, an interleaved planning and execution framework that uses semantic and geometric imagination to compare alternative task-level strategies under partial observability before committing to expensive motion planning. A vision-language model shapes a particle belief over target locations using commonsense relationships between the target and visible objects, while a generative scene model estimates plausible geometry in unobserved regions. Given a target hypothesis and imagined scene, Imagine-TAMP generates multiple symbolic plan skeletons and assigns non-unit costs that approximate both manipulation effort and target visibility from sensing actions, distinguishing a short but poorly informative observation strategy from a longer strategy that first manipulates an occluder to better expose the target. The selected skeleton is then refined into a feasible continuous plan and executed, with new observations updating the belief and triggering replanning when necessary. Experiments show that imagination-guided evaluation improves observation-versus-manipulation decisions: in viewpoint-constrained shelf scenes, non-unit geometric evaluation increases success from 46.0% to 84.0%, while semantic belief shaping further reduces manipulation and replanning. On a real robot, the complete system reduces planning time by 32% relative to a geometry-only ablation.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱环境中作业的机器人通常需要操控那些位置仅能部分观测到的物体。其核心挑战在于判断是应获取额外观测，还是先操控可能遮挡目标的物体。传统的任务与运动规划（TAMP）方法通常依赖符号化动作成本或昂贵的几何规划来做出这一决策，但这二者均无法充分刻画一次观测发现被遮挡目标的可能性。我们提出Imagine-TAMP，一种交错式规划与执行框架，利用语义想象与几何想象，在投入昂贵运动规划之前，对部分可观测条件下的备选任务级策略进行比较。视觉-语言模型利用目标与可见物体之间的常识性关系，在目标位置上构建粒子置信度，而生成式场景模型则在未观测区域估计合理的几何形态。基于给定的目标假设与想象场景，Imagine-TAMP生成多种符号化规划骨架，并为感知动作赋予非单位成本，该成本同时近似操控工作量与目标可见性，从而区分出信息量少但耗时短的观测策略，与先操控遮挡物以更好暴露目标的较长策略。所选骨架随后被细化成可行的连续规划并执行，新观测数据会更新置信度，并在必要时触发重新规划。实验表明，想象引导的评估能够改善观测与操控之间的决策：在视角受限的货架场景中，非单位几何评估将成功率从46.0%提升至84.0%，而语义置信度塑造进一步减少了操控与重新规划次数。在真实机器人上，与仅使用几何信息的消融方法相比，完整系统将规划时间缩短了32%。

Authors: Antareep Singha, Shivaram Kumar, Yoonwoo Kim, Yoonchang Sung

RoboFind: Multi-Agent Personalized Object Search for People Who Are Blind or Have Low Vision Other

multi-agent object search quadruped robot accessibility vision-language

简要说明：RoboFind 提出了一种多智能体框架，用于盲人或低视力用户的个性化物体搜索，通过四足机器人利用智能手机教学的目标特征进行探索并验证候选物体，在真实机器人任务中取得了高成功率。

TLDR: RoboFind presents a multi-agent framework for personalized object search for blind/low-vision users, where a quadruped robot explores using a smartphone-taught target profile and verifies candidates against stored references, achieving high success in real-robot missions.

Abstract: Blind and low-vision users often need to locate a specific personal object rather than an arbitrary instance of the same category. The task calls for a robot that can move through the space and reach viewpoints the user cannot, and for an accessible interface where the user says which object is meant and learns whether the right one was found. We present RoboFind, a multi-agent framework in which a smartphone teaches the target and a quadruped robot carries out the search. A Target Teaching Agent converts guided smartphone recordings into a semantic target profile and a reusable multi-view reference bank through an accessible capture flow with AR guidance, speech and haptic feedback, and screen-reader support, so later missions refer to a stored object without repeating the teaching process. At runtime, a Navigation Agent explores the environment and proposes candidate targets, a Verification Agent checks each candidate against the stored references, and a Coordination and Recovery Agent completes the mission or triggers recovery and continued search. Across 32 real-robot missions, RoboFind reaches 85.0% success against 25.0% for a reconstructed sequential first-stop baseline over 20 trials with ten targets, and reduces false success from 75.0% to 5.0%. On six shared targets it succeeds in 10/12 trials, against 5/12 for 12 independently executed GPT-6 Astra-only trials. These results show that the multi-agent design fits the demands of personalized object search, where verifying object identity before declaring completion is what makes the outcome something a user can rely on.

摘要（中文）：盲人和低视力用户通常需要定位特定的个人物品，而非同类物品的任意实例。这一任务要求机器人能够在空间中移动，并到达用户无法到达的视角，同时还需提供一个无障碍界面，使用户能够说出目标物品，并了解是否找到了正确对象。我们提出了RoboFind，一个多智能体框架，其中智能手机负责教授目标，四足机器人执行搜索。目标教授智能体通过无障碍采集流程，将引导式手机录制转换为语义目标档案和可复用的多视角参考库，该流程包含增强现实引导、语音与触觉反馈以及屏幕阅读器支持，从而使后续任务能够引用已存储的物体，无需重复教授过程。在运行时，导航智能体探索环境并提出候选目标，验证智能体根据存储的参考信息逐一核对候选对象，协调与恢复智能体则完成任务或触发恢复并继续搜索。在32次真实机器人任务中，RoboFind的成功率达到85.0%，而重建的“首站顺序基线”在20次试验、10个目标下的成功率为25.0%，同时将虚假成功从75.0%降至5.0%。在6个共享目标上，RoboFind在12次试验中成功10次，而12次独立执行的GPT-6 Astra-only试验仅成功5次。这些结果表明，多智能体设计契合个性化物体搜索的需求，而在宣布完成之前验证物体身份，正是使用户能够信赖搜索结果的关键所在。

Authors: Ruiping Liu, Shaofang Quan, Qian Yin, Jingqi Zhang, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Di Wen, Weijia Fan, Kailun Yang, M. Saquib Sarfraz, Tamim Asfour, Kunyu Peng, Rainer Stiefelhagen

AnyViewDex: View-Invariant Dexterous Manipulation from RGB Observations Manipulation

view-invariant dexterous manipulation monocular RGB contrastive alignment privileged geometric supervision

简要说明：AnyViewDex提出了一种非对称训练流程，结合多视角对比对齐和特权3D几何监督，实现了仅依赖单目RGB的视点不变灵巧操作，并在真实硬件上跨未见物体和视点验证了高成功率。

TLDR: AnyViewDex presents an asymmetric training pipeline that combines multi-view contrastive alignment with privileged 3D geometric supervision to achieve view-invariant dexterous manipulation from monocular RGB, validated on real hardware with high success across unseen objects and viewpoints.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies for multi-fingered dexterous manipulation are highly sensitive to camera viewpoint shifts. To achieve view invariance, recent methods increasingly rely on explicit 3D modalities like RGB-D or point clouds, which can introduce hardware dependencies, calibration requirements, and vulnerability to sensor noise during real-world deployment. In this work, we show that view-invariant control can be achieved without explicit test-time 3D sensing by encoding geometric knowledge into the visual representation during simulation. We present AnyViewDex, an asymmetric training pipeline that combines multi-view contrastive alignment with privileged 3D geometric supervision. By regressing absolute 3D object coordinates during simulated training, this auxiliary objective provides a geometric grounding signal that mitigates the spatial collapse of the globally pooled contrastive embedding. At deployment, the policy operates zero-shot using only uncalibrated monocular RGB and proprioception. We validate this approach across both reinforcement learning and student-teacher distillation. In hardware evaluation on an xArm7 with a 16-DoF LEAP Hand, AnyViewDex reaches 76.7% grasping success across eight unseen objects and six uncalibrated viewpoints (480 trials; 2,400 across all ablation conditions), indicating that geometrically grounded monocular policies transfer zero-shot without test-time depth. Project Page: https://anyviewdex.github.io/

摘要（中文）：视觉运动策略用于多指灵巧操作时，对相机视点变化高度敏感。为实现视角不变性，近期方法越来越依赖于显式的三维模态，如RGB-D或点云，这在实际部署中可能引入硬件依赖、标定需求以及对传感器噪声的脆弱性。在本工作中，我们证明通过在仿真训练期间将几何知识编码进视觉表征，可以在不依赖显式测试时三维感知的情况下实现视角不变控制。我们提出AnyViewDex，一种非对称训练流程，将多视角对比对齐与特权三维几何监督相结合。通过在仿真训练中回归绝对三维物体坐标，这一辅助目标提供了几何底层的信号，缓解了全局池化对比嵌入的空间坍缩问题。在部署时，策略仅使用未标定的单目RGB和本体感觉即可零样本运行。我们在强化学习和师生蒸馏两种范式下均验证了该方法。在配备16自由度LEAP手的xArm7硬件评估中，AnyViewDex在八个未见物体和六个未标定视角下达到了76.7%的抓取成功率（480次试验；所有消融条件下共2400次），表明几何底层的单目策略无需测试时深度即可实现零样本迁移。项目页面：https://anyviewdex.github.io/

Authors: Soham Patil, Om Sanjay Gunjal, Sourabh Bhosale, Arhan Chavare, Ramandeep Singh Hora, Spandan Roy

Safety-Critical Scenanrio Emerges from Initial Scene AutonomousDriving

safety-critical scenario generation latent diffusion model reinforcement learning closed-loop simulation Waymo Open Motion Dataset

简要说明：AdvScene提出了一种两阶段条件潜扩散模型，用于生成安全关键的驾驶初始场景，并通过强化学习和闭环模拟器微调来诱发自车故障和危险接近事件。

TLDR: AdvScene proposes a two-stage conditional latent diffusion model that learns to generate realistic initial scenes for safety-critical driving scenario generation, using RL fine-tuning with closed-loop simulators to induce ego faults and near-misses.

Abstract: Safety-critical driving scenario generation has largely focused on manipulating the behavior of surrounding agents while starting from an initial scene from driving data. This assumption can limit the space of discoverable failures, since driving data can provide little opportunity for meaningful interaction. For example, in the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 20.44% of recorded slices feature a stationary ego vehicle that never moves, and 30.39% of initial frames contain no nearby traffic participants within 10 meters. We instead study safety-critical scenario generation as an initialization problem: given agnostic black-box driving policies, we learn to generate realistic initial scenes that are more likely to evolve into critical interactions. We propose AdvScene, a conditional latent diffusion model that is trained in two stages. Starting from pretraining on naturalistic driving data, we post-train the adversarial-agent generation branch using reinforcement learning with feedback from closed-loop simulator rollouts. Conditioning on ego driving displacement prevents the ego from remaining static, and RL finetuning induces criticality directly with non-differentiable safety-critical metrics. Experiments on the Waymo dataset across 12 combinations of ego and traffic policies show that our AdvScene substantially increases the rate of ego-fault collision events and TTC<3s events.

摘要（中文）：安全关键驾驶场景生成的研究大多集中于在从驾驶数据获取的初始场景基础上，操控周围智能体的行为。这一假设可能限制可发现故障的空间，因为驾驶数据难以提供有意义的交互机会。例如，在Waymo开放运动数据集中，20.44%的记录片段中自车处于静止状态且从未移动，30.39%的初始帧在10米范围内没有附近的交通参与者。相反，我们将安全关键场景生成视为一个初始化问题：给定不可知的黑盒驾驶策略，我们学习生成更有可能演变为关键交互的真实初始场景。我们提出了AdvScene，一种两阶段训练的条件潜在扩散模型。首先在自然驾驶数据上进行预训练，然后利用闭环模拟器 rollout 的反馈，通过强化学习对对抗智能体生成分支进行后训练。以自车驾驶位移为条件可防止自车保持静止，而强化学习微调则直接利用不可微的安全关键指标引发临界状态。在Waymo数据集上，针对12种自车与交通策略组合的实验表明，我们的AdvScene显著提高了自车故障碰撞事件和TTC<3s事件的发生率。

Authors: Yin Wu, Jiarong Wei, Carl Esselborn, Shubham Phoolari, Ahmed Abouelazm, Daniel Slieter, J. Marius Zöllner

FlipToSee: A Probabilistic Stable Placement Prior for Active Visual Exploration via Regrasping Manipulation

active visual exploration stable placement prior regrasping von Mises-Fisher mixture point cloud

简要说明：FlipToSee利用von Mises-Fisher混合密度网络从单视角点云学习概率稳定放置先验，通过重新抓取实现主动视觉探索以暴露被遮挡表面，并在仿真和物理机器人上验证了高效性。

TLDR: FlipToSee learns a probabilistic stable placement prior from a single-view point cloud using a von Mises-Fisher mixture density network, enabling active visual exploration via regrasping to expose occluded object surfaces. It demonstrates high success rates in simulation and on a physical robot.

Abstract: Active visual exploration of tabletop objects often requires reorienting an unknown resting object onto a different stable support face to expose occluded surfaces. To identify such placements without exhaustive physical search, we learn a probabilistic placement prior from a single-view point cloud. Stable placement prediction is inherently multimodal, and conventional 6-DoF regression introduces further ambiguity by modeling translation and in-plane yaw. We therefore propose FlipToSee, a probabilistic framework that removes this representational ambiguity by parameterizing placements as unit support normals on $S^2$ while modeling their multimodal conditional distribution via a von Mises--Fisher mixture density network. To decouple mode diversity from physical robustness, FlipToSee deterministically extracts a compact candidate set from the mixture components and applies robustness-aware reranking using an auxiliary head trained with candidate-aligned supervision. In simulation, FlipToSee achieves $98.4\%$ first-proposal success on in-distribution objects, $95.3\%$ on out-of-distribution shapes, and $90.0\%$ under zero-shot transfer to household YCB objects. We further demonstrate the learned placement prior on a physical robot by integrating it with grasp and motion planning for exploratory regrasping.

摘要（中文）：主动视觉探索桌面物体时，常常需要将未知的静止物体重新定向至不同的稳定支撑面，以显露出被遮挡的表面。为了在不进行穷举物理搜索的情况下找出此类放置位置，我们利用单视角点云学习了一个概率性放置先验。稳定的放置预测本质上是多模态的，而常规的6自由度回归通过建模平移和面内偏航引入了额外的歧义。为此，我们提出了FlipToSee，一个概率框架，通过将放置参数化为$S^2$上的单位支撑法向量，并利用von Mises-Fisher混合密度网络对其多模态条件分布进行建模，从而消除了这种表示上的歧义。为了将模式多样性与物理鲁棒性解耦，FlipToSee从混合分量中确定性地提取一个紧凑的候选集合，并使用经候选对齐监督训练的辅助头进行考虑鲁棒性的重新排序。在仿真中，FlipToSee在分布内物体上首次提议成功率达到$98.4\%$，在分布外形状上达到$95.3\%$，在零样本迁移至家庭YCB物体时达到$90.0\%$。我们还将学习到的放置先验集成到抓取和运动规划中，在实体机器人上进行了探索性再抓取实验，验证了该方法的有效性。

Authors: Chang Shu, Sushil Samuel Dinesh, Shinkyu Park

DR-MPC: Fast and Feasible Dynamics-Relaxed Model-Predictive Control for Legged Locomotion Locomotion

model predictive control legged locomotion quadruped robot interior-point method quadratic programming

简要说明：DR-MPC提出了一种动力松弛模型预测控制公式及定制内点求解器，用于腿部运动，在四足机器人上验证，并比现有求解器大幅提速。

TLDR: DR-MPC introduces a dynamics-relaxed MPC formulation with a tailored interior-point solver for legged locomotion, achieving large speedups over existing solvers and validated on a quadruped robot.

Abstract: This paper presents dynamics-relaxed model predictive control (DR-MPC), a novel MPC formulation for legged locomotion, and a tailored interior-point method (IPM) solver. The formulation combines online optimization feasibility by construction with a contact-aware input parameterization. DR-MPC moves the dynamics equality and affine input constraints into quadratic penalties and retains only nonempty box constraints. The resulting box-constrained quadratic program (QP) has a block-arrow Hessian that enables the state and affine-output directions to be eliminated through a Schur complement. The solver factors only the reduced control system after swing-force elimination and contact-aligned move blocking. For the evaluated implementations using the same DR-MPC formulation, our method achieves median end-to-end MPC speedups of $16.0\times$ over HPIPM and $4.4\times$ over OSQP, with comparable locomotion performance in simulation. DR-MPC achieves a median onboard MPC end-to-end time of $4.4$ ms and is validated on a Unitree Go1 quadruped. Open-source code will be made available after publication.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了动力学松弛模型预测控制（DR-MPC），一种新颖的腿部运动MPC公式，以及一种定制化的内点法（IPM）求解器。该公式通过构造性在线优化可行性，结合接触感知输入参数化。DR-MPC将动力学等式和仿射输入约束转化为二次惩罚项，仅保留非空盒约束。所得的盒约束二次规划（QP）具有块箭形Hessian矩阵，使得状态和仿射输出方向可通过Schur补消去。该求解器仅在摆动力的消除和接触对齐的移动阻断后，对缩减的控制系统进行因式分解。在采用相同DR-MPC公式的评估实现中，我们的方法相较于HPIPM实现了中位端到端MPC加速16.0倍，相较于OSQP实现了4.4倍加速，同时仿真中的运动性能相当。DR-MPC在机载MPC端到端中位时间为4.4毫秒，并在Unitree Go1四足机器人上得到验证。开源代码将在发表后提供。

Authors: Run Wang, Alapati Tuerxun, Shuo Liu, Wei Xiao, Ján Drgoňa, Yilin Mo, Liang Wu

Compliance for Free: Learning Identifiable Impedance via Bilateral Teleoperation VLA

bilateral teleoperation compliance stiffness identification vision-language-action model contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：本论文提出一种通过双边遥操作实现机器人操作策略中刚度学习的方法，使每轴刚度可识别，并为VLA微调生成逐时间步的顺应性标签。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for learning compliance (stiffness) in robot manipulation policies by using bilateral teleoperation to make per-axis stiffness identifiable and generating per-timestep compliance labels for VLA fine-tuning.

Abstract: Vision-language-action models tell a robot where to move, but not how hard to push. Contact-rich tasks depend on that second quantity, compliance, yet no widely used demonstration interface records it. The obstacle is identifiability as realized pose and measured force cannot separate the operator's intended equilibrium from their stiffness, so VR controllers, SpaceMouse and handheld grippers cannot supply compliance supervision even in principle. Prior compliance-output policies work around this with hand-specified task structure, privileged simulation contact state, or dedicated force and tactile hardware. Four-channel bilateral teleoperation removes the ambiguity directly by using the leader arm as a separate measurement of the intended equilibrium, making per-axis stiffness identifiable by regression using only the joint-torque sensing already on the manipulator. This yields per-timestep, direction-dependent compliance labels at zero annotation cost, which we use to fine-tune a VLA to emit stiffness alongside pose. On a Franka Research 3 wiping task, ours is the only policy of five whose contact force changes when the instruction asks for a firm wipe rather than a normal one (6.4N (normal) to 9.1N (firm) RMS, Cohen's d = 0.89, p = 0.023

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型告诉机器人移动到哪里，但不告诉它该用多大的力推。接触密集的任务依赖的是后者，即柔顺性，然而目前没有任何广泛使用的示教接口能够记录这一信息。障碍在于可辨识性：由于实际姿态与测得力无法将操作者的意图平衡点与其刚度分离开来，因此VR控制器、SpaceMouse和手持夹爪即使在原理上也无法提供柔顺监督。现有的柔顺输出策略通过手工指定的任务结构、特权的仿真接触状态，或专用的力与触觉硬件来绕开这一问题。四通道双边遥操作直接消除了这一歧义，它利用主手臂作为意图平衡点的独立测量来源，从而仅凭机械臂上已有的关节力矩传感即可通过回归辨识出每个轴向上的刚度。这以零标注成本提供了逐时间步、随方向变化的柔顺标签，我们利用这些标签对VLA进行微调，使其在输出姿态的同时输出刚度。在Franka Research 3擦拭任务中，在五种策略中，唯有我们的策略在指令要求用力擦拭而非正常擦拭时接触力发生了显著变化（RMS从6.4N（正常）升至9.1N（用力），Cohen's d = 0.89，p = 0.023）。

Authors: Harsha Guda, Adrià Colomé, Carme Torras

MaskHarness-WAM: Instance-Grounded Harnessing for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Manipulation

instance-grounded target masks long-horizon manipulation subtask scheduling visual feedback

简要说明：MaskHarness-WAM 提出一种基于实例掩码的框架，通过目标掩码连接高层规划和低层操作策略，在真实机器人上实现长时间多物体操作，并在每个子任务边界重新观察和验证完成状态。

TLDR: MaskHarness-WAM introduces an instance-grounded harness that uses target masks to connect high-level planning with low-level manipulation policies, enabling long-horizon multi-object manipulation on a real robot by re-observing and verifying subtask completion at each stage.

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires not only stable local visuomotor control, but also continuous target tracking and reliable task progress assessment throughout execution. This challenge becomes particularly critical when multiple objects share identical appearances and must be manipulated in a prescribed order. In such scenarios, relying solely on a limited-horizon manipulation policy is often insufficient to determine which instance should be operated on and when the task should transition to the next stage. To address this challenge, we propose MaskHarness-WAM, an instance-grounded harness for long-horizon manipulation. The proposed system connects high-level task planning with low-level manipulation policies through target masks, while leveraging visual feedback for subtask scheduling and continuous execution. Since each subtask corresponds to a different target instance, the low-level policy requires a newly established initial target mask under the updated scene at each subtask transition. The harness continuously re-observes the environment, generates, and verifies the target mask at subtask boundaries, thereby updating the instance-level spatial condition provided to the low-level policy. Furthermore, the system advances the manipulation process by switching target instances according to the verified completion status of each subtask. Experiments on a real robot platform demonstrate that MaskHarness-WAM substantially outperforms limited-horizon policies on sequential multi-object manipulation, showing its effectiveness in extending local manipulation skills to reliable long-horizon execution.

摘要（中文）：长时程机器人操作不仅需要稳定的局部视觉运动控制，还需要在整个执行过程中持续进行目标跟踪和可靠的任务进度评估。当多个对象外观相同且必须按照指定顺序进行操作时，这一挑战尤为关键。在这种情况下，仅依赖有限时域的操作策略往往不足以确定应操作哪个实例以及任务应在何时进入下一阶段。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了MaskHarness-WAM，一种面向长时程操作的实例锚定操控框架。该系统通过目标掩码将高层任务规划与低层操作策略相连接，同时利用视觉反馈进行子任务调度和连续执行。由于每个子任务对应不同的目标实例，低层策略在每次子任务切换时都需在新场景下建立新的初始目标掩码。该框架持续重新观测环境，在子任务边界生成并验证目标掩码，从而更新提供给低层策略的实例级空间条件。此外，系统根据每个子任务已验证的完成状态切换目标实例，从而推进操作进程。在真实机器人平台上的实验表明，MaskHarness-WAM在顺序多对象操作任务中显著优于有限时域策略，展示了其将局部操作技能扩展为可靠长时程执行的有效性。

Authors: Zitai Huang, Taiyi Su, Jian Zhu, Jianjun Zhang, Chong Ma, Tianbin Liu, Weiyi Lu, Yi Xu, Hanli Wang

Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion Manipulation

residual reinforcement learning contact-rich manipulation book insertion PPO task-space control

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于接触丰富的书本插入任务的混合残差强化学习框架，标称任务空间控制器处理结构化插入，残差PPO提供有界修正和释放决策，在仿真和物理机器人试验中相比标称控制显著提升成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a hybrid residual reinforcement learning framework for contact-rich robotic book insertion, where a nominal task-space controller handles structured insertion while residual PPO provides bounded corrections and release decisions, achieving significant improvements over nominal control in both simulation and physical robot trials.

Abstract: Placing a grasped book into a tight shelf is a compact but difficult contact-rich control problem: millimetre-scale pose error can turn a geometrically valid approach into jamming, failed release, or incomplete seating. We study this final phase after grasp acquisition and global approach, and ask how control authority should be divided between known geometry and learned behaviour. Our method retains a nominal task-space controller for structured insertion and seating, while residual PPO supplies bounded local corrections and decides when to release. Only the brief open-retreat-reclose transition is scripted. For the final policy used on hardware, a deployment-matched simulation evaluation over 512 fixed conditions yields 98.50 percent mean success (0.23 percentage-point sample SD) across three independent training runs, compared with 37.89 percent for nominal control. On the physical xArm7, 60 trials over 30 matched conditions show the same qualitative advantage: residual control raises success from 26.7 percent to 63.3 percent, reduces failures from 22 to 11, and wins 13 of the 15 matched conditions in which the two controllers differ. Robustness tests show that performance remains above 87 percent under initialization perturbations up to 1.5x, while very tight clearances expose the geometric limit of local correction. These results support a hybrid design in which geometry preserves reliable task structure and learning is concentrated on the contact-sensitive behaviour that fixed rules handle poorly.

摘要（中文）：将抓取的书本放入紧凑书架是一个紧凑但困难的接触丰富控制问题：毫米级的位姿误差可能将几何上有效的接近动作转变为卡阻、释放失败或未完全就位。我们研究抓取完成和全局接近之后的最终阶段，并探讨控制权限应如何在已知几何与学习行为之间分配。我们的方法保留了标称任务空间控制器以执行结构化插入和就位，同时残差PPO提供有界局部修正并决定何时释放。仅简短的开-退-再闭合过渡过程被脚本化。在硬件上使用的最终策略中，针对512个固定条件的部署匹配仿真评估在三次独立训练运行中平均成功率为98.50%（样本标准差为0.23个百分点），而标称控制仅为37.89%。在物理xArm7上，30个匹配条件下的60次试验显示出相同的定性优势：残差控制将成功率从26.7%提升至63.3%，失败次数从22次减少至11次，并在两个控制器表现不同的15个匹配条件中赢得13个。鲁棒性测试表明，在初始化扰动高达1.5倍时性能仍保持在87%以上，而极紧间隙则暴露了局部修正的几何极限。这些结果支持一种混合设计，其中几何保证可靠的任务结构，学习专注于固定规则难以处理的接触敏感行为。
