Authors: Zhiyi Chen, Shuli Lv, Chen Min, Yong Xu, Jian Sun, Quan Quan

Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent VLN

Vision-Language Navigation zero-shot spatial state navigation topology closed-loop navigation

简要说明：Navi-Agent 提出了一种零样本 VLN-CE 智能体，利用视觉观察和运动历史构建无坐标空间状态，在几何约束方法中达到最优性能，并与依赖几何定位的方法竞争表现。

TLDR: Navi-Agent introduces a zero-shot VLN-CE agent using a coordinate-free spatial state built from visual observations and motion histories, achieving state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods and competitive results with geometric localization approaches.

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.

摘要（中文）：连续环境中的视觉-语言导航要求具身智能体在未知环境中执行长时段指令。现有的零样本连续环境视觉-语言导航系统通常通过几何定位或基于坐标的表征来维护空间状态。近期的几何约束导航方法去除了深度信息和全局一致坐标，但在维护持久空间感知以进行地点确认、进度验证和恢复方面仍面临挑战。我们提出Navi-Agent，一种零样本连续环境视觉-语言导航智能体，它从视觉观察和已执行的运动历史中构建无坐标空间状态。Navi-Agent将该状态组织为导航拓扑结构，其中节点表示视觉地点，边表示运动转换。这种表征支持基于观察的近似自定位、任务进度验证以及基于视觉重访的恢复机制。Navi-Agent通过将指令分解为子目标、执行局部视觉导航，并利用所构建的空间状态验证已访问地点来实现闭环导航。在零样本连续环境视觉-语言导航基准和真实机器人平台上的实验表明，Navi-Agent在几何约束方法中达到了最先进的性能，同时与依赖几何定位的方法相比仍具有竞争力。

Authors: Wenyuan Xie, Mengyang Hong, Yongzhong Wang, Yanbiao Ji, Yijin Zhou, Shaokai Wu, Shalayiding Sirejiding, Huayi Zhou, Yi-Chao Chen, Ma Ling, Yue Ding, Hongtao Lu

EliGSiR: Continual RGB-D Mapping with Gaussian Splatting under Bounded Compute Perception3D

continual RGB-D mapping Gaussian Splatting online reconstruction view scheduling load-adaptive fidelity

简要说明：EliGSiR 提出了一种基于 3D 高斯散射的持续 RGB-D 建图方法，通过自适应视图调度、负载自适应保真度和定向几何增长，在 RGB-D SLAM 基准上以更低计算量实现了更高的重建质量。

TLDR: EliGSiR introduces a continual RGB-D mapper using 3D Gaussian Splatting with adaptive view scheduling, load-adaptive fidelity, and targeted geometry growth, achieving higher reconstruction quality and lower compute than existing methods on RGB-D SLAM benchmarks.

Abstract: Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting assumes a closed set of observations and long optimization schedules. Continual RGB-D mapping in contrast poses the problem that new observations arrive online, while previously reconstructed regions must be preserved. We present EliGSiR (Evidence-guided Load-adaptive Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Image Replay), a continual Gaussian mapper that controls how the available optimization budget is used as the reconstruction evolves. Map-Guided View Scheduling filters redundant incoming views and reconsiders retained views according to the current state of the map. Load-Adaptive Fidelity adjusts supervision resolution to the current mapping load instead of following a fixed resolution schedule. Targeted Geometry Growth separates depth supervision from Gaussian creation and adds geometric capacity only where repeated RGB-D observations indicate missing or misplaced structure. Together, these mechanisms adapt which views are optimized, how much image detail is used, and where the representation grows while mapping remains active. We evaluate EliGSiR on Replica, TUM RGB-D, ScanNet++, and real RGB-D sensor sequences, considering both the final reconstruction and the map available throughout acquisition. On TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household, EliGSiR reaches 21.52 dB with the same ground-truth mapping poses used by the controlled baselines, compared with 19.42 dB for SplaTAM. In the tracked-pose comparison, EliGSiR with live ORB-SLAM3 poses reaches 23.02 dB in 155.5 s, compared with 20.10 dB in 230.9 s for CaRtGS using its native tracker. We further evaluate reconstruction throughout acquisition and show how EliGSiR adaptive view scheduling, supervision fidelity, and geometry growth improve the use of the available mapping budget.

摘要（中文）：常规三维高斯泼溅假设观测集封闭且优化时间表较长。相比之下，持续RGB-D建图面临的问题是：新的观测在线到达，而先前重建的区域必须被保留。我们提出EliGSiR（基于证据引导与图像回放的负载自适应增量式高斯泼溅），这是一种持续式高斯建图器，能够随着重建的进展控制可用优化预算的使用方式。地图引导的视图调度根据地图当前状态过滤冗余的输入视图，并重新考虑已保留的视图。负载自适应保真度根据当前建图负载调整监督分辨率，而非遵循固定的分辨率计划。定向几何增长将深度监督与高斯生成分离，仅在重复RGB-D观测表明存在缺失或错位结构的位置增加几何容量。这些机制共同调整了哪些视图被优化、使用了多少图像细节，以及在建图持续进行期间表示在何处增长。我们在Replica、TUM RGB-D、ScanNet++以及真实RGB-D传感器序列上评估了EliGSiR，同时考虑了最终重建结果和采集过程中可用的地图。在TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household序列上，在受控基线使用相同真值建图位姿的条件下，EliGSiR达到21.52 dB，而SplaTAM为19.42 dB。在跟踪位姿对比中，使用实时ORB-SLAM3位姿的EliGSiR在155.5秒内达到23.02 dB，而使用原生跟踪器的CaRtGS在230.9秒内为20.10 dB。我们进一步评估了采集过程中的重建质量，并展示了EliGSiR的自适应视图调度、监督保真度和几何增长如何改善可用建图预算的使用。

Authors: Björn Ellensohn, Elmar Rueckert, Christian Rauch

GPT-6-Astra in a Navigation Workflow: Behavioral Analysis in Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments VLN

zero-shot VLN-CE GPT-6-Astra behavioral analysis R2R-CE navigation workflow

简要说明：本文在连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）系统中评估了GPT-6-Astra的零样本表现，在R2R-CE的50个片段中实现了52.0%的成功率，并分析了其决策过程，揭示了局部理解与自主导航之间的差距。

TLDR: This paper evaluates GPT-6-Astra in a zero-shot VLN-CE system across 50 R2R-CE episodes, reporting a 52.0% success rate and analyzing its decision-making, highlighting gaps between local understanding and autonomous navigation.

Abstract: We study GPT-6-Astra in a zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) system, where it interprets instructions, assesses its surroundings, and proposes actions. The system uses a common observation--decision--execution workflow with direct model API calls, without a packaged agent harness or navigation-specific fine-tuning. In this workflow, each request receives selected observations, execution feedback, and retained progress records. Evaluation covers the complete system, including context management and action control. We evaluate the system on 50 of the 100 R2R-CE val-unseen episodes used by Open-Nav. It achieves a success rate of 52.0\%, an SPL of 48.9\%, and an nDTW of 70.8\%. Our analysis highlights three findings. First, recorded responses link landmarks and earlier actions to instructions using observations and supplied history. Second, reviews include requests for additional views and revisions of uncertain judgments. Third, the results suggest a gap between task understanding and autonomous completion: an unfinished crossing is recognized while rotation continues. At termination, 36.0\% of episodes succeed with a workflow-accepted STOP, while another 16.0\% meet the distance criterion at the step limit. These results highlight a central challenge: translating correct local judgments into sustained progress and appropriate stopping.

摘要（中文）：我们在零样本连续环境视觉与语言导航（VLN-CE）系统中研究了GPT-6-Astra，该系统负责解析指令、评估周围环境并提议动作。该系统采用常见的观察—决策—执行工作流程，通过模型API直接调用，未使用封装的代理框架或导航专用微调。在此工作流程中，每次请求都会收到选定的观察信息、执行反馈以及保留的进度记录。评估涵盖整个系统，包括上下文管理和动作控制。我们在Open-Nav所用的100个R2R-CE未见验证集情节中选取了50个进行系统评估。该系统实现了52.0%的成功率、48.9%的SPL和70.8%的nDTW。我们的分析突出了三个发现。首先，记录的回答将地标和早期动作通过观察及提供的历史信息与指令关联起来。其次，审查过程中包括对额外视角的请求以及对不确定判断的修正。第三，结果揭示了任务理解与自主完成之间的差距：在旋转继续时，系统识别出未完成的穿越。在终止时，36.0%的情节以工作流接受的停止指令成功完成，另有16.0%的情节在步数限制内达到距离标准。这些结果凸显了一个核心挑战：将正确的局部判断转化为持续进展和适当的停止行为。

Authors: Guangzhao Dai, Qi Wu, Bin Zhu

Universal Navigation Interface: Robot-Free Data for Wheeled Robot Navigation RLRobot

data collection wheeled robot navigation human demonstrations goal-conditioned navigation closed-loop transfer

简要说明：UNI提出了一种使用助行器和智能手机的免机器人数据收集范式，通过物理约束的人类演示训练轮式机器人导航策略，在轨迹预测误差和闭环节轮式转移方面取得了良好效果。

TLDR: UNI introduces a robot-free data collection paradigm using a rollator walker and smartphone to gather physically constrained human demonstrations for training wheeled robot navigation policies, demonstrating reduced trajectory prediction error and closed-loop transfer to a powered wheelchair.

Abstract: Collecting real-world navigation data for mobile robots typically requires platform-specific teleoperation, making large-scale collection expensive and difficult to scale. We introduce Universal Navigation Interface (UNI), a robot-free data collection paradigm that uses a four-wheeled rollator walker (rollator) and smartphone to collect physically constrained human demonstrations. Because the rollator cannot climb stairs, negotiate uncut curbs, or pass through narrow gaps, demonstrations are naturally biased toward wheeled-feasible routes. Using UNI, we collect 37.2 km of real-world navigation data and recover metric trajectories that directly supervise goal-conditioned navigation models. Fine-tuning visual-navigation models on UNI reduces trajectory prediction error by 17.4-24.8% on held-out UNI demonstrations. Evaluation on other navigation datasets shows benefits that vary by dataset and metric. We further demonstrate closed-loop transfer to a powered wheelchair in curb, staircase, and curb-cut scenarios. These results support low-cost physical proxies as a practical source of navigation supervision collected without the target robot.

摘要（中文）：收集移动机器人的真实世界导航数据通常需要特定平台上的远程操作，这使得大规模数据采集成本高昂且难以扩展。我们引入了通用导航接口（UNI），一种无需机器人的数据采集范式，利用四轮助行器（rollator）和智能手机来采集受物理约束的人类示范。由于助行器无法攀爬楼梯、通过未切边的路缘石或穿过狭窄间隙，示范数据自然偏向于轮式可行路径。利用UNI，我们采集了37.2公里的真实世界导航数据，并恢复了可用于直接监督目标条件导航模型的度量轨迹。在UNI示范数据上微调视觉导航模型，可将留出集上的轨迹预测误差降低17.4%至24.8%。在其他导航数据集上的评估显示，收益因数据集和指标而异。我们进一步展示了在路缘石、楼梯和路缘切割场景中向电动轮椅的闭环迁移。这些结果支持低成本物理代理作为无需目标机器人即可采集的实用导航监督来源。

Authors: Sarvesh Prajapati, Ananya Trivedi, Lorena Maria Genua, Drake Moore, Bruce Maxwell, Taskin Padir

Mechanical Precision Weeding with a Quadruped Robot Locomotion

quadruped robot mechanical weeding autonomous weed removal milling tool precision agriculture

简要说明：本文提出了一种配备铣削工具的四足机器人（波士顿动力Spot）用于机械除草，并开发了自主操作的软件架构，在室内和室外环境中分析了其精度和效率。

TLDR: This paper presents a quadruped robot (Boston Dynamics Spot) equipped with a milling tool for mechanical weed removal, along with a software architecture for autonomous operation, and analyzes its accuracy and efficiency in indoor and outdoor settings.

Abstract: Herbicide-based weed control is increasingly unsustainable due to rising weed resistance and the adverse environmental impacts of chemical use. While mechanical weed control avoids these drawbacks, it is typically implemented using large machines that cause soil compaction. We propose a novel alternative based on small mobile robots for mechanical weeding. Compared with existing automated mechanical weeding approaches, the proposed method offers reduced soil compaction, simpler automation, and improved scalability. Our solution involves a Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped robot equipped with a custom weed removal tool featuring a milling bit at its end. The tool is rigidly attached to the robot and uses the degrees of freedom of the robot base by actuating the legs, while keeping the feet stationary. We develop a software architecture that enables autonomous weed removal and integrate this system with all other required components. We analyze the accuracy and efficiency of the current proof of concept both in an indoor and outdoor environment and provide recommendations for future work to make the system more accurate and efficient.

摘要（中文）：基于除草剂的杂草防控因杂草抗性不断增强及化学药剂使用对环境造成的不利影响而日益难以为继。尽管机械除草避免了这些弊端，但其通常采用大型机械实施，容易导致土壤板结。我们提出了一种基于小型移动机器人进行机械除草的新方案。与现有的自动化机械除草方法相比，该方法具有减少土壤压实、自动化更简单以及可扩展性更优等优势。该方案采用一台波士顿动力公司生产的Spot四足机器人，其末端配备定制除草工具，工具端部装有铣削钻头。该工具刚性连接于机器人本体，通过驱动腿部执行器利用机器人基座的自由度，同时保持足端固定不动。我们开发了一套支持自主除草的软件架构，并将该系统与所有其他必要组件集成。我们在室内和室外环境中分别对当前概念验证系统的精度和效率进行了分析，并为后续提升系统精度与效率提供了改进建议。

Authors: Ruben Beumer, Tom Janssen, René van de Molengraft, Duarte Antunes

Execution-Aware Pre-Execution Ranking for Grasp-Conditioned Robotic Placement Manipulation

grasp-conditioned placement pre-execution ranking point cloud planning success execution success

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于抓取条件机器人放置的预执行排序框架，利用类型化目标条件点云和分层头在运动规划前联合选择抓取和放置候选。在30个物体的数据集上，相较于基线，top-1成功率有所提升，并成功冻结迁移至不同的机械臂。

TLDR: This paper introduces a pre-execution ranking framework for grasp-conditioned robotic placement, using a typed target-conditioned point cloud and hierarchical heads to jointly select grasp and placement candidates before motion planning. It demonstrates improved top-1 success rates over a baseline on a 30-object dataset and successful frozen transfer to a different robot arm.

Abstract: A geometrically valid placement can still be difficult to execute because the selected grasp changes the required end-effector pose, collision geometry, and transport motion. Placement is formulated as a pre-execution ranking problem in which supplied grasp-placement candidates are scored before planning. The model combines a typed target-conditioned point cloud with three pose descriptors and hierarchical heads for planning success and execution success conditioned on planning. On a 30-object, 1,235-scene dataset with scene-group-held-out splits, three-seed top-1 success on covered test groups reaches 85.63 +/- 1.08% for joint selection and 79.84 +/- 0.16% for fixed-target ranking. For the designated frozen seed-42 checkpoint, top-1 success improves from 72.84% to 85.78% over full-pool cuMotion for joint ranking and from 59.65% to 79.67% for fixed-target ranking. Frozen transfer to xArm7/MoveIt requires no xArm-specific retraining. Across 27 locked cases, 13 complete end to end (48.15%). Of the 16 cases that pass Top-5 preflight and begin execution, 13 succeed (81.25%). Candidate-level deployment-feasibility prediction reaches 81.25% recall, 85.20% specificity, and 83.23% balanced accuracy.

摘要（中文）：一个几何上有效的放置位姿仍可能难以执行，因为所选的抓取方式会改变所需的末端执行器位姿、碰撞几何以及搬运运动。本文将放置问题建模为执行前的排序问题，在规划之前对给定的抓取-放置候选进行评分。该模型将类型化目标条件点云与三个姿态描述符以及用于规划成功和执行成功（以规划为条件）的层级头相结合。在一个包含30个物体、1,235个场景、并按场景组划分训练/测试的数据集上，三随机种子下，覆盖测试组的Top-1成功率在联合选择中达到85.63 ± 1.08%，在固定目标排序中达到79.84 ± 0.16%。对于指定的冻结seed-42检查点，联合排序的Top-1成功率从全池cuMotion的72.84%提升至85.78%，固定目标排序则从59.65%提升至79.67%。冻结模型迁移至xArm7/MoveIt无需针对xArm进行重新训练。在27个锁定案例中，13个完整端到端执行成功（48.15%）。在通过Top-5预检并开始执行的16个案例中，13个成功（81.25%）。候选级部署可行性预测的召回率达到81.25%，特异性为85.20%，平衡准确率为83.23%。

Authors: Tianyuan Liu, Rutherford Agbeshi Patamia, Benjamin Champion, Richard Dazeley, Akansel Cosgun

Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software RLRobot

closed-loop policy learning coding agents policy code generation simulation feedback RoboCasa

简要说明：本文提出将完整的闭环机器人策略实现视为可复用的执行经验，通过编码智能体从演示中生成并优化代码，并将最佳版本存档以迁移到新任务。在RoboCasa中的实验表明，优化后的存档代码比初始代码平均成功率提高15.6个百分点，展示了执行改进软件对于新策略获取的价值。

TLDR: This paper proposes treating complete closed-loop robot policy implementations as reusable execution experience, where a coding agent generates and optimizes code from demonstrations and archives the best versions for transfer to new tasks. Experiments in RoboCasa show optimized archived code improves success by 15.6 percentage points over initial code, demonstrating the value of execution-improved software for policy acquisition.

Abstract: Closed-loop robot policies require observation processing, state management, and situation-dependent branching, making them costly to design and tune manually. Although coding agents increasingly support control-code generation and optimization, it remains unclear whether implementations improved on source tasks also support policy acquisition for new tasks. We study this question by treating complete closed-loop implementations as reusable execution experience. For each source task, a coding agent generates policy code from a few successful demonstrations and iteratively improves it using simulation feedback. The validation-selected implementations are retained in a software archive. For new tasks, the agent generates and improves policies using archived implementations, target demonstrations, and execution feedback. The resulting policy is then frozen and executes without further model calls. Across four source tasks in RoboCasa, iterative optimization increases mean success from 28.3% to 64.2%. Across nine target tasks and three independent runs, mean success is 45.2% without references, 41.5% with initial source code, and 57.0% with optimized source code. Optimized references outperform initial references in all three runs on the nine-task average, with a mean gain of 15.6 percentage points. These results demonstrate the value of execution-improved software as a resource for acquiring new policies in this setting, although initial references remain better on two target tasks when averaged across runs.

摘要（中文）：闭环机器人策略需要观测处理、状态管理以及依赖情境的分支决策，这使得其设计和手动调优成本高昂。尽管编码代理在控制代码生成与优化方面的支持日益增强，但源任务上的改进实现是否也能支持新任务的策略习得，仍不明确。本研究将完整的闭环实现视为可复用的执行经验来探讨这一问题。对于每个源任务，编码代理基于少量成功演示生成策略代码，并利用仿真反馈进行迭代优化。经验证选中的实现被存入软件档案库。对于新任务，代理利用档案中的实现、目标演示及执行反馈来生成并改进策略。最终所得策略被冻结并执行，此过程中不再调用模型。在RoboCasa的四个源任务上，迭代优化使平均成功率从28.3%提升至64.2%。在九个目标任务及三次独立运行中，无参考时平均成功率为45.2%，使用初始源代码时为41.5%，使用优化后源代码时为57.0%。在九任务平均上，优化参考在所有三次运行中均优于初始参考，平均提升15.6个百分点。这些结果表明，在所述情境下，经执行改进的软件作为获取新策略的资源具有重要价值，尽管在跨运行平均下，初始参考在两个目标任务上仍表现更优。

Authors: So Kuroki, Yujin Tang

GR2PO: Group Relative Return Policy Optimization for Continuous Robot Control RLRobot

critic-free reinforcement learning group relative return policy optimization continuous robot control edge deployment policy optimization

简要说明：本文提出了GR2PO，一种用于连续机器人控制的无需评论家的强化学习框架，通过从并行轨迹中估计折扣回报并进行组归一化，改进了基于即时奖励的策略优化。它优于无评论家基线，与演员-评论家方法相当，并展示了在边缘设备上的部署。

TLDR: This paper introduces GR2PO, a critic-free reinforcement learning framework for continuous robot control that estimates discounted returns from parallel trajectories and applies group normalization to improve policy optimization over immediate-reward baselines. It outperforms critic-free baselines, competes with actor-critic methods, and demonstrates deployment on an edge device (NVIDIA Jetson TX2).

Abstract: Actor-critic architecture has been widely used in continuous robot control. However, they rely on learning a value network, introducing additional computational overhead during training. Moreover, policy learning may also be affected by the approximation error of value estimation. Critic-free group relative policy optimization methods provide a simpler training approach by removing the need for a critic. However, they fail to learn long-term action outcomes when directly applying immediate rewards to policy optimization in dense-reward environments. To address these problems, we propose Group Relative Return Policy Optimization (GR2PO), a critic-free reinforcement learning framework for continuous robot control. GR2PO estimates the discounted returns from the parallelly collected trajectories, performs group normalization at each rollout time index, and uses relative advantages and clipped targets to update the policy. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, we instantiate it on robot control simulation environments and deploy the model to a real-world edge device. The results show that GR2PO significantly outperforms critic-free baselines that use immediate rewards and performs competitively against state-of-the-art actor-critic methods. Furthermore, GR2PO demonstrates competitive training efficiency. Inference tests on NVIDIA Jetson TX2 demonstrate the feasibility of deploying the learned policies on edge platforms. Further ablation experiments analyze the effects of parallel group size, return estimation methods, and target clipping ratio on learning performance. To support follow-up research, we will make the complete code publicly available after the paper is accepted, including the framework implementation, experimental configuration, and training and evaluation scripts.

摘要（中文）：演员-评论家架构已广泛用于连续机器人控制中。然而，这类方法依赖于学习一个价值网络，从而在训练过程中引入了额外的计算开销。此外，策略学习也可能受到价值估计近似误差的影响。无评论家的群体相对策略优化方法通过去除评论家网络，提供了一种更简单的训练途径。然而，在密集奖励环境中直接将即时奖励应用于策略优化时，这类方法无法学习到长期动作效果。为解决这些问题，我们提出了群体相对回报策略优化（GR2PO），一种面向连续机器人控制的无评论家强化学习框架。GR2PO从并行采集的轨迹中估计折扣回报，在每个 rollout 时间索引处进行群体归一化，并使用相对优势与裁剪目标来更新策略。为评估所提框架的有效性，我们在机器人控制仿真环境中对其进行了实例化，并将模型部署到真实边缘设备上。结果表明，GR2PO显著优于使用即时奖励的无评论家基线方法，并与最先进的演员-评论家方法性能相当。此外，GR2PO展现出具有竞争力的训练效率。在 NVIDIA Jetson TX2 上的推理测试证明了将所学策略部署到边缘平台的可行性。进一步的消融实验分析了并行群体规模、回报估计方法和目标裁剪比率对学习性能的影响。为支持后续研究，论文被接收后我们将公开完整代码，包括框架实现、实验配置以及训练和评估脚本。

Authors: Pengqin Wang, Qiming Zhang, Shaojie Shen, Jun Ma

Improving Cross-embodiment Transfer in Latent Action Models with Action-Similarity Supervision VLA

latent action models cross-embodiment transfer action-similarity supervision bimanual manipulation

简要说明：本文提出基于动作相似性监督的隐式动作模型（LAM），通过将隐式动作的相似性与末端执行器运动的相似性对齐，在双臂机器人跨本体迁移中使成功率翻倍。

TLDR: This paper introduces action-similarity supervision for latent action models (LAMs) to improve cross-embodiment transfer in robot manipulation, showing that aligning latent action similarities with end-effector motion similarities doubles success on disjoint bimanual tasks.

Abstract: As generalist robot policies gain vision and language from web-scale pretraining, demonstrations remain costly to collect and tied to the robot that recorded them. Latent action models (LAMs) address both by learning latent actions from action-free videos that can be shared across embodiments, however, in practice, LAMs are sensitive to background visual noise, and the same motion from two different robots may be encoded with different latents. One solution to the background visual noise is to add an auxiliary loss predicting the robot action from the latent action, further associating the latent action space to the embodiment specific robot action space. We study a different use of the same labels, through action-similarity supervision. The similarity between any two latent actions is trained to match the similarity of the two ground-truth robot action sequences. The ground-truth actions are never predicted by the LAM, so the latent action does not need to encode embodiment specifics. We evaluate cross-embodiment transfer on RoboTwin 2.0 in a controlled setup, two bimanual robots demonstrate disjoint task sets, a policy is trained on all the demonstrations, and each robot is evaluated closed-loop on the tasks only the other demonstrated. With the policy architecture and its hyperparameters, the dataset, and the evaluation protocol fixed, predicting latent actions instead of ground-truth actions more than doubles cross-embodiment success. Given the same ground-truth actions, similarity supervision transfers better than an auxiliary loss that predicts the ground-truth action during the LAM training. Computing the similarities on end-effector motion rather than joint-space motion, and letting the loss compare latent actions across the two robots, gives the best approach of the study.

摘要（中文）：摘要：随着通用机器人策略从网络规模的预训练中获取视觉和语言能力，演示数据的收集仍然成本高昂，且受限于采集数据的机器人本体。潜动作模型（LAMs）通过从无需动作标注的视频中学习潜动作，并在不同机器人实体间共享这些动作来解决上述两个问题。然而，在实践中，LAMs对背景视觉噪声较为敏感，且两台不同机器人执行相同运动时可能被编码为不同的潜变量。针对背景视觉噪声的一种解决方案是添加辅助损失函数，利用潜动作预测机器人实际动作，从而将潜动作空间与特定机器人实体的动作空间关联起来。我们研究了利用相同标注的另一条路径——通过动作相似性监督。任意两个潜动作之间的相似度被训练为与对应的两条真实机器人动作序列的相似度相匹配。由于LAMs从不直接预测真实动作，潜动作无需编码机器人实体特有的信息。我们在RoboTwin 2.0上进行了受控条件下的跨实体迁移评估：两台双臂机器人分别演示互不重叠的任务集，策略在全部演示数据上训练，每台机器人仅在另一台所演示的任务上进行闭环评估。在策略架构、超参数、数据集和评估协议均固定的前提下，预测潜动作相比预测真实动作使跨实体成功率提升了一倍以上。在给定相同真实动作的条件下，相似性监督相比在LAM训练过程中额外预测真实动作的辅助损失具有更好的迁移效果。基于末端执行器运动而非关节空间运动计算相似度，并让损失函数对两台机器人的潜动作进行跨实体比较，是本研究中最优的方案。

Authors: Maxime Alvarez, Renzo Caballero, Tatsuya Matsushima, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo

TADreamer: Zero-Shot Language-Guided 3D Navigation for Terrestrial-Aerial Bimodal Robots via Video Imagination Locomotion

bimodal robot navigation zero-shot video imagination VLM geometric calibration

简要说明：TADreamer 是一种零样本框架，用于地空双模态机器人的语言引导 3D 导航。它利用视觉语言模型生成和选择视频，然后根据实测几何进行校准，以产生度规一致的航点和运动模式，用于真实世界导航。

TLDR: TADreamer is a zero-shot framework for language-guided 3D navigation of terrestrial-aerial bimodal robots. It uses vision-language models to generate and select videos, then calibrates them against measured geometry to produce metrically consistent waypoints and locomotion modes for real-world navigation.

Abstract: Language-guided navigation for terrestrial-aerial bimodal robots requires selecting routes and locomotion modes that match scene context and task intent. Generated videos can represent such motion sequences, but recovering metrically consistent navigation references from them is challenging because of scale ambiguity and axis-dependent geometric distortions. We present TADreamer, a zero-shot framework that grounds video-imagined navigation in measured geometry without task-specific training or fine-tuning. A vision-language model translates onboard observations and instructions into navigation prompts, selects valid generated videos, and provides corrective feedback when regeneration is needed. The selected video is reconstructed into 3D waypoints annotated with terrestrial or aerial modes. A two-stage calibration procedure uses field-of-view constraints to initialize scale estimation, then refines axis-dependent scales, rotation, and translation by registering the reconstructed point cloud to measured geometry. The calibrated waypoints and mode labels guide a planner that incorporates measured geometry for robot execution. Real-world experiments demonstrate navigation across seven indoor and outdoor scenarios. With five candidates per round, usable videos are obtained within two rounds in all seven scenarios. On the calibration observations, our method reduces mean absolute depth error by 87.7% and mean absolute relative depth error by 86.3% compared with NavDreamer.

摘要（中文）：语言引导的陆空双模态机器人导航需要选择与场景情境和任务意图相匹配的路线及运动模式。生成的视频能够表征此类运动序列，但由于尺度模糊性和轴相关的几何畸变，从中恢复度量一致的导航参考信息颇具挑战。我们提出TADreamer，一种零样本框架，无需任务专属训练或微调即可在实测几何中落地视频想象的导航方案。视觉语言模型将机载观测与指令转化为导航提示，筛选有效的生成视频，并在需重新生成时提供修正反馈。选定的视频被重建为带有陆空模态标注的三维航点。两阶段标定流程利用视场角约束初始化尺度估计，然后通过将重建点云配准至实测几何，精细化轴相关尺度、旋转和平移。标定后的航点与模态标签引导结合实测几何的规划器，以执行机器人任务。真实世界实验展示了在七个室内外场景中的导航能力。在每轮生成五个候选视频的条件下，全部七个场景均能在两轮内获得可用视频。在标定观测上，与NavDreamer相比，本方法将平均绝对深度误差降低了87.7%，平均绝对相对深度误差降低了86.3%。

Authors: Xiangyu Li, Tiancheng Lai, Xijie Huang, Ruitian Pang, Siqi Shen, Juncheng Chen, Zaisheng Pan, Chao Xu, Fei Gao, Yanjun Cao

Vehicle Trajectory Prediction via Neural Fusion of Multiple EKF-Based Trajectory Candidates AutonomousDriving

trajectory prediction EKF neural fusion nuScenes Trajectron++

简要说明：本文通过将Trajectron++神经轨迹预测器的输出与多个基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的轨迹候选进行融合，在nuScenes数据集上分别将平均位移误差（ADE）和最终位移误差（FDE）降低了13.7%和14.6%。

TLDR: This paper improves the Trajectron++ neural trajectory predictor by fusing its output with multiple EKF-based trajectory candidates, reducing ADE and FDE on nuScenes by 13.7% and 14.6%, respectively.

Abstract: Predicting the future trajectories of surrounding vehicles in autonomous driving is important for collision risk assessment and safe ego-vehicle path planning. Conventional neural network-based trajectory predictors typically achieve strong prediction performance by exploiting agent history, dynamic scene graphs, and semantic maps. However, in specific motion regimes such as acceleration, deceleration, and turning, these predictors may fail to reflect physically feasible trajectories. To address this issue, this study proposes a framework that fuses the output of Trajectron++, a neural network-based trajectory predictor, with extended Kalman filter (EKF)-based multiple trajectory candidates at a late stage. On the nuScenes dataset, the proposed method reduces the average displacement error and final displacement error of the Trajectron++ robot baseline by 13.7% and 14.6%, respectively, without modifying the baseline architecture. These results indicate that EKF-based trajectory candidates can effectively complement neural trajectory prediction through learned fusion.

摘要（中文）：预测自动驾驶中周围车辆的未來轨迹对于碰撞风险评估和安全自车路径规划至关重要。传统的基于神经网络的轨迹预测器通常通过利用智能体历史信息、动态场景图和语义地图来实现强大的预测性能。然而，在加速、减速和转弯等特定运动模式下，这些预测器可能无法反映物理上可行的轨迹。为解决这一问题，本研究提出了一种框架，在后期阶段将基于神经网络的轨迹预测器Trajectron++的输出与基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的多条轨迹候选相融合。在nuScenes数据集上，所提出的方法在不修改基线架构的情况下，将Trajectron++机器人基线的平均位移误差和最终位移误差分别降低了13.7%和14.6%。这些结果表明，基于EKF的轨迹候选可以通过学习融合有效补充神经轨迹预测。

Authors: Seong-Jun Kim, Seung-Hyun Kong

HEROIC: Heterogeneous Evidential Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Identification and Cross-Robot Collaboration Other

Heterogeneous air-ground robots Open-vocabulary search Evidential reasoning Natural language communication Decentralized coordination

简要说明：HEROIC是一个去中心化的多智能体开放词汇搜索框架，空中与地面异构机器人仅通过自然语言通信，基于证据推理和安全飞行约束动态重新分配任务并协作识别目标。在全栈仿真实验中显著优于基线方法。

TLDR: HEROIC is a decentralized multi-agent open-vocabulary search framework where heterogeneous air-ground robots communicate in natural language, dynamically re-task based on evidential reasoning and safe-flight constraints, and coordinate to identify targets. It significantly outperforms baseline methods in simulated full-stack experiments.

Abstract: Multi-agent heterogeneous air-ground robot teams are attractive for open world search, with applications for reconnaissance, urban search and rescue missions (USAR), disaster response and recovery, and hazardous environments. These two platforms have different failure modes: aerial robots cover ground quickly but cannot resolve small or occluded targets from altitude, while ground robots can identify objects-of-interest, such as people or hazardous objects, at close range but cover less area. Existing language-tasked teams either have roles fixed prior, or have a language model assign them from hand-written capability tags, so the team is unable to know when within a mission an asset is no longer useful. We present HEROIC, a decentralized heterogeneous multi-agent open-vocabulary search coordination framework that requires agents to communicate in natural language only. HEROIC's initial agent role assignment is derived from sensor properties and a scale law to determine whether targets can be detected with a high confidence. From the mission's natural language prompt alone, this law assigns aerial flight altitudes and sweep spacing. When this calculated height falls below the altitude for safe flight, aerial agents re-task themselves from searcher to aerial triage, escort, and route guide for ground agents. Both robots maintain an evidential belief over the search area (bearing rays for positive evidence, a log-odds posterior for negative evidence) and gate any arrival on close-range verification. In full-stack experiments, HEROIC reaches the target 84% of the time across all 6 scenes, compares to 35-54% for vision-language frontier baselines, frontier-based search, lawnmower, and random-walk running the same perception, all while being 2-4x sooner to arrive at the target.

摘要（中文）：多智能体异构空中-地面机器人团队在开放世界搜索任务中具有吸引力，可应用于侦察、城市搜索与救援任务（USAR）、灾害响应与恢复以及危险环境。这两种平台具有不同的失效模式：空中机器人能够快速覆盖地面，但无法从高空分辨小型或被遮挡的目标，而地面机器人能够在近距离识别感兴趣物体（如人员或危险物品），但覆盖面积较小。现有的基于语言任务分配的团队要么事先固定角色，要么由语言模型根据手工编写的能力标签进行角色分配，因此团队无法在任务过程中判断某一装备何时不再有用。我们提出了HEROIC，一种去中心化的异构多智能体开放词汇搜索协调框架，要求智能体仅通过自然语言进行通信。HEROIC的初始智能体角色分配基于传感器属性和尺度定律来确定目标是否能够以高置信度被检测到。仅依据任务的自然语言提示，该定律即可分配飞行高度和扫描间距。当计算出的高度低于安全飞行高度时，空中智能体将自身角色从搜索者重新分配为空中分诊、护航和地面智能体的路线引导者。两种机器人在搜索区域内维护一种证据信念（正证据采用方位射线，负证据采用对数几率后验），并对近距离验证的任何到达进行门控。在全栈实验中，HEROIC在所有6个场景中84%的情况下能够到达目标，而视觉-语言前沿基线、基于前沿的搜索、割草机式搜索和随机行走在相同感知条件下仅有35%-54%的成功率，同时HEROIC到达目标的时间缩短2-4倍。

Authors: Mihir Chauhan, Aarav Jain, Addison Zucek, Manmeet Dang, Damon Conover, Aniket Bera

Affective Shared Autonomy: Temporal Affect Dynamics and Subjective Evaluation in Bimanual Teleoperation Tasks Manipulation

shared autonomy teleoperation affective computing multimodal fusion human-robot interaction

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于双臂遥操作的情感感知共享自主框架，通过多模态信号估计操作员情感状态并动态调整机器人辅助，实验表明可有效增加操作员的生产状态。

TLDR: This paper introduces an affect-aware shared autonomy framework for bimanual teleoperation that estimates operator affective states from multimodal signals and dynamically modulates robotic assistance, demonstrating increased productive states in a user study.

Abstract: Physical teleoperation integrates human cognitive flexibility with robotic precision, yet demanding manipulation tasks frequently induce severe cognitive workload, acute frustration, and execution breakdown. Conventional shared autonomy paradigms rely primarily on task-based rules, such as spatial error boundaries, which disregard the operator's transient affective state and risk misaligned control interventions. To address this limitation, we propose an affect-aware shared autonomy teleoperation framework that dynamically modulates robotic assistance based on real-time operator state estimation. The system estimates operator affective states from synchronized facial video, cardiac signals, and bilateral arm kinematics, outputting a seven-state affective distribution and a three-category operational abstraction (neutral, productive, adverse). Affect-aware assistance is selectively triggered when the user is detected in a continuous adverse state, preserving task-positive engagement without unnecessary disruption. The empirical user study ($N = 30$) confirms that the proposed affective assistance increases the productive states by up to 39.7% without compromising user agency. The collected dataset represents the first multimodal dataset that provides continuous visual, physiological, and operator's bilateral motion tracking of temporal affective state shifts during bimanual teleoperation. Our multimodal fusion model outperforms zero-shot baselines (Qwen, MiniCPM-V) in tracking temporal state dynamics. This real-world deployment offers a new human-centric framework that integrates visual, physiological, and motion tracking for physical human-robot interaction.

摘要（中文）：物理遥操作将人类认知灵活性与机器人精度相结合，然而高要求的操作任务常常引发严重的认知负荷、急性挫败感以及执行中断。传统共享自主范式主要依赖基于任务的规则（如空间误差边界），这些规则忽视了操作者瞬时的情感状态，可能导致控制干预不匹配。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种情感感知的共享自主遥操作框架，该框架基于实时操作者状态估计动态调节机器人辅助水平。系统通过同步面部视频、心脏信号及双臂运动学数据估计操作者的情感状态，输出七状态情感分布及三分类操作抽象（中性、积极、不利）。当检测到用户处于持续不利状态时，情感感知辅助被选择性地触发，从而在不造成不必要干扰的前提下保持任务正向参与度。实证用户研究（$N = 30$）证实，所提出的情感辅助机制在不损害用户自主性的情况下，将积极状态比例最高提升39.7%。所采集的数据集是首个提供双手遥操作过程中连续视觉、生理及操作者双侧运动追踪的时序情感状态变化的多模态数据集。我们的多模态融合模型在追踪时序状态动态方面优于零样本基线模型（Qwen、MiniCPM-V）。该实际部署为物理人机交互提供了一种以人为中心的新框架，整合了视觉、生理及运动追踪技术。

Authors: Zhengji Liang, Guiyin Tian, Sijin Qu, Hainan Liu, Shiyan Hu

VAST: V2X/Dynamic Map-Aware Autonomous Driving Systems Validation Toolchain AutonomousDriving

V2X Dynamic Map co-simulation edge-case discovery Autoware

简要说明：VAST是一个用于协同自动驾驶的验证工具链，集成了Scenic、SS2、AWSIM、Autoware和SIM-LDM，支持V2X/动态地图感知测试，显著提高了遮挡十字路口中的边缘案例发现率并降低了碰撞率。

TLDR: VAST is a validation toolchain for cooperative autonomous driving that integrates Scenic, SS2, AWSIM, Autoware, and SIM-LDM to enable V2X/Dynamic Map-aware testing, significantly improving edge-case discovery and reducing collision rates in occluded intersections.

Abstract: Cooperative autonomous driving in the IoT-to-Edge-to-Cloud continuum requires system-level validation across vehicles, infrastructure sensors, edge-side Dynamic Map services, and in-vehicle autonomous-driving stacks. This paper presents VAST, a V2X/Dynamic Map-aware validation toolchain that connects Scenic, Scenario Simulator v2, AWSIM, Autoware, and SIM-LDM. VAST does not introduce a new search algorithm; instead, it addresses interoperability challenges, including Lanelet2-to-Scenic mapping, ROS 2-based co-simulation through SS2, Dynamic Map object injection into Autoware, and collection of TTC, PET, collision, timeout, and performance measurements. In occluded-intersection scenarios, Lanelet2-compatible constrained sampling increases the edge-case discovery rate from 40.0% to 80.0% and reduces the average time per discovered edge case from 259.7 s to 110.4 s. Under the same generated scenario distribution, Dynamic Map availability reduces the collision rate from 78.0% to 40.0% and increases non-collision outcomes from 22.0% to 60.0%, with statistically significant TTC/PET shifts. A throughput study with 1-16 NPCs shows that sampling remains below 0.1 s, whereas AWSIM/Autoware execution and restart overhead dominate runtime. These results position VAST as a practical validation infrastructure for cooperative autonomous-driving CPSs.

摘要（中文）：在物联网-边缘-云连续体中实现协同自动驾驶，需要在车辆、基础设施传感器、边缘侧动态地图服务以及车载自动驾驶栈之间进行系统级验证。本文介绍了VAST，一种支持V2X/动态地图的验证工具链，它连接了Scenic、Scenario Simulator v2、AWSIM、Autoware和SIM-LDM。VAST并未引入新的搜索算法，而是解决了互操作性挑战，包括Lanelet2到Scenic的映射、通过SS2进行的基于ROS 2的协同仿真、向Autoware注入动态地图对象，以及收集TTC、PET、碰撞、超时和性能指标。在遮挡交叉口场景中，兼容Lanelet2的约束采样将边缘案例发现率从40.0%提升至80.0%，并将每个发现边缘案例的平均时间从259.7秒减少至110.4秒。在相同生成场景分布下，动态地图的可用性将碰撞率从78.0%降低至40.0%，非碰撞结果从22.0%提升至60.0%，且TTC/PET的变化具有统计显著性。针对1至16个NPC的吞吐量研究表明，采样时间保持在0.1秒以下，而AWSIM/Autoware的执行与重启开销主导了运行时。这些结果使VAST成为协同自动驾驶信息物理系统（CPS）的实用验证基础设施。

Authors: Shunsuke Ito, Takuya Azumi

Runtime Safety Filtering for Two-Terminal Hazards in Robotic Battery Recycling Manipulation

runtime safety filtering VLA policies two-terminal hazard safety-utility trade-off fallback strategy

简要说明：本文针对机器人电池回收中的双端子危险，使用冻结的OpenVLA策略分析运行时安全过滤器，发现回退策略和边际选择对安全-效用权衡的影响大于谓词结构。

TLDR: This paper analyzes runtime safety filters for two-terminal hazards in robotic battery recycling with frozen OpenVLA policies, finding that fallback strategy and margin selection outweigh predicate structure in the safety-utility trade-off.

Abstract: Runtime safety filters for learned manipulation policies typically define unsafe states as unions of object-wise keep-out regions. This representation can be unnecessarily restrictive for hazards that depend on a joint spatial relation, such as battery recycling, where a conductive payload can short a charged cell only when it approaches both terminals simultaneously. We study runtime filtering for this two-terminal hazard in LIBERO using frozen OpenVLA policies. We factor a runtime filter into three design choices: the predicate structure, its geometric margin, and the fallback action applied when a commanded action is rejected. We compare a conjunctive predicate, a conventional two-site keep-out, and a composite of the two. For each predicate, we vary its margin to obtain a frontier between task success and residual hazard. We then compare four fallback strategies at matched operating points: holding, retreat, sampled search, and a continuous-action barrier projection. Across three workcells, the three predicate families trace nearly identical safety--utility frontiers once each is evaluated over its own margin. In contrast, the fallback strategy has a substantially larger effect: holding reduces task success by up to 0.302 relative to retreat without reducing hazard, while both minimally invasive fallbacks leave substantially more residual hazard. This ordering transfers to a second policy and task suite, while retreat-based filtering remains effective under standing errors in the clearances available to the filter, although correlated error in the estimated payload size is more damaging than larger independent errors in terminal position. These results show that, for proximity-defined manipulation hazards, margin selection and fallback strategy can matter more than predicate structure in determining the safety--utility trade-off of a runtime filter.

摘要（中文）：运行时安全过滤器通常将不安全状态定义为物体级禁入区域的并集。然而，对于依赖于联合空间关系的危险，这种表示可能过于严格。以电池回收为例，导电载荷只有在同时接近充电电池的两个端子时才会造成短路。我们利用冻结的OpenVLA策略，针对LIBERO中的双端子危险研究运行时过滤问题。我们将运行时过滤器拆分为三个设计选择：谓词结构、几何裕度以及当指令动作被拒绝时所采用的备用动作。我们比较了合取谓词、传统的双位点禁入区域以及两者的组合。对于每种谓词，我们通过改变其裕度来获取任务成功率与残余危险之间的权衡边界。随后，我们在匹配的操作点上比较了四种备用策略：保持、撤退、采样搜索以及连续动作屏障投影。在三个工作单元中，三种谓词族在各自裕度范围内评估时，其安全-效用边界几乎一致。相比之下，备用策略的影响显著更大：保持相对于撤退将任务成功率降低了最多0.302，且并未降低危险；而两种最小干预的备用策略则留下了显著更多的残余危险。这一排序同样适用于第二种策略和任务套件。此外，在过滤器可获取的净距存在恒定误差的情况下，基于撤退的过滤仍然有效，但估计载荷尺寸的相关误差比端子位置更大的独立误差更具破坏性。这些结果表明，对于由接近关系定义的操控危险，在决定运行时过滤器的安全-效用权衡时，裕度选择和备用策略可能比谓词结构更为关键。

Authors: Yuxin Cao, Wei Song, Xianglin Yang, Fusen Guo, Lin Li, Xiao Cheng, Jin Song Dong

Selective Cotton Boll Localization for Robotic Harvesting: Evaluation of Deep Learning Vision Models Under Field Conditions Manipulation

cotton boll detection YOLOv12-m-seg robotic harvesting field conditions instance segmentation

简要说明：本文评估了深度学习视觉模型（YOLO变体、SAM等）在田间条件下对棉铃检测和分割的性能，并通过UR5e机械臂的实际采摘实验验证了YOLOv12-m-seg模型的有效性。

TLDR: This paper evaluates deep learning vision models (YOLO variants, SAM, etc.) for cotton boll detection and segmentation in field conditions, and validates a YOLOv12-m-seg model in real robotic harvesting experiments with a UR5e manipulator.

Abstract: This study developed and evaluated a deep-learning-based perception framework for selective robotic cotton picking. The dataset contained 1,008 annotated field images collected using three cameras under varying natural lighting and weather conditions. Object-detection models from the YOLOv8 through YOLOv13 families were evaluated using their default configurations, while segmentation performance was assessed using YOLOv8-seg, YOLOv11-seg, YOLOv12-seg, the Segment Anything Model (SAM), SAMv2.1, FastSAM, and Grounded-SAM with the Recognize Anything Model (RAM). Among the detection models, GELAN-s achieved the most favorable balance between mean average precision (mAP) and inference speed, obtaining an mAP of 86.1%, precision of 81.6%, recall of 76.6%, and an F1-score of 79.0%, with an average inference time of 42.3 ms per image. Among the direct segmentation models, YOLOv12-m-seg provided the most favorable balance between AP@0.5 and FPS, achieving a segmentation AP@0.5 of 83.7% with an inference time of 20.4 ms per image. In the detection-prompted segmentation approach, bounding-box prompts generated by GELAN-s improved the localization of cotton bolls for SAM and SAMv2.1, while SAMv2.1 Tiny consistently outperformed FastSAM and Grounded-SAM with RAM. In the area-based evaluation against manually annotated segmentation masks, YOLOv12-m-seg achieved an $R^2$ value of 0.966, compared with 0.860 for GELAN-s + SAMv2.1 Tiny. Field experiments conducted using a UR5e robotic manipulator, a custom end-effector, and a ZED2i stereo camera further validated the effectiveness of the YOLOv12-m-seg model for real-time cotton boll detection, segmentation, and selective picking under varying confidence levels. These results demonstrate that YOLOv12-m-seg provides an efficient perception model for robotic cotton harvesting and has strong potential for field deployment.

摘要（中文）：本研究开发并评估了一种基于深度学习的感知框架，用于选择性机器人棉花采摘。数据集包含1,008张标注田间图像，这些图像使用三台相机在不同自然光照和天气条件下采集。评估了YOLOv8至YOLOv13系列的目标检测模型（使用其默认配置），同时使用YOLOv8-seg、YOLOv11-seg、YOLOv12-seg、Segment Anything Model (SAM)、SAMv2.1、FastSAM以及结合Recognize Anything Model (RAM)的Grounded-SAM评估了分割性能。在检测模型中，GELAN-s在平均精度均值（mAP）与推理速度之间取得了最优平衡，其mAP达到86.1%，精确率为81.6%，召回率为76.6%，F1分数为79.0%，平均推理时间为每幅图像42.3毫秒。在直接分割模型中，YOLOv12-m-seg在AP@0.5与FPS之间提供了最优平衡，实现了83.7%的分割AP@0.5，推理时间为每幅图像20.4毫秒。在检测提示分割方法中，由GELAN-s生成的边界框提示改善了SAM和SAMv2.1对棉铃的定位能力，而SAMv2.1 Tiny始终优于FastSAM和结合RAM的Grounded-SAM。在与人工标注分割掩膜的基于面积的评估中，YOLOv12-m-seg取得了0.966的$R^2$值，而GELAN-s + SAMv2.1 Tiny为0.860。使用UR5e机器人操纵臂、定制末端执行器和ZED2i立体相机进行的田间实验进一步验证了YOLOv12-m-seg模型在不同置信度水平下实时棉铃检测、分割和选择性采摘的有效性。这些结果表明，YOLOv12-m-seg为机器人棉花收获提供了一种高效的感知模型，并具有强大的田间部署潜力。

Authors: Thevathayarajh Thayananthan, Xin Zhang, Isuru Laddusinghe Badu, Jonathan Harjono, Glen C. Rains, Beiwen Li, Leonardo M. Bastos, Nuwan K. Wijewardane, Vitor S. Martins

Quantifying Mechanical Intelligence in Legged Robots with Information Theory Locomotion

mechanical intelligence legged robots information theory series-elastic actuation embodied computation

简要说明：本文提出用信息论指标量化腿足机器人的机械智能，通过线性模型、单腿仿真和四足机器人学习策略仿真，展示了串联弹性驱动与本体感受驱动对控制负担的影响。

TLDR: The paper introduces information-theoretic metrics to quantify mechanical intelligence in legged robots, demonstrating how body dynamics and actuation mechanisms (series-elastic vs. proprioceptive) affect control burden through simulations of increasing complexity, including learned policies on simulated quadrupeds.

Abstract: Mechanical intelligence, loosely defined as the reduction in control burden afforded by a robot's physical form, has become a prominent concept in robotics, with instantiations in bioinspired robotics, soft robotics, robotic swarms, and many other areas. However, rigorous theoretical understanding and quantitative measures of mechanical intelligence have lagged behind the engineering systems that the community has developed. In this work, using modern legged robots as a benchmark and exemplar, we propose several information-theoretic metrics for quantifying mechanical intelligence. By viewing body dynamics as both a computational process and a communication channel, we show that several prior insights in legged-robot engineering can be described using information theory, and we quantify how bits are processed by mechanical modes and across robot coordinates. Specifically, we examine the trade-off between explicitly incorporating compliance through series-elastic actuation and using so-called proprioceptive, low-gear-ratio transmissions, and we explore how these mechanisms interact with control policies during locomotion. We develop these results on systems of increasing complexity: a simplified linear model of a robot-leg transmission, a nonlinear single-leg simulation, and simulated quadruped robots controlled by a learned policy while navigating challenging terrain. These results lay the groundwork for broader study of robot mechanisms and their role in embodied computation.

摘要（中文）：机械智能，宽泛定义为机器人的物理形态所赋予的控制负担减少，已成为机器人学中的一个重要概念，其在仿生机器人、软体机器人、机器人集群及众多其他领域均有实例体现。然而，对机械智能的严格理论理解和定量度量却落后于该社区已开发的工程系统。在本工作中，以现代腿式机器人为基准和范例，我们提出了若干用于量化机械智能的信息论度量指标。通过将机体动力学视为一种计算过程和通信通道，我们展示了腿式机器人工程中若干先前见解可借助信息论加以描述，并量化了机械模态及机器人坐标间信息比特的处理方式。具体而言，我们考察了通过串联弹性驱动显式引入柔顺性与采用所谓本体感觉式低减速比传动之间的权衡，并探讨了这些机制在运动过程中如何与控制策略相互作用。我们在复杂度递进的系统上发展了这些结果：机器人腿传动的简化线性模型、非线性单腿仿真，以及在学习策略控制下穿越挑战性地形的四足机器人仿真。这些结果为机器人机构及其在具身计算中作用的更广泛研究奠定了基础。

Authors: Zach J. Patterson

OmniCalib: Target-Free, Task-Structured Self-Calibration for Humanoid Robots HumanoidEmbodied

calibration humanoid robot joint zero offset camera extrinsic target-free

简要说明：OmniCalib是一种针对人形机器人的无靶标、任务结构化标定流程，仅利用机器人自身运动与机载传感来标定关节零位与相机外参，并在手臂、腿部、头部及胸部/腕部相机上得到验证。

TLDR: OmniCalib is a target-free, task-structured calibration workflow for humanoid robots that calibrates joint zeros and camera extrinsics using only robot-native motion and onboard sensing, validated on full upper/lower limbs, head rig, and chest/wrist cameras.

Abstract: Assembly, wear, and component replacement perturb the sensor extrinsics and joint zeros encoded by a humanoid CAD model. Existing procedures calibrate one sensor pair or require external fiducials. Using only robot-native motion and onboard sensing, we present OmniCalib, a target-free workflow that calibrates the full upper limbs---all 14 arm joint zeros and the extrinsics of both wrist and chest cameras---as well as lower limbs and the multi-camera head rig. Each module matches a robot-native task to a parameter block, checks observability, and writes only supported corrections to the CAD model. Our depth ICP method recovers all 14 arm joint zeros and calibrates all RGB-D camera extrinsics without any calibration target. Relative to CAD, the estimated extrinsic corrections are 10.56 mm and 1.74 degrees for the left wrist, 6.33 mm and 1.25 degrees for the right wrist, and 9.81 mm and 0.929 degrees for the chest RGB-D camera. ICP point-to-plane residual is 2.09 mm. On the same injected offsets, ICP and ArUco recover all 14 joint zeros below the 0.1-degree encoder-resolution reference. On an AGIBOT A3 Ultra humanoid, four static double-support stances recover all 12 lower-limb joint-zero offsets injected with an RMS error of 0.063 degrees. The head module combines multi-camera visual odometry with legged odometry and dynamic compensation through the live ROS transform tree. Using only planar walking, it attains a mean SO(3) error of 1.061 degrees across three sequences. The best sequence reaches 0.775 degrees, competitive with iKalibr at 0.902 degrees from rich 6-DOF excitation. Rig-relative angles repeat within 0.140 degrees. Injection recovery and held-out tests validate each observable block.

摘要（中文）：装配、磨损及部件更换会扰动人体模型CAD所编码的传感器外参和关节零位。现有标定流程通常针对单一传感器对，或需借助外部基准标记。仅利用机器人本体运动及机载感知，我们提出OmniCalib——一种无需标定靶的工作流，可标定完整上肢（全部14个手臂关节零位、腕部及胸部相机的内外参）、下肢以及多相机头部装置。每个模块将机器人本体任务与参数块匹配，检查可观测性，并仅将受支持的修正写入CAD模型。我们的深度ICP方法无需任何标定靶即可恢复全部14个手臂关节零位，并标定所有RGB-D相机外参。相对于CAD模型，估计的外参修正量分别为：左腕10.56 mm、1.74度，右腕6.33 mm、1.25度，胸部RGB-D相机9.81 mm、0.929度。ICP点到平面残差为2.09 mm。在相同注入偏移下，ICP与ArUco方法均以低于0.1度编码器分辨率基准的误差恢复全部14个关节零位。在AGIBOT A3 Ultra人形机器人上，四次静态双脚支撑位姿即可恢复全部12个下肢关节零位偏移，RMS误差为0.063度。头部模块将多相机视觉里程计与腿部里程计结合，并通过实时ROS变换树实现动态补偿。仅利用平面行走，该方法在三个序列上平均SO(3)误差为1.061度。最佳序列达到0.775度，与通过丰富六自由度激励获得0.902度结果的iKalibr方法相当。机体相对角度重复性在0.140度以内。注入恢复及留出测试验证了每个可观测模块的有效性。

Authors: Kaixiang Lu, Haiyu Lan, Chunxiao Qiao, You Li, Enyu Li, Yehao Lu, Jiarui Yang, Peiwen Lin, Chuang Wang

VABench: Measuring Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Visual Demonstrations, Active Perception, and Metric Control VLA

embodied spatial intelligence visual demonstrations active perception metric control multimodal LLM evaluation

简要说明：该论文提出了VA-Bench基准，通过视觉演示、主动感知和度量控制来评估多模态大语言模型的具身空间智能，发现主动相机控制显著提升成功率，而几何迁移仍是重大挑战。

TLDR: This paper introduces VA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating embodied spatial intelligence in multimodal LLMs through visual demonstrations, active perception, and metric control, finding that active camera control significantly boosts success and that geometric transfer remains a major challenge.

Abstract: Spatial intelligence requires more than describing object locations. Under incomplete observation, models must identify and acquire missing evidence, interpret it in a common spatial frame, and act on it. We introduce VA-Bench to evaluate the complete observe-reason-act-revise loop. General-purpose MLLMs learn procedural context from RGB-only demonstrations, actively select camera viewpoints, issue metric Cartesian commands, and revise them from execution feedback. Models receive no privileged object poses, oracle trajectories, or learned action heads. A fixed model-agnostic controller executes only model-specified targets. VA-Bench contains 14 base task families (11 single-arm and three dual-arm), seven held-out geometry/layout variants, and a long-horizon five-object composition track. We evaluate 12 primary model conditions in three independent runs over the same 20 physically verified seeds per base task, reporting terminal success, nine trajectory-level behavioral diagnostics, and subtask progress. First, the best-performing model scores 100.0% on target localization and 78.9% on spatial relations in the annotated run. Its three-run macro-average task success is only 53.93+/-3.17%. Second, active camera control significantly improves task success over passive multi-view observation. In one matched comparison, success rises from 27.86% to 57.50%. Third, held-out geometric transfer can reduce task success by over 30 percentage points. No model completes a strict long-horizon episode, despite substantial partial progress. VA-Bench thus tests whether general-purpose MLLMs can turn visual demonstrations and actively acquired evidence into successful embodied action.

摘要（中文）：空间智能所要求的远不止描述物体位置。在观测不完整的情况下，模型必须识别并获取缺失的证据，在共同的空间框架中对其进行解读，并据此采取行动。我们引入VA-Bench来评估完整的“观察-推理-行动-修正”循环。通用多模态大语言模型仅从RGB演示中学习程序性上下文，主动选择相机视角，发出度量制笛卡尔坐标指令，并根据执行反馈进行修正。模型不获得任何特权物体姿态、专家轨迹或学习型动作头。一个固定的模型无关控制器仅执行模型指定的目标。VA-Bench包含14个基础任务族（11个单臂和3个双臂任务）、七个保留的几何/布局变体，以及一个长时程五物体组合任务轨道。我们在每个基础任务的同一组20个物理验证种子上，对12种主要模型条件进行了三次独立运行评估，报告终端成功率、九项轨迹级行为诊断指标以及子任务进展。首先，表现最佳的模型在标注运行中的目标定位得分为100.0%，空间关系得分为78.9%。其三次运行的宏平均任务成功率仅为53.93±3.17%。其次，主动相机控制相比被动多视角观测显著提升了任务成功率。在一项匹配对比中，成功率从27.86%提升至57.50%。第三，保留的几何迁移可将任务成功率降低超过30个百分点。尽管取得了可观的局部进展，但没有模型能够完成严格的长时程任务回合。因此，VA-Bench检验的是通用多模态大语言模型能否将视觉演示和主动获取的证据转化为成功的具身行动。

Authors: Zhongbo Zhang, Jiayi Jin, Yifan Wang, Zaibin Zhang, Haiwen Diao, Lijun Wang, Huchuan Lu

Navigate or Relocate? Planning Among Movable Obstacles in Unknown Environments Manipulation

NAMO unknown environments interdependent relocation LLM-based sampling online planning

简要说明：该论文提出了一种在未知环境中进行可移动障碍物间导航（NAMO）的在线框架，通过最短路径在导航和重定位之间进行选择，并使用LLM来偏置采样以处理相互依赖的重定位序列。

TLDR: This paper proposes an online framework for Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) in unknown environments, which selects between navigation and relocation using shortest paths and uses an LLM to bias sampling for interdependent relocation sequences.

Abstract: Conventional robot planning methods seek collision-free paths to a goal but fail when all paths are blocked. In these cases, the robot must determine which objects to relocate, in what order, and where to place them to clear a path---a problem known as Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO). Most NAMO planners assume a known environment, while existing approaches for unknown environments typically reason locally about relocations and cannot plan interdependent relocation sequences. We consider NAMO in unknown environments revealed through onboard sensing, where the robot must decide whether a blocked route requires relocation or a feasible path may exist through unexplored space. We propose an online framework that addresses this ambiguity by selecting between navigation and relocation using shortest paths that treat discovered movable objects as obstacles or as removable. Navigation relies on existing motion planners, while relocation uses a sampling-based approach that, unlike existing approaches for unknown environments, searches over \textit{interdependent} relocation sequences and uses an LLM to bias sampling. Numerical experiments demonstrate scalability to cluttered environments requiring interdependent relocations and improved plan quality over existing baselines.

摘要（中文）：常规机器人规划方法旨在寻找通往目标的无碰撞路径，但当所有路径均被阻塞时，这些方法便失效。在此类情况下，机器人必须确定需要移动哪些物体、以何种顺序移动，以及将其放置何处以清除路径——这一问题被称为“可移动障碍物环境中的导航”（NAMO）。大多数NAMO规划器假设环境已知，而针对未知环境的现有方法通常仅在局部范围内考虑物体重新布置，无法规划相互依赖的重排序列。我们考虑在通过机载感知揭示的未知环境中进行NAMO，此时机器人需要判断被阻塞的路线是需要重新布置障碍物，还是可能存在一条穿越未探索空间的可行路径。我们提出了一种在线框架，通过选择基于最短路径的导航或重排来解决这一模糊性，其中最短路径将已发现的可移动障碍物视为障碍物或可移除物体。导航依赖现有的运动规划器，而重排则采用基于采样的方法，与现有针对未知环境的方法不同，该方法搜索\textit{相互依赖}的重排序列，并利用大型语言模型（LLM）对采样进行偏置。数值实验证明了该方法在需要相互依赖重排的杂乱环境中的可扩展性，并且相较于现有基线方法，路径规划质量有所提升。

Authors: Yuqing Zhang, Haoyu Zhu, Yiannis Kantaros

CoreSense: Traceable Failure Recall and Conflict-Aware Belief Gating for Auditable Robot Decisions Other

belief gating episodic evidence failure recall auditable decisions robot safety

简要说明：CoreSense 提出了一种机器人系统集成架构，通过可追踪的 episodic 证据和冲突感知的信念门控减少机器人任务执行中的不安全决策，并在离线数据集和仿真中进行了验证。

TLDR: CoreSense introduces a robot-system integration architecture with traceable episodic evidence and a conflict-aware belief gate to reduce unsafe decisions in robot task execution, validated on offline datasets and simulations.

Abstract: Robots can recall prior failures without knowing whether recalled evidence remains valid, conflicts with current observations, or is sufficient to guide a decision. We present CoreSense, a robot-system integration architecture that combines traceable episodic evidence with a conflict-aware belief gate and bounded, auditable recommendations. The gate checks scope, provenance, time, contradiction, and support before it permits PROCEED, requests re-observation, abstains, or escalates. Evaluation follows three complementary layers without commanding a physical robot: offline public real-robot data, a frozen signal-level simulation, and a live cloud deployment path. On CableTrace-120 and BotFails-200, belief gating reduces protocol-defined unsafe proceeds from 20% and 40% to 0%. A disjointly calibrated raw-video policy also reaches 0% unsafe proceed, but overblocks every nominal episode. On public data, a ViFailback-BotFails visual detector reaches 0.778 AUROC yet remains all-blocking, whereas cycle-disjoint UR3 telemetry for protective stops yields 0% unsafe proceed, 36.1% overblocking, and 61.9% coverage; grip-loss transfer remains a negative result. Controlled physical corroboration yields 3.3%, 0%, and 42.0%, while conflict-aware fusion yields 4.7%, 0%, and 42.8%. Finally, 20/20 cloud recalls validate a CockroachDB Cloud-Amazon Bedrock deployment path. The evidence supports an auditable integration pattern, not autonomous recovery or certified safety.

摘要（中文）：机器人能够回忆之前的失败经历，却不知道所回忆的证据是否仍然有效、是否与当前观测相冲突，或者是否足以指导决策。我们提出CoreSense，一种机器人系统集成架构，它将可追溯的片段式证据与冲突感知的信念门控以及有界、可审计的建议相结合。信念门控在允许继续（PROCEED）、请求重新观测、弃权或升级之前，会检查范围、来源、时间、矛盾性和支持度。评估在三个互补层面进行，而无需操控实体机器人：离线公开真实机器人数据、冻结的信号级仿真，以及实时云端部署路径。在CableTrace-120和BotFails-200数据集上，信念门控将协议定义的不安全继续操作率从20%和40%降至0%。一个经不相交校准的原始视频策略同样达到0%的不安全继续操作率，但会过度阻塞所有正常片段。在公开数据上，ViFailback-BotFails视觉检测器达到0.778的AUROC，但仍然全量阻塞；而用于保护性停止的周期不相交UR3遥测数据实现了0%的不安全继续操作率、36.1%的过度阻塞率以及61.9%的覆盖率；抓取损失迁移仍为负结果。受控物理验证得到3.3%、0%和42.0%的结果，而冲突感知融合得到4.7%、0%和42.8%的结果。最后，20/20次云端召回验证了CockroachDB Cloud-Amazon Bedrock部署路径的可行性。这些证据支持一种可审计的集成模式，而非自主恢复或认证安全性。

Authors: Zoe Li

ParticleSplat: Self-supervised Object-centric Latent Particle Splatting Manipulation

self-supervised learning 3D Gaussian Splatting object-centric representation robotic manipulation latent particles

简要说明：ParticleSplat 提出了一种自监督的以对象为中心的3D表示方法，利用潜在粒子拼接和新视图合成目标，实现无监督对象分割和3D编辑，并提升下游机器人操作性能。

TLDR: ParticleSplat introduces a self-supervised object-centric 3D representation using latent particle splatting with a view synthesis objective, enabling unsupervised object segmentation and 3D editing, and improving downstream robotic manipulation.

Abstract: We present ParticleSplat, a self-supervised object-centric learning method that decomposes scenes into a set of latent ''particles'' representing semantic entities through feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting. Building on the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework, which represents images as a set of particles with attributes such as position, scale, and visual appearance, we address a key limitation of DLP: its inherently 2D nature, which prevents explicit 3D spatial and geometric reasoning that are critical for downstream tasks such as robotic manipulation. Leveraging the structural similarity between latent particles and 3D Gaussian primitives, we introduce a 3D latent particle space trained with a novel view synthesis objective. Our model jointly encodes multiple views with camera poses into a shared 3D object-centric latent space, then transforms particles into particle-aligned 3D Gaussians whose composition reconstructs the full scene. On simulated and real-world datasets, we show that this formulation inherently learns object masks without supervision and supports controllable 3D scene editing, such as moving objects by modifying particles in the latent space. We further establish that the learned 3D representation improves downstream performance on robotic manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了ParticleSplat，一种自监督的以对象为中心的学习方法，通过前馈3D高斯泼溅将场景分解为一组代表语义实体的潜在“粒子”。该方法建立在深度潜在粒子（DLP）框架之上，该框架将图像表示为一组具有位置、尺度和视觉外观等属性的粒子。我们解决了DLP的一个关键局限性：其固有的二维特性，这阻碍了对机器人操作等下游任务至关重要的显式3D空间与几何推理。利用潜在粒子与3D高斯原语之间的结构相似性，我们引入了一个通过新颖视图合成目标训练的3D潜在粒子空间。我们的模型将多个带有相机位姿的视图联合编码到一个共享的3D以对象为中心的潜在空间中，然后将粒子转换为与粒子对齐的3D高斯，其组合重构完整场景。在模拟和真实数据集上，我们展示了该公式无需监督即可内在地学习对象掩码，并支持可控的3D场景编辑，例如通过在潜在空间中修改粒子来移动对象。我们进一步证明了所学习的3D表示能够提升机器人操作任务的下游性能。

Authors: Lyuxing He, Daniel Guo, Elizabeth Terveen, Deepak Pathak, David Held, Tal Daniel

Pose-aware Legged Robot Semantic Exploration with Omnidirectional Perception in Confined Unknown Environments Locomotion

legged robot semantic exploration pose-aware viewpoint sampling vision-language model omnidirectional perception

简要说明：POSE 是一种针对受限空间中腿式机器人的姿态感知语义探索系统，利用身体俯仰/翻滚和全向感知及 VLM 辅助视点剪枝，提高覆盖率并减少探索时间。

TLDR: POSE is a pose-aware semantic exploration system for legged robots in confined spaces, using body pitch/roll and omnidirectional perception with VLM-assisted viewpoint pruning to improve coverage and reduce exploration time.

Abstract: Semantic exploration in confined environments requires both environment mapping and detailed observation of target objects. For ground robots, limited sensor vertical fields of view and restricted standoff distances can leave upper object surfaces unobserved from planar viewpoints. Body tilting can improve coverage, but additional observations and posture transitions increase mission time. To address this trade-off, we present POSE, a pose-aware semantic exploration system that exploits a legged robot's intrinsic body pitch and roll with omnidirectional camera-LiDAR perception. The proposed pose-aware viewpoint sampling module selects body postures from partial object maps according to expected coverage gain, while aim-aligned execution reduces unnecessary body reorientation. Further, we introduce an object-centric viewpoint pruning strategy assisted by a vision-language model (VLM), which uses persistent observation history and bird's-eye-view (BEV) maps to reduce redundant inspection visits. The resulting semantic viewpoints are combined with geometric exploration viewpoints in a global exploration planner. Simulations show that POSE improves final target-surface coverage by 8-10 percentage points over the planar planning baseline while reducing exploration time by 17-32%, and achieves the highest mean object coverage AUC among the evaluated baselines. Real-world experiments with a legged robot carrying an omnidirectional camera-LiDAR suite in a machine shop further demonstrate the system's applicability. These results support adaptive body-posture planning for improving the coverage-efficiency trade-off in legged robot semantic exploration. We plan to release the code for community benefit in the future.

摘要（中文）：在受限环境中进行语义探索，既需要环境地图构建，也需要对目标物体进行细致观察。对于地面机器人而言，传感器垂直视场角有限且安全距离受限，导致从平面视角无法观察到物体的上表面。机身倾斜可提升覆盖率，但额外的观测与姿态切换会增加任务时间。为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了POSE——一种利用腿式机器人固有俯仰与横滚能力，并结合全向相机-激光雷达感知的位姿感知语义探索系统。所提出的位姿感知视点采样模块根据期望覆盖率增益，从部分物体地图中选择机身姿态，而瞄准对齐执行策略则减少了不必要的机身重定向。此外，我们引入了一种由视觉语言模型辅助的以物体为中心的视点剪枝策略，该策略利用持续观测历史与鸟瞰图来减少冗余的检查访问。最终得到的语义视点与几何探索视点被共同集成于全局探索规划器中。仿真结果表明，相比平面规划基线，POSE将最终目标表面覆盖率提升了8至10个百分点，同时将探索时间缩短了17%至32%，并在所有评估基线中取得了最高的平均物体覆盖率AUC。在机械车间中，搭载全向相机-激光雷达套件的腿式机器人实物实验进一步验证了该系统的实用性。上述结果支持自适应机身姿态规划，以改善腿式机器人语义探索中的覆盖率-效率权衡。我们计划未来公开代码，以回馈社区。

Authors: Xiaoyang Zhan, Shiyu Chen, Kenji Shimada

GLAMDRING: Gait Learning And Morphology co-Design via Reinforcement LearnING of CPGs Locomotion

morphology co-design central pattern generator gait learning quadruped locomotion reinforcement learning

简要说明：GLAMDRING 通过强化学习联合优化四足机器人的形态与 CPG 步态策略，以满足任务约束，并涌现出动物步态。

TLDR: GLAMDRING jointly optimizes quadruped robot morphology and CPG-based gait policies via reinforcement learning to meet task constraints, yielding feasible designs and emergent animal gaits.

Abstract: Robots are moving out of the structured factory floor and into unstructured environments such as disaster sites, planetary surfaces, and agricultural fields, for which the right robot often does not yet exist. We present GLAMDRING, a framework that synthesizes the optimal robot for a locomotion task and, jointly, learns the controller that drives it. For the given specifications of forward-velocity bounds, a per-actuator power budget, an actuator library, and a payload requirement, GLAMDRING returns a matched quadruped morphology (link geometry and per-joint actuators) and a Hopf-oscillator Central Pattern Generator (CPG) gait policy. We rank feasible designs against a target design objective, viz., maximum speed, minimum Cost of Transport (CoT), or max Payload Margin. Because body and locomotion are coupled, the optimal morphology dictates how a robot is driven, while optimal gait depends on the physical body. We train a small number of CPG policies by reinforcement learning across the space of candidate morphologies, co-learning the gait with the underlying robot hardware. Link lengths and actuators are then resolved post-hoc from the policy's logged operating envelope, reducing synthesis cost to a small, fixed number of reinforcement-learning runs instead of one per candidate. Our experiments show three key findings: co-designing body and gait is necessary to satisfy locomotion constraints; actuator-envelope feasibility, rather than locomotion success alone, determines realizable payload capacity; and canonical animal gaits emerge naturally in most designs from morphology and constraints alone. A real-world demonstration further highlights the efficacy of our work.

摘要（中文）：机器人正从结构化工厂车间走向非结构化环境，如灾难现场、行星表面和农业田地，而针对这些场景的合适机器人往往尚不存在。我们提出了GLAMDRING，这是一个框架，能够为运动任务综合出最优机器人，并同时学习驱动该机器人的控制器。根据给定的前进速度范围、每个执行器的功率预算、执行器库和负载要求，GLAMDRING会返回匹配的四足形态（连杆几何结构和各关节执行器）以及Hopf振荡器中央模式发生器（CPG）步态策略。我们根据目标设计指标对可行设计进行排序，即最大速度、最小运输成本（CoT）或最大负载裕度。由于本体与运动相互耦合，最优形态决定了机器人的驱动方式，而最优步态则依赖于物理本体。我们在候选形态空间中通过强化学习训练少量CPG策略，将步态与底层机器人硬件协同学习。连杆长度和执行器随后根据策略记录的工作包络事后确定，从而将综合成本降至少量固定次数的强化学习运行，而非每个候选方案一次。我们的实验展示了三个关键发现：协同设计本体与步态对于满足运动约束是必要的；执行器包络可行性（而非仅运动成功）决定了可实现的有效载荷能力；典型动物步态在多数设计中仅由形态和约束自然涌现。一项现实世界演示进一步凸显了我们工作的有效性。

Authors: Amogh Joshi, Kaushik Roy

Winning a Won Game: Strict Reach-Avoid-Stay Control Barrier Functions for High-Dimensional Black-Box Systems Locomotion

control barrier functions reach-avoid-stay black-box systems safety filter quadruped locomotion

简要说明：本文针对高维黑箱系统提出了一种严格到达-避免-停留(Q-CBF)安全滤波器，并在四足机器人跨越间隙和模拟F1TENTH赛车中验证，无需已知动力学或手动设计即可保证安全完成任务。

TLDR: This paper proposes a strict reach-avoid-stay (sRAS) Q-control barrier function (CBF) safety filter for high-dimensional black-box systems, validated on quadruped gap jumping and simulated F1TENTH racing, ensuring safe task completion without known dynamics or hand-designed barriers.

Abstract: Robots must complete their tasks and maintain the achieved outcomes while avoiding safety failures at all times. Strict reach-avoid-stay (sRAS) formalizes this requirement: safely reaching a target and remaining there indefinitely after first entry. We propose an sRAS Q-control barrier function (CBF) safety filter for high-dimensional black-box systems under bounded uncertainty. Our construction combines a stay value encoding safe permanent residence in a target subset with a reach-avoid value encoding safe reachability of this subset while avoiding target states from which safe permanent residence cannot be guaranteed. We prove that these values jointly yield a valid robust discrete-time CBF and lift them to state-action Q-functions for runtime intervention. For exact values and under a measure-zero condition, our filter preserves sRAS feasibility from almost every winnable initial state and keeps the system safely within the target after first entry, against all admissible uncertainty realizations. We adopt reachability-based adversarial reinforcement learning for scalable value approximation using only black-box interactions. Notably, neither synthesis nor deployment of our filter requires known dynamics, affine structure, value derivatives, or hand-designed barriers. We validate our framework in quadruped gap jumping in simulation and hardware, where the robot crosses the gap, lands safely, and remains safe afterward. Simulated F1TENTH races further demonstrate safe overtaking and lead retention.

摘要（中文）：机器人必须完成任务并保持已取得的成果，同时始终避免安全故障。严格到达-保持-避障（sRAS）形式化了这一要求：安全地到达目标区域，并在首次进入后无限期地停留在该区域内。我们提出了一种针对有界不确定性下高维黑箱系统的sRAS Q-控制屏障函数（CBF）安全过滤器。我们的构造将编码目标子集中安全永久驻留的保持值与编码该子集安全可达性同时避开无法保证安全永久驻留的目标状态的到达-避障值相结合。我们证明了这些值共同产生一个有效的鲁棒离散时间CBF，并将其提升为用于运行时干预的状态-动作Q函数。对于精确值，在零测度条件下，我们的过滤器几乎从所有可获胜的初始状态保持sRAS可行性，并在首次进入后使系统安全地保持在目标区域内，抵御所有可允许的不确定性实现。我们采用基于可达性的对抗强化学习，仅利用黑箱交互实现可扩展的值近似。值得注意的是，我们过滤器的综合和部署都不需要已知动力学、仿射结构、值导数或手工设计的屏障。我们在四足机器人间隙跳跃的仿真和硬件实验中验证了我们的框架，机器人跨越间隙、安全着陆，并在之后保持安全。模拟的F1TENTH比赛进一步证明了安全超车和保持领先的能力。

Authors: Donggeon David Oh, Duy P. Nguyen, Gongkai Yuan, Qingchen Li, Jaime Fernández Fisac, Haimin Hu

From Wizard-of-Oz Human-Robot Dialogue Collection to a Taxonomy of Robot Response Decisions: A Retrospective Analysis of Assistive Pilot Interactions Other

human-robot dialogue taxonomy assistive robot Wizard-of-Oz vision-language model

简要说明：本文回顾性分析了 Wizard-of-Oz 人机对话研究，为辅助移动机械臂提炼出机器人响应模式与歧义类型的层级分类法，并展示了可微调视觉语言模型来预测这些响应决策。

TLDR: This paper presents a retrospective analysis of a Wizard-of-Oz human-robot dialogue study, deriving a hierarchical taxonomy of robot response modes and ambiguity types for assistive mobile manipulators, and demonstrates that vision-language models can be fine-tuned to predict these response decisions.

Abstract: Robots that follow natural-language instructions in everyday indoor environments must act on incomplete human utterances. Instructions often omit essential information, such as the identity of an out-of-view object, an intended destination, or the user's goal. Existing datasets contain little real-world situated dialogue and provide few practice-grounded criteria for deciding when a robot should act, confirm, clarify, or refuse. We retrospectively analyze a pilot Wizard-of-Oz study in which five participants performed everyday indoor tasks, including door opening, drawer opening, feeding, drinking, and cleaning, with a wheelchair-mounted mobile manipulator while the wizard responded without a formal communication policy. This preserved authentic user behavior but produced inconsistent robot-side decisions, motivating an explicit decision scheme. From 40 episodes, we derived a hierarchical taxonomy of six response modes (ANSWER, REPORT_DONE, REFUSE, CONFIRM, CLARIFY, ACT) and four ambiguity types (intent, referential, spatial, intelligibility). Two human annotators and an AI annotator applied the scheme to the pilot data. Clean-label rates were 91% and 89%, and Cohen's ranged from 0.72 to 0.95 across decision-point, mode, and ambiguity levels for both human-human and human-AI comparisons. Fine-tuning LLaVA-1.6-7B on taxonomy-derived labels for ACT and CLARIFY indicates the feasibility of training vision-language models using annotations from our taxonomy. Remaining boundary cases in decision-point identification and REPORT_DONE motivate a constrained protocol for more consistent dialogue collection.

摘要（中文）：在日常生活室内环境中遵循自然语言指令的机器人，必须在人类表述不完整的情况下采取行动。指令常常遗漏关键信息，例如视野外物体的身份、预期目的地或用户的目标。现有数据集缺乏真实世界情境对话的丰富内容，也几乎未提供基于实践的准则，用以判断机器人何时应当行动、确认、澄清或拒绝。我们回顾性地分析了一项先导性“ Wizard-of-Oz ”研究，其中五名参与者使用一台安装在轮椅上的移动机械臂完成日常室内任务，包括开门、开抽屉、喂食、饮水和清洁，而操控者则在没有正式通信策略的情况下作出响应。这保留了真实的用户行为，但导致机器人侧决策不一致，从而促使我们提出一种明确的决策方案。从40个情节中，我们归纳出一个包含六种响应模式（回答、报告完成、拒绝、确认、澄清、行动）和四种模糊类型（意图、指代、空间、可理解性）的层级分类体系。两名人工标注者和一名AI标注者将该方案应用于先导数据。干净标签率分别为91%和89%，在决策点、模式和模糊层级上，人工之间及人工与AI之间的Cohen's kappa值介于0.72至0.95之间。基于该分类体系生成的标签对LLaVA-1.6-7B进行微调，用于行动和澄清任务，结果表明利用我们分类体系的标注来训练视觉语言模型是可行的。在决策点识别和报告完成方面仍存在的边界案例，促使我们提出一种受约束的协议，以实现更一致的对话数据收集。

Authors: Guangping Liu, Nicholas Hawkins, Tipu Sultan, Flavio Esposito, Madi Dian

Predict Before You Deploy: Offline Prediction of Quantization-Induced Task Degradation for World Action Models WorldModel

post-training quantization world action models offline action deviations closed-loop evaluation policy calibration

简要说明：本文提出PreDE框架，利用离线动作偏差预测世界动作模型量化引起的任务退化，并在真实机器人上验证，显著提升速度并降低内存。

TLDR: This paper proposes PreDE, a framework to predict quantization-induced task degradation for world action models using offline action deviations, validated on real robots with significant speedup and memory reduction.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) rely on video-generation backbones, requiring substantial memory and compute for deployment. Post-training quantization reduces memory and can accelerate inference, but bit width, grouping, and quantizer choice define a large configuration space. Identifying configurations that preserve task performance through exhaustive closed-loop evaluation is costly. We propose PreDE (Predict Before You Deploy), a policy-calibrated framework for predicting quantization-induced task degradation from offline action deviations. Using closed-loop outcomes from a small development set, PreDE calibrates two thresholds and accepts, rejects, or defers new configurations using a fixed observation log. Under a within-setting label-ordering hypothesis, the rule issues decisions where all thresholds consistent with the development labels agree. Across five WAMs and four benchmark settings, quantization produces configuration-dependent task losses that cannot be explained by bit width alone or a shared deviation threshold. Across 28 held-out configurations from two policies, PreDE issued 21 decisions before observing closed-loop outcomes (75% coverage), all matching the observed acceptable or degraded labels. Deferred candidates included both acceptable outcomes and a 33-percentage-point loss. In 450 Franka Research 3 trials across two independently fine-tuned policies, all configurations assigned to high-deviation groups before testing showed significant degradation, while low-deviation comparisons showed no statistically significant degradation. On the real robot, W4A4 achieved a 1.37x action-query speedup and approximately 44% lower peak memory. These results support policy-specific behavioral calibration for quantization configuration selection while identifying candidates that require closed-loop evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/PreDE.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）依赖视频生成骨干网络，其部署需要大量内存和计算资源。训练后量化可减少内存占用并加速推理，但位宽、分组和量化器的选择构成了一个庞大的配置空间。通过穷举闭环评估来确定能够保持任务性能的配置成本高昂。我们提出PreDE（部署前预测），一种策略校准框架，用于从离线动作偏差中预测量化引起的任务退化。利用小型开发集的闭环结果，PreDE校准两个阈值，并基于固定观测日志接受、拒绝或延迟新配置。在设置内标签排序假设下，该规则在所有与开发集标签一致的阈值上做出决策。在五个WAM和四个基准设置中，量化产生的配置相关任务损失无法仅用位宽或共享偏差阈值来解释。针对来自两个策略的28个留出配置，PreDE在观测闭环结果前发布了21项决策（覆盖率75%），全部与观测到的可接受或退化标签一致。延迟候选同时包含可接受结果和33个百分点的损失。在450次Franka Research 3试验中，跨越两个独立微调策略，测试前被归类为高偏差组的所有配置均表现出显著退化，而低偏差对照则无统计学显著退化。在真实机器人上，W4A4实现了1.37倍的动作查询加速和约44%的峰值内存降低。这些结果支持针对量化配置选择的策略特定行为校准，同时识别需要闭环评估的候选配置。代码可在https://github.com/jiuyixu25/PreDE获取。

Authors: Jiuyi Xu, Jinjia Guo, Meida Chen, Jing Du, Yangming Shi

Enhancing the Perception of Safety and Comfort during Physical Human-Robot Handshake Interactions by Integrating Flexible Elements into a Robotic Arm Manipulation

series elastic actuators human-robot interaction physical handshake perceived safety compliant joints

简要说明：本文通过实验评估了在机器人手臂中集成串联弹性执行器（SEA）对物理人机握手过程中感知安全性和舒适性的影响，结果表明柔性关节相比刚性关节能改善用户感知。

TLDR: This paper experimentally evaluates how integrating series elastic actuators (SEAs) into a robotic arm affects perceived safety and comfort during physical human-robot handshakes, showing that flexible joints improve user perception compared to rigid joints.

Abstract: Safety and comfort in human-robot physical in-teractions are essential aspects in the development of social technologies, where natural gestures, such as handshakes, represent a challenge due to their direct physical contact. The implementation of series elastic actuators (SEA) to absorb impacts is proposed as a design strategy that favors safer interactions. This paper presents an experimental study aimed at evaluating how the incorporation of SEAs in robotic arms influences perceived safety and the interaction experience dur-ing handshaking. The design allows a direct comparison of the effect of rigidity versus the incorporation of elastic elements, in order to identify the advantages of SEAs in improving the physical safety and social acceptance of robotic systems in everyday contexts. The experiment was carried out with 10 volunteers (6 men and 4 women), who performed two interactions with each robotic arm: one with rigid joints and the other with flexible joints using SEA. During testing, objective data on end-effector trajectories were collected, as well as subjective information through a perception survey focused on safety, naturalness, and confidence during the handshake. The survey results show increased perceptions of safety and comfort with the SEA-equipped arm, supporting its potential to facilitate safer and more socially accepted human-robot interactions.

摘要（中文）：人与机器人物理交互中的安全性与舒适性是社交技术发展中的重要方面，其中握手等自然手势因涉及直接身体接触而构成挑战。采用串联弹性执行器（SEA）来吸收冲击力，被视为一种有利于实现更安全交互的设计策略。本文开展了一项实验研究，旨在评估在机械臂中引入SEA对握手过程中感知安全性和交互体验的影响。该设计允许直接比较刚性连接与引入弹性元件之间的效果差异，从而识别SEA在提升机器人系统日常情境中物理安全性和社会接受度方面的优势。实验共有10名志愿者参与（6名男性，4名女性），每位志愿者分别与两台机械臂各进行两次交互：一次为刚性关节，另一次为采用SEA的柔性关节。测试过程中，采集了末端执行器轨迹的客观数据，并通过一份聚焦于握手过程中安全性、自然性和信任度的感知问卷收集了主观信息。问卷调查结果显示，配备SEA的机械臂在安全性和舒适性方面的感知均有所提升，这支持了其在促进更安全且更具社会接受度的人机交互方面的潜力。

Authors: Joel Hidalgo, Dennys Paillacho, Melissa Cobos, Luigi Miranda

Dynamic-LIVO: A Dynamic-Aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry System Using Spatio-Temporal Normals Perception3D

LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry dynamic environment spatio-temporal normals state estimation static mapping

简要说明：本文提出了Dynamic-LIVO，一种利用时空法线分析检测并排除动态点的LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计系统，用于动态环境中的鲁棒定位和静态建图。

TLDR: This paper presents Dynamic-LIVO, a LiDAR-Inertial-Visual odometry system that uses spatio-temporal normal analysis to detect and exclude dynamic points for robust localization and static mapping in dynamic environments.

Abstract: This paper proposes Dynamic-LIVO, a dynamic-aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) system for robust state estimation and static colored mapping in dynamic environments. Dynamic-LIVO employs Spatio-Temporal (S-T) normal analysis to identify dynamic LiDAR points and propagates the resulting classification to both LiDAR-inertial and visual-inertial updates, preventing dynamic LiDAR measurements and their associated visual observations from affecting state estimation and mapping. However, S-T normal estimation can be unreliable in newly observed and spatially sparse regions due to insufficient spatio-temporal observations. To address this issue, we introduce a time-delayed S-T normal estimation strategy that defers the classification of insufficiently constrained points and re-evaluates them as additional observations become available. This strategy improves dynamic classification reliability while preserving valid static points for map construction. Extensive experiments on public and self-collected datasets with diverse sensor configurations demonstrate that Dynamic-LIVO improves localization accuracy and produces cleaner static colored maps in challenging dynamic environments. The source code and self-collected dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了Dynamic-LIVO系统，一种面向动态环境的动态感知激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计（LIVO）系统，用于在动态环境中实现鲁棒的状态估计与静态彩色地图构建。Dynamic-LIVO利用时空（S-T）法向分析来识别动态激光雷达点，并将该分类结果同时传播至激光雷达-惯性更新和视觉-惯性更新中，从而避免动态激光雷达测量及其相关视觉观测影响状态估计与地图构建。然而，在新增观测区域及空间稀疏区域，由于时空观测不足，S-T法向估计可能不可靠。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一种延时S-T法向估计策略，该策略将对约束不足的点的分类进行延迟处理，并在获得更多观测信息后对其重新评估。该策略提升了动态分类的可靠性，同时保留了有效的静态点用于地图构建。在包含多种传感器配置的公开数据集及自采集数据集上的大量实验表明，Dynamic-LIVO在具有挑战性的动态环境中能够提高定位精度，并生成更干净的静态彩色地图。源代码及自采集数据集将在论文被接收后公开发布。
