Authors: Zhixin Zhang, Samuel Ahiwe, Matthew Hale, Liang Zhao, Pawel Ladosz

SemSafe-3DGS: Semantic Risk-Aware Active Navigation in Uncertain 3D Gaussian Splatting Maps RLRobot

semantic risk control barrier function active perception 3D Gaussian Splatting navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于三维高斯溅射地图的语义风险感知主动导航框架，通过类别相关风险权重调制控制屏障函数进行碰撞规避，并通过主动感知降低机器人路径上的地图不确定性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a semantic risk-aware active navigation framework for robots using 3D Gaussian Splatting maps, where class-dependent risk weights modulate a control barrier function for collision avoidance and active perception reduces map uncertainty along the robot's path.

Abstract: Autonomous robots operating in partially observed environments must navigate safely while acquiring observations that improve future planning. Existing safety formulations generally reason primarily about geometry. Consequently, geometrically similar scene elements may induce comparable control responses despite having different semantic consequences. We present a semantic risk aware safe-active perception framework for navigation in attributed 3D Gaussian maps. Semantic attributes modulate an Average Value-at-Risk collision clearance model through class dependent risk weights, allowing safety-critical Gaussian primitives to receive greater influence in the composite barrier. The resulting weighted clearances are aggregated into a control barrier function, while a trajectory-relevant active perception barrier promotes observations that reduce geometric map uncertainty along the robot's anticipated motion. Both objectives are integrated in a unified CBF-QP that enforces semantic risk-aware collision avoidance as a hard constraint while relaxing information acquisition when it conflicts with safety or task progress. Experiments demonstrate efficient safety constraint, improved navigation through active perception, semantic dependent trajectory adaptation, and real-robot execution under Ackermann dynamics.

摘要（中文）：在部分可观测环境中运行的自主机器人必须在安全导航的同时，获取能够改善未来规划的观测信息。现有的安全建模方法通常主要考虑几何因素，因此，几何上相似的场景元素可能会引发相似的控制响应，即便它们具有不同的语义后果。我们提出了一种基于语义风险感知的安全主动感知框架，用于在带属性的三维高斯地图中进行导航。语义属性通过类别相关的风险权重调节平均风险价值碰撞间隙模型，使得安全关键的高斯基元在复合障碍函数中具有更大的影响力。由此得到的加权间隙被聚合为一个控制障碍函数，同时，与轨迹相关的主动感知障碍函数促进机器人沿预期运动方向获取观测，以降低几何地图的不确定性。这两个目标被统一整合到一个CBF-QP优化问题中，其中语义风险感知的碰撞避免作为硬约束被强制执行，而在信息获取与安全或任务进度冲突时则予以松弛。实验结果表明，该方法能够实现高效的安全约束，通过主动感知提升导航性能，具备语义相关的轨迹自适应能力，并在阿克曼动力学条件下完成真实机器人执行验证。

Authors: Amirhossein Mollaei Khass, Athanasios Cosse, Nader Motee

A Morphing Aerial Robot With Thruster-Integrated Flexible Continuum Links for Shape Adaptive Aerial Manipulation Manipulation

aerial manipulation flexible continuum links distributed thrusters vibration suppression morphing robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种带有推力器集成柔性连续体连杆的变形空中机器人，结合了软体操纵器的环境适应性和分布式推力器的扩展力 wrench 空间，实现了稳定飞行和多种空中操纵任务。

TLDR: This paper presents a novel morphing aerial robot with thruster-integrated flexible continuum links that combines soft manipulators' environmental adaptability with distributed thrusters' expanded wrench space, enabling stable flight and versatile aerial manipulation tasks.

Abstract: In recent years, aerial manipulation has attracted increasing attention as a key to expand the application of aerial robots. In this work, we focus on two major research directions for achieving versatile aerial manipulation: (i) acquiring high environmental adaptability using soft manipulators, and (ii) expanding the feasible wrench space by distributing thrusters along the manipulator. However, no aerial robot has simultaneously satisfied these two requirements. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a morphing rotor-distributed aerial robot with flexible continuum links that achieves both high shape adaptability and an expanded wrench space. The flexible continuum links function as soft manipulators, passively conforming to the shape of the environment, while the thrusters distributed along the continuum links expand the feasible thrust wrench space and enable the end-effector to exert large interaction forces. To realize the proposed robot, it is essential to suppress vibrations of the lightweight continuum links. Thus, we develop a composite leaf-spring structure that provides both high torsional and vertical stiffness, and vibration-suppressing control methods. Using these implementations, we demonstrate stable flight and a variety of aerial manipulation tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to realize aerial manipulations using flexible links with an integrated thruster.

摘要（中文）：近年来，空中操控作为拓展空中机器人应用领域的关键技术，日益受到关注。本研究聚焦于实现多功能空中操控的两个主要研究方向：（i）利用软体操控器获取高环境适应性，以及（ii）通过沿操控器分布推进器来扩展可行的力旋量空间。然而，目前尚无空中机器人能同时满足这两项要求。因此，本文提出一种具有柔性连续体连杆的变构型分布式推进空中机器人，该机器人兼具高形状适应性与扩展的力旋量空间。柔性连续体连杆作为软体操控器，能被动顺应环境形状，而沿连续体连杆分布的推进器则扩展了可行的推力力旋量空间，使末端执行器能够施加较大的交互力。为实现所提出的机器人，抑制轻质连续体连杆的振动至关重要。为此，我们开发了一种复合板簧结构，该结构同时具备高扭转刚度和垂直刚度，并配套了相应的振动抑制控制方法。基于上述实现，我们展示了稳定飞行及多种空中操控任务。据我们所知，这是首项利用集成推进器的柔性连杆实现空中操控的研究工作。

Authors: Eri Sawada, Kazuki Sugihara, Ayano Miyamichi, Kunio Kojima, Kei Okada

Open-vocabulary 3D object detection with promptable segmentation AutonomousDriving

open-vocabulary detection promptable segmentation 3D object detection autonomous driving training-free

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的免训练开放词汇3D目标检测流程，利用可提示分割模型在环视图像上生成掩码，并借助场景几何转换为3D框，在nuScenes上验证了性能，并指出主要瓶颈在于几何测量精度而非2D检测。

TLDR: This paper presents a training-free open-vocabulary 3D object detection pipeline for autonomous driving that leverages a promptable segmentation model (SAM3) on surround-view images and converts the resulting masks into metric 3D boxes using scene geometry, demonstrating competitive performance on nuScenes and revealing that the main performance bottleneck is geometry measurement precision rather than 2D detection.

Abstract: Three-dimensional object detection for autonomous driving is dominated by detectors trained on large corpora of human-annotated 3D boxes. Such a detector learns a fixed category list, and everything outside it is invisible. This paper asks whether the task can be solved training-free and open-vocabulary. A promptable segmentation model (SAM3), queried with class names as text prompts, supplies instance masks in the vehicle's six surround-view cameras, and the masks are turned into metric 3D boxes using the geometry of the scene. The core is a controlled three-stage comparison on nuScenes in which 2D detection is held fixed and only the source of 3D geometry changes. Geometry predicted from images alone reaches 0.183 mean average precision (mAP) under the official protocol; fitting boxes from raw LiDAR points inside the same masks with training-free rules reaches 0.298 mAP / 0.348 nuScenes detection score (NDS) at zero labeling cost; borrowing supervised box geometry at inference time lifts the same detections to 0.413 mAP / 0.555 NDS, which locates the pipeline's largest deficit in measurement precision rather than 2D detection, while class confusion and confidence calibration survive that substitution. Reversing the direction, a three-state camera-witness rule built from the same masks improves a supervised LiDAR-only detector from 0.596 to 0.630 mAP, roughly half the gain of fully supervised camera fusion, with no training. A coverage analysis shows that SAM3 finds 84% of in-range objects with a correctly named mask; the classes that fail in the official metric are misnamed or geometrically unforgiving, not unseen.

摘要（中文）：三维目标检测在自动驾驶领域主要由基于大规模人工标注3D框数据集训练的检测器主导。这类检测器学习固定的类别列表，列表之外的所有目标均不可见。本文探讨该任务能否在无需训练且开放词汇的条件下完成。以类别名称作为文本提示查询的可提示分割模型（SAM3），在车辆六个环视摄像头中提供实例掩码，并利用场景几何信息将这些掩码转换为公制三维框。核心在于nuScenes数据集上受控的三阶段对比实验，其中二维检测保持固定，仅改变三维几何信息的来源。在官方协议下，仅从图像预测几何信息达到0.183的平均精度（mAP）；在相同掩码内使用无需训练的规则从原始激光雷达点拟合三维框，在零标注成本下达到0.298 mAP / 0.348 nuScenes检测分数（NDS）；在推理阶段借用有监督的框几何信息，可将相同检测结果提升至0.413 mAP / 0.555 NDS，这表明该流程的最大短板在于测量精度而非二维检测，而类别混淆和置信度校准在该替换下保持稳健。反向来看，基于相同掩码构建的三状态相机见证规则可将有监督的仅激光雷达检测器从0.596提升至0.630 mAP，约为全监督相机融合增益的一半，且无需任何训练。覆盖率分析表明，SAM3能以正确命名的掩码找到84%的范围内目标；在官方指标中失败的目标类别属于命名错误或几何条件严苛，而非未被发现。

Authors: Ömer Faruk Deniz, Mustafa Taha Koçyiğit

REARL: A Closed-loop Autonomous Driving Simulation Enhancement Framework with Real Traffic Data and Large Language Models AutonomousDriving

closed-loop simulation large language models real traffic data distribution discrepancy HighD highway

简要说明：REARL是一种用于自动驾驶的闭环仿真增强框架，结合真实交通数据和大语言模型调整模拟车辆，减少分布差异，提高受控高速公路场景的真实性。

TLDR: REARL is a closed-loop simulation enhancement framework for autonomous driving that uses real traffic data and LLMs to adjust simulated vehicles, reducing distribution divergence and improving realism in controlled highway settings.

Abstract: Accurate simulation is crucial for autonomous driving development, yet capturing real-world traffic complexity remains challenging. Existing simulators that rely on predefined rules or static data playback struggle with dynamic traffic. CRITICAL uses real traffic data and a large language model (LLM) to adjust the initial simulation configuration, but the simulated distribution still diverges from real traffic as the rollout evolves. We propose REARL, a closed-loop simulation enhancement framework that integrates real traffic data with LLMs. Real traffic data are clustered, and each cluster center is used as a representative scenario that provides typical real-world traffic patterns for the LLM. A timed sliding-window detector then monitors discrepancies in vehicle speed distribution and mean spacing between pairs of vehicles. If a metric exceeds a threshold, the LLM adjusts vehicle decision-making; otherwise the existing controller is kept. The LLM also selects a matching real vehicle from a traffic snapshot and modulates the simulated vehicle with reference to that real action. In a controlled HighD highway setting, compared with the CRITICAL baseline and a PPO-based learning baseline, REARL reduces the Hellinger distance for speed distributions to 0.3067 and the MAPE for mean spacing to 0.8371, while achieving a time headway (THW) of 22.8575 and a lane change rate of 0.0708.

摘要（中文）：精准的仿真对自动驾驶研发至关重要，然而还原真实交通的复杂性仍是挑战。现有依赖预设规则或静态数据回放的仿真器难以应对动态交通。CRITICAL方法利用真实交通数据和大语言模型调整初始仿真配置，但随着推演推进，仿真分布仍会偏离真实交通。我们提出REARL，一种融合真实交通数据与大语言模型的闭环仿真增强框架。真实交通数据经过聚类，每个聚类中心作为代表性场景，为语言模型提供典型的真实交通模式。随后，一个定时滑动窗口检测器监控车速分布和车辆间平均间距的偏差。若某指标超过阈值，语言模型调整车辆决策；否则保留原有控制器。语言模型还会从交通快照中选取匹配的真实车辆，并参照该真实动作调节仿真车辆。在受控HighD高速场景下，与CRITICAL基线和基于PPO的学习基线相比，REARL将速度分布的Hellinger距离降至0.3067，平均间距的MAPE降至0.8371，同时时距（THW）达到22.8575，换道率为0.0708。

Authors: Xiaojun Bi, Jun Jiang, Yiwen Sun, Quanyi Ou, Ke Cheng, Mingjie Bi, Yexin Li

DeliveryGym: An RL Environment for Long-Horizon Embodied Agent Planning with Adaptive Curriculum Other

RL environment adaptive curriculum long-horizon planning embodied agent multimodal tool interaction

简要说明：DeliveryGym 是一个带有自适应课程的三维强化学习环境，用于训练具身智能体（如 Qwen3-VL-4B）进行长时程快递班次规划，通过持久世界动力学和轨迹级反馈提高净收入，并证明强化学习在固定评测中取得提升。

TLDR: DeliveryGym is a 3D RL environment with adaptive curricula for training embodied agents (e.g., Qwen3-VL-4B) on long-horizon courier-shift planning, improving net income by integrating persistent world dynamics and trajectory-level feedback, and showing RL gains over fixed evaluation.

Abstract: Executable environments enable LLM agents to learn from the consequences of their actions. For embodied agents, those consequences extend beyond whether the current task succeeds: completing a delivery can consume the time, energy, or money needed for later work. Learning to plan therefore requires environments that preserve these dependencies and turn them into feedback across a complete trajectory. We introduce DeliveryGym, a 3D environment for evaluating and training agents on continuous courier shifts. It couples multimodal tool interaction with persistent world dynamics and computes trajectory rewards from simulator events, making the costs of an agent's decisions available for reinforcement learning (RL). The environment also adapts future training shifts to the policy's observed weaknesses while keeping evaluation fixed. Across six models and 13 city maps, evaluation exposes a gap between reliably executing assigned deliveries and choosing and sequencing work over a shift. On the fixed test suite, RL improves Qwen3-VL-4B's net income by 54.3%, showing that learning from complete shifts improves performance under these coupled constraints. Adapting the training environment improves test income by 16.5% over uniform sampling at the same rollout budget, indicating that which situations an agent practices also matters. DeliveryGym provides an executable setting for studying how agents learn to coordinate deliveries and preserve resources for later orders within an episode.

摘要（中文）：可执行环境使大型语言模型智能体能够从自身行为的后果中学习。对于具身智能体而言，这些后果不仅限于当前任务是否成功：完成一次配送可能会消耗后续工作所需的时间、精力或资金。因此，学习规划需要环境能够保留这些依赖关系，并将其转化为贯穿完整轨迹的反馈。我们引入了DeliveryGym，这是一个用于在连续配送班次中评估和训练智能体的三维环境。它将多模态工具交互与持久的世界动态相结合，并从仿真器事件中计算轨迹奖励，使智能体决策的成本可用于强化学习。该环境还会根据策略的已知弱点调整未来的训练班次，同时保持评估固定不变。在六种模型和13张城市地图上的评估揭示了一个差距：可靠地执行分配的配送任务与在班次中选择和排序工作之间存在明显差距。在固定测试集上，强化学习使Qwen3-VL-4B的净收入提升了54.3%，表明在耦合约束下，从完整班次中学习能够提高性能。在相同采样预算下，自适应训练环境比均匀采样将测试收入提升了16.5%，这表明智能体所练习的情境同样重要。DeliveryGym提供了一个可执行环境，用于研究智能体如何在一次情节内学习协调配送并保留资源以应对后续订单。

Authors: Haoqiang Kang, Yiming Zhang, Yiyang Guo, Chuying Li, Jianzhi Shen, Tianruo Rose Xu, Xiaokang Ye, Lianhui Qin

Conservation Buys Stability and Factoring Buys Counterfactuals in Physical World Models WorldModel

world models symplectic integration counterfactual generalization physical simulation stability

简要说明：该论文为物理世界模型提出一个设计原则：通过辛积分学习能量实现长时程稳定性，通过显式线性分解物理耦合实现反事实泛化，并且这两者结构上可分离、可独立控制。

TLDR: This paper proposes a design principle for physical world models, showing that long-horizon stability is achieved via symplectic integration of a learned energy, while counterfactual generalization under interventions requires explicit linear factorization of physical couplings, with these two structural commitments being separable and independently controllable.

Abstract: A learned simulator can reproduce its training conditions accurately yet fail in two distinct ways once those conditions change. Over long rollouts, small errors accumulate until the trajectory drifts away from physically plausible behavior; under an intervention on a physical parameter, the model may continue to follow the law seen during training rather than the intervened one. We show that these two failures require different structural remedies. Evolving a learned energy with a symplectic integrator preserves the geometry of the conservative dynamics and keeps rollouts bounded and physically meaningful for up to $100\times$ the training horizon, while equal-capacity predictors, an energy-regularized predictor, and a tuned neural ODE diverge. By contrast, encoding the physical coupling through an explicit linear factorization enables the model to follow a never-seen sign of that coupling, whereas an unrestricted parameterization remains locked to the training law. Crucially, the two mechanisms are separable: removing the structure responsible for long-horizon stability leaves counterfactual transfer intact, while removing the factorized coupling destroys counterfactual transfer without eliminating stability. This double dissociation, established with matched controls that remove or replace one structural component at a time, persists beyond the headline three-body system and remains visible when the physical state must be inferred from pixels rather than provided directly. The result is a concrete design principle for physical world models: long-horizon stability and changed-law generalization arise from distinct structural commitments, and each can be imposed deliberately without requiring the other.

摘要（中文）：一个经过学习的模拟器能够准确复现其训练条件下的行为，然而一旦这些条件发生变化，它便会以两种截然不同的方式失效。在长时间推演中，微小误差不断累积，直至轨迹偏离物理上合理的行为；当对某一物理参数施加干预时，模型可能继续遵循训练期间所见的规律，而非被干预后的新规律。我们表明，这两种失效需要不同的结构性修正。通过辛积分器演化学习得到的能量函数，能够保持保守动力学几何结构，并使推演在长达训练时域$100$倍的时间范围内保持有界且物理上有意义，而同等容量的预测器、能量正则化的预测器以及调优后的神经ODE则会出现发散。相比之下，通过显式线性分解来编码物理耦合，能使模型遵循从未见过的耦合符号，而无约束的参数化则仍然固守训练时的规律。关键在于，这两种机制是可分离的：去除负责长时间稳定性的结构，并不会影响反事实迁移；而去除分解耦合则会破坏反事实迁移，却不会消除稳定性。这种双重分离，通过逐一移除或替换某一结构成分的匹配对照实验得以确立，其现象不仅存在于标志性的三体系统中，而且在物理状态必须从像素中推断而非直接给定之时依然清晰可见。由此得出的物理世界模型设计原则十分具体：长时间稳定性与变规律泛化源于不同的结构性承诺，且两者可以被有意地分别施加，而不必依赖对方。

Authors: Yufeng Wang, Parivesh Priye, Lu Wei, Haibin Ling

FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations Perception3D

articulated objects point cloud feed-forward joint parameters sparse observations

简要说明：FAMOS 是一种前馈模型，通过多状态关节 Transformer 和观测关节跨度目标，从稀疏、无序的部分点云中联合推理多个观测，预测可动部件分割和关节参数。它引入程序化数据生成器以克服训练数据有限的问题，并在多个基准上持续优于基线。

TLDR: FAMOS is a feed-forward model that predicts articulation models (movable-part segmentation and joint parameters) from sparse, unordered partial point clouds by jointly reasoning over multiple observations with a Multi-state Articulation Transformer and an observed articulation span objective. It introduces a procedural data generator to overcome limited training data and demonstrates consistent improvements over baselines on multiple benchmarks.

Abstract: Modeling articulated objects from sparse monocular views is challenging because each observation reveals only partial geometry and motion evidence. Most feed-forward methods infer articulation from a single observation and therefore rely heavily on learned category-level shape priors. We present FAMOS, a feed-forward model that predicts movable-part segmentation and joint parameters from a sparse, unordered set of partial point clouds. Our model jointly reasons over multiple observations and naturally supports a variable number of inputs, including a single view. To aggregate articulation cues across observations, we introduce a Multi-state Articulation Transformer with alternating state-wise and global attention. We further propose an observed articulation span objective that supervises the motion range each part exhibits across the input observations, encouraging the model to leverage the full observation set. To overcome the limited scale and diversity of existing datasets, we introduce a procedural data generator that synthesizes self-annotated assets during training. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility, ACD, and ArtiCraft-10K demonstrate consistent improvements over both feed-forward and optimization-based baselines. Project page: https://kevinqu7.github.io/famos

摘要（中文）：从稀疏单目视角建模铰接物体具有挑战性，因为每次观测仅能揭示部分几何与运动信息。大多数前馈方法仅从单次观测推断铰接结构，因此高度依赖学习得到的类别级形状先验。我们提出FAMOS，一种前馈模型，能够从一组稀疏、无序的部分点云中预测可移动部件分割及关节参数。该模型联合推理多次观测，并自然支持可变数量的输入，包括单视角输入。为跨观测聚合铰接线索，我们引入了一种多状态铰接变换器，交替进行状态间注意力与全局注意力。我们还提出了一种观测铰接跨度目标函数，用于监督各部件在输入观测中展现的运动范围，从而鼓励模型充分利用整组观测数据。为克服现有数据集在规模与多样性上的局限，我们引入了一种程序化数据生成器，在训练过程中合成带自动标注的资产。在PartNet-Mobility、ACD及ArtiCraft-10K上的实验表明，本方法相较于前馈基线及基于优化的基线均取得了一致改进。项目页面：https://kevinqu7.github.io/famos

Authors: Kevin Qu, Tao Sun, Massimiliano Viola, Liyuan Zhu, Zhizhuo Zhou, Sayan Deb Sarkar, Konrad Schindler, Iro Armeni

HOPHY: A Hierarchical Hypergraph Representation for Off-Road Path and Mission Planning Other

hypergraph off-road planning hierarchical representation mission planning replanning

简要说明：HOPHY 提出了一种可复用的分层超图地形表示，用于越野路径和任务规划，以更低的延迟实现接近最优的成本精度，并在实体无人地面车辆任务中验证了有效性。

TLDR: HOPHY presents a reusable hierarchical hypergraph terrain representation for off-road path and mission planning, achieving near-oracle cost accuracy with much lower latency and demonstrating success on a physical UGV mission.

Abstract: Mission-level autonomy for disaster response, search and rescue, and tactical UGV operations requires repeated path and mission planning as terrain conditions, agent types, and objectives change. Pixel-grid search is costly for repeated kilometer-scale queries, while semantic abstractions must maintain valid costs and connectivity as conditions change. We present HOPHY (Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs), a reusable hierarchical terrain representation that organizes map-scale terrain into geometrically connected semantic regions (GSNodes), connectivity-preserving critical regions (Coarse Regions), and typed hyperedges for terrain, agent, and weather context. Hyperedge intersections select affected regions and incident edges for state updates without rebuilding the hierarchy. Across real off-road maps spanning kilometer-scale areas, HOPHY achieves 100% planning success and less than 0.01% median cost deviation from the oracle (pixel A*), with substantially lower query and replanning latency than the evaluated pixel and abstraction baselines. Applied to a multi-robot task-allocation (MRTA) problem, these gains reduce total computation by 79x over pixel A* and 7.2x over the fastest abstraction baseline, with mission makespan comparable to pixel A*. Finally, we demonstrate HOPHY on a physical Clearpath Jackal that successfully executes a 1.5-km, eight-task mission across mixed-surface outdoor terrain and a blockage-triggered replanned route.

摘要（中文）：面向灾害响应、搜索救援及战术无人地面车辆（UGV）任务的任务级自主性要求在地形条件、智能体类型和目标发生变化时，能够反复进行路径与任务规划。像素网格搜索在重复进行公里级查询时成本高昂，而语义抽象方法则必须在条件变化时维持有效的代价与连通性。我们提出HOPHY（基于超图的层级越野规划），一种可复用的层级地形表示方法，将地图尺度地形组织为几何连通的语义区域（GSNodes）、保持连通性的关键区域（Coarse Regions），以及针对地形、智能体和天气上下文类型化的超边。超边交点选择受影响区域及关联边以进行状态更新，而无需重建层级结构。在覆盖公里级范围的真实越野地图上，HOPHY实现了100%的规划成功率，且与神级基准（像素A*）相比，代价中位数偏差小于0.01%，同时查询与重规划延迟显著低于所评估的像素及抽象基准方法。应用于多机器人任务分配（MRTA）问题时，这些优势使总计算量相比像素A*降低了79倍，相比最快的抽象基准方法降低了7.2倍，且任务完工时间与像素A*相当。最后，我们在实体Clearpath Jackal平台上演示了HOPHY，成功完成了跨越混合表面户外地形的1.5公里、八任务任务，以及由阻塞触发的重规划路径执行。

Authors: Pranay Meshram, Charuvahan Adhivarahan, Prithvi Poddar, Ehsan Tarkesh Esfahani, Chen Wang, Souma Chowdhury, Karthik Dantu

MAGNETAR: Multipath-Guided Spatial Posteriors for Transmitter Pose Inference in the Upper Mid-Band Other

transmitter pose inference RF multipath joint posterior heading-conditioned U-Net robotic localization

简要说明：MAGNETAR 利用以朝向为条件的 2D U-Net，从单个 RF 多径快照推断无线电发射器位置和朝向的联合后验，提高了在杂乱环境中机器人的定位能力。

TLDR: MAGNETAR infers a joint posterior over a radio transmitter's position and heading from a single RF multipath snapshot using a heading-conditioned 2D U-Net, improving localization for robots in cluttered environments.

Abstract: Robots that localize a radio transmitter need more than a point estimate: in cluttered rooms, one measurement is often consistent with several transmitter locations and, because upper-mid-band antennas are directional, several headings. We present MAGNETAR, which infers a joint posterior over planar transmitter position and heading from a single asynchronous radio-frequency (RF) multipath snapshot, represented by angle-of-arrival and signal-to-noise-ratio estimates, given the room layout and receiver pose. Among our five neural scorers, MAGNETAR adopts a shared 2D U-Net conditioned on each candidate heading, jointly normalizing scores over a discretized position-heading grid. Training uses real-to-sim-calibrated 10 GHz simulations and a small measured subset. Grid-based joint posteriors outperform parametric ones on held-out simulations, the heading-conditioned scorer transfers best to robotic measurements, and fusing joint posteriors improves on fusing position-only marginals.

摘要（中文）：机器人对无线电发射机进行定位时，需要的不仅仅是点估计：在杂乱房间中，一次测量往往与多个发射机位置一致，并且由于中高频段天线的方向性，也可能对应多个朝向。我们提出了MAGNETAR方法，该方法从单个异步射频（RF）多径快照中推断平面发射机位置与朝向的联合后验分布，该快照由到达角和信噪比估计表示，并给定房间布局和接收机姿态。在我们设计的五种神经评分器中，MAGNETAR采用共享的2D U-Net，以每个候选朝向为条件，在离散的位置-朝向网格上联合归一化评分。训练使用经过真实到仿真校准的10 GHz仿真数据以及少量实测子集。在保留的仿真数据上，基于网格的联合后验优于参数化后验；以朝向为条件的评分器在机器人实测数据上迁移效果最佳；融合联合后验优于仅融合位置边缘分布。

Authors: Haozhe Lei, Ruibin Chen, Yuhan Jiang, Ali Rasteh, Aditya Dhananjay, Sundeep Rangan

A Simulation Platform for AUV Fault Recovery: Exploring LLM-Based Diagnostic Strategies Other

AUV LLM diagnostic fault recovery simulation platform ensemble evaluation

简要说明：本文提出了SPAR，一个用于评估自主水下机器人基于LLM故障诊断与恢复的闭环仿真平台，通过480次试验的集成测试比较前沿模型与本地模型。

TLDR: This paper presents SPAR, a closed-loop simulation platform for evaluating LLM-based fault diagnosis and recovery in autonomous underwater vehicles, using ensemble testing across 480 trials to compare frontier and local models.

Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating beyond reliable communications must recover from failures without human intervention. We investigate an architecture in which conventional deterministic layered control autonomy manages normal operations, while an invokable large language model (LLM) serves as a diagnostic and recovery planner when onboard anomaly detection identifies performance outside expected limits. Because language models are stochastic, rigorous evaluation requires ensemble testing rather than individual demonstrations. We present a closed-loop simulation architecture that couples real-time C vehicle software with a higher-level orchestration layer for physics-based fault injection, structured prompting, language-model interaction, mission file generation, validation, execution, and LLM-judge scoring. The framework, which we call SPAR (Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery), supports evaluation across fault realizations, prompt structures, reasoning models, and mission conditions. We vary these for a mass-shift fault over 480 SPAR trials, evaluating a frontier model and three off-the-shelf locally deployable LLMs. Model choice dominates diagnosis: the frontier model places the CG-shift mechanism in its top three hypotheses in 85-90% of trials, versus 60-78% for the best local model. Reasoning analysis indicates that local-model success is associated with following the complete diagnostic procedure, whereas weaker models often commit prematurely to elevator failure even though the actuator tracks its command. Diagnosis and operational decision performance do not appear to be coupled in this dataset. The contributions are an architecture extending unanticipated-fault recovery from detection to mitigation and an ensemble methodology for evaluating LLM-assisted mission management on low-power AUVs.

摘要（中文）：自主水下航行器（AUV）在超出可靠通信范围运行时，必须能够在无人工干预的情况下从故障中恢复。我们研究了一种架构，其中传统的确定性分层控制自主性负责正常操作管理，而当机载异常检测识别到性能超出预期范围时，可调用的大语言模型（LLM）作为诊断和恢复规划器。由于语言模型具有随机性，严格的评估需要集成测试而非单个演示。我们提出了一种闭环仿真架构，将实时C语言车辆软件与高层编排层相结合，用于基于物理的故障注入、结构化提示、语言模型交互、任务文件生成、验证、执行以及LLM评判器评分。该框架我们称之为SPAR（AUV恢复仿真平台），支持跨故障实现、提示结构、推理模型和任务条件的评估。我们针对质量偏移故障在480次SPAR试验中变化这些因素，评估了一个前沿模型和三个现成的本地可部署LLM。模型选择主导诊断结果：前沿模型在85-90%的试验中将重心偏移机制列为其前三假设之中，而最佳本地模型的这一比例为60-78%。推理分析表明，本地模型成功与遵循完整诊断程序相关，而较弱模型即使在执行器跟踪指令的情况下，也常常过早地归因于升降舵故障。在该数据集中，诊断与操作决策性能之间未表现出耦合关系。本研究的贡献在于提出了一种将意外故障恢复从检测扩展到缓解的架构，以及一种用于在低功耗AUV上评估LLM辅助任务管理的集成方法论。

Authors: Khalid Halba, Kylie Cooper, James G. Bellingham

Semantic SLAM in Precision Agriculture using Bayesian Inference Other

semantic SLAM precision agriculture Bayesian inference graph-based SLAM autonomous robots

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于精准农业的实时语义世界建模框架，将基于贝叶斯推理的语义映射与基于g2o的图SLAM相结合，并在Boston Dynamics Spot机器人上使用YOLOv8n进行验证，可映射多达400株植物。

TLDR: This paper presents a real-time semantic world modeling framework for precision agriculture, combining Bayesian-inference-based semantic mapping with graph-based SLAM using g2o, validated on a Boston Dynamics Spot robot with YOLOv8n for plant detection and mapping up to 400 plants.

Abstract: This paper presents a real-time semantic world modeling framework specialized for precision agriculture using autonomous robots. The framework combines probabilistic mapping of objects and their semantic attributes, updated through Bayesian inference, with a graph-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) approach implemented using $g^2o$, a general framework for graph optimization. This integration enables accurate mapping and localization without relying solely on GPS. By leveraging semantic information such as plant type, size, and health, the robot can perform tasks while mapping and localizing itself within a field of crops. The proposed framework was validated through Gazebo simulations and physical experiments on an indoor field with artificial plants using Boston Dynamics' robot dog Spot. A YOLOv8n object detection model was trained to extract object and semantic data from depth camera observations. These simulations and experiments demonstrate that the system can successfully perform real-time mapping of up to at least 400 plants.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种专为自主机器人精准农业设计的实时语义世界建模框架。该框架将对象及其语义属性的概率映射（通过贝叶斯推断更新）与基于图的同时定位与建图（SLAM）方法相结合，后者利用通用图优化框架$g^2o$实现。这种集成使得在不完全依赖GPS的情况下，仍能实现准确的建图与定位。通过利用植物类型、大小和健康状况等语义信息，机器人可以在田间执行任务的同时进行建图与自身定位。所提出的框架通过Gazebo仿真以及使用波士顿动力公司机器狗Spot在室内人工植物田地上进行的物理实验得到验证。训练了一个YOLOv8n目标检测模型，用于从深度相机观测中提取对象及语义数据。这些仿真与实验表明，该系统能够成功执行实时建图，至少可覆盖400株植物。

Authors: Ruben Beumer, Sander Doodeman, René van de Molengraft, Duarte Antunes

Towards AI-enhanced control: a numerical technique for trajectory smoothing of a parallel robot for pancreatic surgery Manipulation

trajectory smoothing parallel robot surgical robotics velocity control S-curve

简要说明：本文提出一种数值轨迹平滑方法，利用速度场中的S曲线对胰腺微创手术并联机器人进行轨迹平滑，实现了基于3D空间鼠标的主从实时控制下的稳定运动。

TLDR: This paper introduces a numerical trajectory smoothing method using S-curves in velocity fields for a parallel robot in minimally invasive pancreatic surgery, enabling stable real-time control under a master-slave architecture with a 3D space mouse.

Abstract: The paper presents a numerical approach for the end-effector trajectory smoothing of a parallel robot designed for minimally invasive pancreatic surgery. The approach is tailored for real-time master-slave control architecture and uses a 3D space mouse for command input for velocity control. The trajectory smoothing is achieved by generating S-curves in the end-effector velocity fields, thus controlling the accelerations, which in turn reduces tissue trauma in the minimally invasive procedures. Real-time control is enabled by segmenting the S-curves based on the command inputs from the 3D space mouse. A special case is considered where the acceleration time is constant for all command inputs. Numeric results demonstrate stable transitions (without abrupt changes) in both the end-effector parameter space and in the active joints parameters, thereby validating the proposed approach. Further work aims to test the approach on an experimental model and integrate it into AI-based training modules.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种针对微创胰腺手术并联机器人末端执行器轨迹平滑的数值方法。该方法专为实时主从控制架构设计，并利用3D空间鼠标进行速度控制的指令输入。轨迹平滑通过在末端执行器速度场中生成S曲线来实现，从而控制加速度，进而减少微创手术中的组织创伤。通过基于3D空间鼠标指令输入对S曲线进行分段处理，实现了实时控制。本文考虑了一种特殊情况，即所有指令输入的加速时间保持恒定。数值结果表明，在末端执行器参数空间及主动关节参数中均实现了稳定过渡（无突变），从而验证了所提方法的有效性。后续工作旨在将该方法在实验模型上进行测试，并将其集成到基于人工智能的训练模块中。

Authors: Iosif Birlescu, Alexandru Pusca, Bogdan Gherman, Calin Vaida, Ionut Zima, Damien Chablat, Doina Pisla

SenseFuse: Label-Free Fusion of Image and Shape Encoders for Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation Perception3D

open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation label-free fusion 2D-3D complementarity adaptive fusion weight scene understanding

简要说明：SenseFuse 提出了一种无标签融合方法，自适应地结合 2D 图像和 3D 形状编码器以改进开放词汇 3D 实例分割，在多个基准上展示了鲁棒性能且开销极低。

TLDR: SenseFuse introduces a label-free fusion method that adaptively combines 2D image and 3D shape encoders to improve open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation, demonstrating robust performance across several benchmarks with minimal overhead.

Abstract: Open-vocabulary scene understanding is fundamental for robotics, laying the groundwork for spatial reasoning and object manipulation. While closed-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation heavily leverages 3D shape information, state-of-the-art open-vocabulary methods remain predominantly restricted to 2D image features or image-distilled representations during mask labeling. In this paper, we propose SenseFuse, a label-free fusion method that balances 2D image and 3D shape encoders for robust open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation, refining only the mask-labeling stage of existing pipelines. We reveal that 2D image and 3D shape encoders exhibit largely disjoint failure patterns and rarely share identical wrong labels, whereas two 2D image encoders frequently repeat the same errors. This distinct behavior makes the 2D and 3D pair inherently complementary. We introduce an adaptive mechanism that selects a scene-level fusion weight to maximize a label-free sensitivity measure, estimated directly from a single scene's unlabeled proposals in milliseconds. SenseFuse improves labeling accuracy in every evaluated setting across ScanNet200, Replica, and ScanNet++, recovering 67-100% (median 93%) of the gain achievable with an oracle weight, and it raises instance AP in 21 of 22 reported settings. Code is available at https://github.com/hanes1207/SenseFuse.

摘要（中文）：开放词汇场景理解是机器人技术的基础，为空间推理和物体操作奠定基础。虽然封闭词汇的三维实例分割在很大程度上利用三维形状信息，但最先进的开放词汇方法在掩码标注阶段仍主要局限于二维图像特征或图像蒸馏表示。本文提出了SenseFuse，一种无标签融合方法，平衡二维图像与三维形状编码器以实现鲁棒的开放词汇三维实例分割，仅优化现有流程中的掩码标注阶段。我们发现，二维图像编码器和三维形状编码器展现出高度不重叠的失败模式，很少共享相同的错误标签，而两个二维图像编码器则经常重复相同的错误。这种独特的行为使得二维与三维配对天然具有互补性。我们引入一种自适应机制，选择场景级融合权重以最大化一种无标签灵敏度度量，该度量可直接在毫秒级时间内从单个场景的无标签提议中估计得出。SenseFuse在ScanNet200、Replica和ScanNet++的每一项评估设置中均提升了标注准确性，恢复了使用最优权重可获得增益的67%-100%（中位数93%），并在22个报告设置中的21个提高了实例AP。代码可在https://github.com/hanes1207/SenseFuse获取。

Authors: Euiseok Han, Tri Ton, Hwanhee Kim, Seungyeon Ryu, Chang D. Yoo

Graph-Based Design of Soft Grippers with Multi-Objective Quality-Diversity Optimisation Manipulation

soft gripper design quality-diversity optimization graph-based design generalization genetic algorithm

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于图的软体夹爪设计空间，并结合多目标、多样性驱动的遗传优化框架，以产生能够泛化到不同物体和未见场景的抓取设计。

TLDR: This paper introduces a graph-based design space for soft grippers and a multi-objective, diversity-driven genetic optimization framework to generate grasping designs that generalize across diverse objects and unseen scenarios.

Abstract: Effective manipulation across diverse objects is critical for applications ranging from agricultural harvesting to laboratory and domestic automation. While the inherent compliance of soft robotics is well suited to this challenge, designing grippers that generalize across tasks remains difficult due to the vast design space of continuum mechanics and the risk of overfitting to specific scenarios. We propose a graph-based design space for representing soft structures and mechanisms, coupled with a multi-objective, diversity-driven genetic optimization framework that explicitly promotes solution variety throughout the design process. Using multiple grasping scenarios during optimization, we study how task diversity influences the emergence of generalization to unseen objects and contact conditions. Our results show that optimization over a sufficiently diverse set of grasping cases leads to designs with emergent generalization, exhibiting improved robustness compared to task-specific solutions on novel scenarios. These findings suggest that diversity-driven optimization offers a principled pathway toward general-purpose soft grippers, aligned with the adaptable nature of soft robotics.

摘要（中文）：有效操控各类物体对于从农业收割到实验室及家庭自动化等应用至关重要。尽管软体机器人固有的柔顺性非常适合应对这一挑战，但由于连续介质力学的广阔设计空间以及过度拟合特定场景的风险，设计能够泛化于多种任务的夹持器仍然困难重重。 我们提出了一种基于图的设计空间，用于表示软体结构与机构，并耦合了一个多目标、多样性驱动的遗传优化框架，该框架在设计过程中明确促进解决方案的多样性。通过在优化过程中使用多种抓取场景，我们研究了任务多样性如何影响对未见物体及接触条件泛化能力的涌现。 结果表明，在充分多样化的抓取案例集合上进行优化，能够催生具备涌现泛化能力的设计，并在面对新场景时相比特定任务的解决方案展现出更高的鲁棒性。这些发现表明，多样性驱动的优化为通用软体夹持器提供了一条有原则的路径，与软体机器人顺应自然的适应性本质高度契合。

Authors: Andre Farinha, Ge Shi, Harry Bowman, Brendan Tidd, David Howard, Josh Pinskier

Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation WorldModel

world model video generation action-conditioned camera control block-causal attention

简要说明：本文介绍了 Astronex-World 1.0，一个开放的可控视频世界模型基础，可根据文本、图像、相机轨迹、连续动作和具身标识符预测未来视觉状态，并提供双向和因果两种变体以支持实时生成。该模型旨在通过后训练用于具身智能和自动驾驶，但本文未涉及具体应用。

TLDR: This paper introduces Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation that generates future visual states conditioned on text, images, camera trajectories, actions, and embodiment identifiers, with bidirectional and causal variants for real-time generation. The model is designed to be post-trained for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving applications, though it is not applied to these domains in this work.

Abstract: We present Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation. Given a text prompt (text-to-video) or an initial observation (image-to-video), the model predicts future visual states under frame-aligned camera trajectories, continuous actions, and an embodiment identifier, and accepts text events inserted at a specified position of a rollout. The family provides a bidirectional model for full-context generation and a causal model with block-causal attention and cross-block KV caching for persistent generation, both built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior. PRoPE injects camera intrinsics and extrinsics, while a 64-dimensional action stream modulates every Transformer layer. A five-stage training path develops bidirectional camera and action control, converts the backbone to block-causal generation, distills a few-step student, restores mixed-domain dynamics, and applies asymmetric DMD/DMD2 distribution matching. The causal model generates 832x480 video at 24 fps. All five training stages run on two NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPUs, and the causal model streams in real time on one. It scores 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. On Full, this 5B model is above the 13.6B LongCat-Video and the 14B Helios, within one point of the 22B LTX-2.3, and above YUME 1.5, which is post-trained from the same 5B prior on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The reserved action input and output interfaces allow post-training for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了Astronex-World 1.0，一个开放的可控视频世界模型基础架构。给定文本提示（文本到视频）或初始观测（图像到视频），该模型在帧对齐的相机轨迹、连续动作和具身标识符条件下预测未来视觉状态，并接受在滚动生成指定位置插入的文本事件。该系列模型包含一个用于全上下文生成的双向模型和一个具有块因果注意力和跨块KV缓存的因果模型，用于持久生成，两者均基于Wan2.2-TI2V-5B先验构建。PRoPE注入相机内参和外参，同时一个64维动作流调制每个Transformer层。五阶段训练路径依次发展双向相机与动作控制、将骨干网络转换为块因果生成、蒸馏几步学生模型、恢复混合域动态，并应用非对称DMD/DMD2分布匹配。因果模型以24帧/秒生成832x480视频。全部五个训练阶段在两块NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPU上运行，因果模型在单块GPU上实时流式生成。该模型在WBench Navi上得分73.5，在WBench Full上得分70.0。在Full基准上，这个5B模型超过了13.6B的LongCat-Video和14B的Helios，与22B的LTX-2.3差距在一分以内，并超过了从相同5B先验在NVIDIA A100 GPU上进行后训练的YUME 1.5。预留的动作输入和输出接口允许针对具身智能和自动驾驶进行后训练。

Authors: Xin Zhou, Cong Miao

PerSeM: Persistent Semantic Memory for Long-Horizon Open-Vocabulary UAV Mapping Perception3D

open-vocabulary segmentation semantic memory UAV mapping 3D voxel aggregation temporal stability

简要说明：PerSeM提出了一种无需训练、持久的语义记忆框架，将无人机逐帧开放词汇分割结果聚合为3D体素地图，并通过保守的细化策略提高了语义准确性和时间稳定性。

TLDR: PerSeM introduces a training-free persistent semantic memory that aggregates frame-wise open-vocabulary segmentations from UAVs into a 3D voxel map with conservative refinement, improving semantic accuracy and temporal stability over frame-wise predictions.

Abstract: Open-vocabulary segmentation enables rich semantic perception for UAVs, but frame-wise predictions can remain temporally inconsistent across repeated observations and changing viewpoints. We present PerSeM, a training-free persistent semantic memory framework for long-horizon open-vocabulary UAV mapping. PerSeM associates frame-wise semantic observations with persistent world-space voxels and constructs a majority-based semantic memory, which is conservatively refined through history-preserving spatial refinement, trust-aware replay, and context-guided verification. Experiments on the Forest and UAVScenes benchmarks show that persistent 3D memory provides substantial gains in semantic correctness and temporal stability over frame-wise predictions. Beyond this strong persistent-memory baseline, PerSeM provides consistent additional improvements, improving both semantic accuracy and temporal stability across all five evaluated UAVScenes sequences. Analysis using regions identified independently of the final PerSeM predictions further shows that these gains are concentrated in semantically difficult and temporally unstable regions, where majority-based memory is most likely to remain uncertain. These results demonstrate that persistent 3D aggregation provides a strong foundation for long-horizon semantic mapping, while conservative refinement of uncertain memory states can provide additional improvements without retraining or additional neural-network inference.

摘要（中文）：开放词汇分割使无人机能够进行丰富的语义感知，但逐帧预测在重复观测和视角变化时可能产生时间上的不一致性。我们提出了PerSeM，一种无需训练、面向长时程开放词汇无人机测绘的持久语义记忆框架。PerSeM将逐帧语义观测与持久的世界空间体素关联起来，构建基于多数投票的语义记忆，并通过保持历史信息的三维空间精化、基于信任度的重放以及上下文引导的验证，对该记忆进行保守式改进。在Forest和UAVScenes基准上的实验表明，相较于逐帧预测，持久三维记忆在语义正确性和时间稳定性方面带来了显著提升。在这一强持久记忆基线的基础上，PerSeM提供了持续一致的额外改进，在所有五个评估的UAVScenes序列中同时提升了语义准确性和时间稳定性。进一步分析使用独立于最终PerSeM预测识别的区域表明，这些增益集中在语义困难和时间不稳定的区域，而基于多数投票的记忆在该类区域中最可能保持不确定状态。这些结果表明，持久三维聚合为长时程语义测绘提供了坚实基础，而对不确定记忆状态的保守精化则可在无需重新训练或额外神经网络推理的情况下带来进一步改进。

Authors: Saurbh Singh Jamwal, Ganesh Ramakrishnan

PIVOT: Perception-aware Independent Viewpoint Online Optimization Locomotion

viewpoint optimization perception-aware SO(3) exponential-map feature visibility visual localization

简要说明：PIVOT是一种轻量级在线优化方法，用于云台相机和MEMS激光雷达，在固定轨迹中优化观测方向以最大化特征可见性，从而提升四足机器人的视觉定位鲁棒性。

TLDR: PIVOT is a lightweight online optimization method for gimbal-mounted cameras and MEMS-based LiDARs that selects viewing directions to maximize feature visibility during a fixed trajectory, improving visual localization robustness on a quadruped robot.

Abstract: A fundamental assumption in robotic perception is that the sensor's field of view (FoV) is fixed relative to the robot body. Motion-decoupled sensors, such as gimbal-mounted cameras and MEMS-based LiDARs, instead allow sensing direction to be controlled independently at runtime. This freedom creates a computational challenge: efficiently selecting useful viewing directions online in feature-dense environments. We propose PIVOT, a lightweight iterative method that optimizes sensor viewing direction along a fixed translation trajectory to maximize feature visibility. Under a conical FoV model, visibility depends only on the optical axis, yielding a two-degree-of-freedom optimization on the viewing sphere $S^2$. Coordinate-free $SO(3)$ exponential-map updates enable efficient continuous optimization without explicit angular parameterizations or exhaustive viewing-sphere search. Monte Carlo evaluations retain 98.1--99.6% of brute-force visibility with a 76--85x speedup. Photorealistic simulation and real-world experiments further demonstrate improved visual localization robustness and practical viewpoint control on a quadruped robot.

摘要（中文）：机器人感知的一个基本假设是，传感器的视场（FoV）相对于机器人本体是固定的。然而，运动解耦传感器，如云台相机和基于MEMS的激光雷达，允许在运行时独立控制传感方向。这种自由度带来了计算上的挑战：在特征密集的环境中，如何高效地在线选择有用的观测方向。我们提出了PIVOT，一种轻量级迭代方法，用于在固定平移轨迹上优化传感器观测方向，以最大化特征可见性。在锥形视场模型下，可见性仅依赖于光轴，从而在观测球面 $S^2$ 上产生一个二自由度优化问题。采用无坐标的 $SO(3)$ 指数映射更新，可实现高效的连续优化，而无需显式的角度参数化或穷举观测球搜索。蒙特卡洛评估保留了暴力搜索法98.1%至99.6%的可见性，同时实现了76至85倍的加速。逼真模拟和真实世界实验进一步证明了改进的视觉定位鲁棒性以及四足机器人上的实用视角控制。

Authors: Yuyang Chen, Shekoufeh Sadeghi, Charuvahan Adhivarahan, Elton Lemos, Chen Wang, Sanjeev J. Koppal, Karthik Dantu

Self-excited actuation enables adaptive and resilient flapping-wing flight Other

asynchronous actuation flapping-wing robot embodied control resilient flight insect-inspired robotics

简要说明：本文介绍了首个采用异步驱动的可飞行扑翼机器人，展示了这种仿生策略能够在杂乱环境中无需外部传感或控制干预即可实现自适应、鲁棒的飞行。

TLDR: This paper presents the first flight-capable flapping-wing robot using asynchronous actuation, demonstrating that this bio-inspired strategy enables adaptive, resilient flight in cluttered environments without requiring external sensing or control intervention.

Abstract: The muscles that power insect flight fall into one of two categories: 1) synchronous muscles that contract under direct control from the nervous system, and 2) asynchronous muscles which have an intrinsic stretch activation response that spontaneously generates wingbeats without the need for signaling from the brain. It is thought that the emergent nature of asynchronous wingbeats provides both adaptive and responsive capabilities for flight control. To date, most flying robots use synchronous actuation. In this paper we develop the first flight-capable flapping wing robot that uses asynchronous actuation. We demonstrate that asynchronous actuation allows wings to respond to changes in the resonant mechanics of the body without control input, and wings can react instantaneously to collisions with obstacles with no extrinsic sensing needed. Flight tests within cluttered environments demonstrate that asynchronous actuation significantly improves stability and performance when compared to synchronous actuation. In total this work demonstrates that a flapping wing robot actuation strategy that emulates the asynchronous muscles of flying insects can provide fast, reactive actuation responses before a control system would need to intervene. This partitioning of embodied control to both the low-level actuation dynamics and and high-level sensorimotor system provides a compelling blueprint for new flying robots.

摘要（中文）：驱动昆虫飞行的肌肉分为两类：一类是同步肌肉，在神经系统的直接控制下收缩；另一类是异步肌肉，具有内在的拉伸激活响应，无需大脑发出信号即可自发产生翅膀拍动。据认为，异步翅膀拍动的涌现特性为飞行控制提供了适应性与响应性能力。迄今为止，大多数飞行机器人采用同步驱动方式。本文研制了首款采用异步驱动的、具备飞行能力的扑翼机器人。我们证明了异步驱动使翅膀无需控制输入即可响应身体共振力学的变化，且在无需任何外部传感的情况下，翅膀能瞬时对与障碍物的碰撞作出反应。在杂乱环境中的飞行测试表明，与同步驱动相比，异步驱动显著提高了稳定性和性能。总体而言，本研究证明，模拟飞行昆虫异步肌肉的扑翼机器人驱动策略，能够在控制系统介入之前提供快速、反应性的驱动响应。这种将具身控制划分为低层驱动动力学与高层感觉运动系统的方式，为新型飞行机器人提供了极具吸引力的设计蓝图。

Authors: Rundong Yang, Ethan S. Wold, Ellen Liu, James Lynch, Wei Zhou, Mark Jankauski, Simon Sponberg, Nick Gravish

Task-Oriented Active Learning of Residual Dynamics for Model Predictive Path Integral Control Other

active learning residual dynamics MPPI Gaussian process off-road navigation

简要说明：本文提出了任务导向信息获取（ToIA），一种用于模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制与在线高斯过程残差学习的主动学习准则，通过按任务相关性加权信息增益来提高越野导航中的目标到达率。在模拟导航中，ToIA 优于被动和任务无关的主动学习方法，尤其是在稀疏更新下。

TLDR: This paper introduces Task-Oriented Information Acquisition (ToIA), an active-learning criterion for Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control with online Gaussian process residual learning, which improves goal-reaching in off-road navigation by weighting information gain by task relevance. ToIA outperforms passive and task-agnostic active learning in simulated navigation, especially with sparse updates.

Abstract: Online residual learning can reduce model mismatch in predictive control, but passive data collection may fail to adequately cover states that become important later in the task. Task-agnostic active learning targets uncertain or informative regions, but information acquired in such regions does not necessarily improve task performance. This paper introduces Task-Oriented Information Acquisition (ToIA), an active-learning criterion for model predictive path integral control (MPPI) with online Gaussian process (GP) residual learning. For each sampled control sequence, ToIA estimates how much an observation obtained early in the rollout would reduce predictive uncertainty at later states on the same rollout, and weights this reduction by the rollout's relevance to the task. The score is evaluated over the existing MPPI rollout batch without sampling future observations or re-optimizing control under hypothetical posterior updates. In simulated off-road navigation across held-out maps with heterogeneous terrain, ToIA improved the goal-reaching success rate over passive GP learning by 19.3 and 27.4 percentage points and outperformed task-agnostic active-learning baselines across dense and sparse online-learning intervals. An ablation study indicates that task relevance is particularly important under sparse model updates. The implementation supports online control at 20 Hz on an NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti.

摘要（中文）：在线残差学习可以降低预测控制中的模型失配，但被动数据采集可能无法充分覆盖任务后期变得重要的状态。任务无关的主动学习瞄准不确定或信息量大的区域，但这些区域中获取的信息并不一定能改善任务表现。本文提出任务导向信息采集（ToIA），一种面向模型预测路径积分控制（MPPI）与在线高斯过程（GP）残差学习相结合的主动学习准则。对于每条采样的控制序列，ToIA估计在同一条轨迹上早期获得的观测能在多大程度上降低后续状态的预测不确定性，并按该轨迹与任务的相关性对这一降低量进行加权。该评分在现有MPPI rollout批次上进行评估，无需对未来观测进行采样，也无需在假设的后验更新下重新优化控制。在跨异质地形保留地图的仿真越野导航中，与被动GP学习相比，ToIA将目标到达成功率提升了19.3和27.4个百分点，并在密集与稀疏在线学习间隔下均优于任务无关的主动学习基线。消融研究表明，在稀疏模型更新条件下，任务相关性尤为重要。该实现支持在NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti上以20 Hz频率进行在线控制。

Authors: Nobuaki Aoki, Hojin Lee, Stefan Sosnowski, Sandra Hirche

Kinematics-Grounded Agentic AI for Robotic Additive Manufacturing Process Planning Other

agentic AI robotic additive manufacturing process planning kinematics LLM

简要说明：本文提出A-RAM，一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，集成了切片、放置和运动学可行性评估，用于机器人增材制造工艺规划，显著降低了关节冲击和运动时间。

TLDR: This paper introduces A-RAM, an agentic LLM-based framework that integrates slicing, placement, and kinematic feasibility evaluation for robotic additive manufacturing process planning, achieving significant reductions in joint jerk and motion time.

Abstract: Robotic additive manufacturing (AM) extends material-extrusion printing beyond gantry kinematics but makes process planning robot-dependent. A slicer-generated plan that appears favorable in part coordinates can become infeasible or robotically unfavorable on a manipulator because slicer-process decisions and part orientation determine the generated path, while part orientation and workspace placement affect its kinematic realization. Existing AM tools, large language model (LLM)-based decision-support methods, and digital-shadow systems do not provide integrated pre-execution evaluation of these coupled decisions. This paper presents agentic robotic additive manufacturing (A-RAM), an agent-specialist-tool framework that converts user intent and a part file into traceable, execution-ready plans. The LLM interprets manufacturing objectives and constraints, identifies prescribed and searchable planning variables, and encodes this reasoning in a schema-constrained request; a deterministic Planning Agent instantiates the corresponding search workflow, while domain tools compute quantitative evidence for slicing, placement, inverse kinematics, trajectory timing, Joint-6 jerk, and extrusion. The framework is evaluated on a six-axis robotic-arm AM cell through three case studies covering expert-specified planning, goal-only planning, objective-dependent infill screening, and geometry-dependent orientation-placement selection. Across the evaluated candidate sets, selected plans achieve up to 53.5% lower maximum Joint-6 jerk and 48.3% lower mean absolute Joint-6 jerk than the least favorable valid candidates, while objective-specific infill screening yields motion-plan completion times up to 40.1% shorter and extrusion paths up to 12.7% shorter than the corresponding least favorable screened patterns.

摘要（中文）：机器人增材制造（AM）将材料挤出打印扩展至龙门运动学之外，但也使工艺规划依赖于机器人本体。切片器生成的规划在零件坐标系中看似有利，但在操作臂上可能变得不可行或对机器人不利，因为切片器工艺决策和零件方向决定了生成路径，而零件方向和工位布局则影响其运动学实现。现有AM工具、基于大语言模型（LLM）的决策支持方法以及数字孪生系统均未对这些耦合决策提供集成化的执行前评估。本文提出了代理式机器人增材制造（A-RAM），一种代理-专家-工具框架，将用户意图和零件文件转化为可追踪、可执行的规划。LLM解释制造目标和约束，识别预设及可搜索的规划变量，并将该推理编码至模式约束请求中；确定性规划代理实例化相应的搜索工作流，而领域工具计算切片、布局、逆运动学、轨迹时序、第六关节加加速度和挤出的量化证据。该框架在六轴机械臂AM单元上通过三个案例研究进行评估，涵盖专家指定规划、仅目标规划、目标相关的填充筛选以及几何相关的方向-布局选择。在评估的候选集中，所选规划相比最不利的有效候选方案，第六关节最大加加速度降低最高达53.5%，平均绝对加加速度降低最高达48.3%；而针对特定目标的填充筛选产生的运动规划完成时间最多缩短40.1%，挤出路径最多缩短12.7%，均优于相应的最不利筛选模式。

Authors: Jingzhan Ge, Ruimin Chen, Azadeh Haghighi, Jiong Tang, Farhad Imani

SIMLIFE: Pattern Understanding for Long-Horizon Human-Agent Partnership Other

long-horizon pattern understanding benchmark household simulation embodied agents

简要说明：SimLife 是一个用于长期人机协作模式理解的平台和基准，通过丰富的视觉和对话观察评估模型推断潜在行为规则的能力。研究发现现有模型在全面规则理解和行为变化适应方面存在不足，成为具身智能体的主要瓶颈。

TLDR: SimLife is a scalable platform and benchmark for long-horizon human-agent pattern understanding in household settings, evaluating frontier models' abilities to infer latent behavioral rules from long visual and dialogue observations. Results show current models struggle with comprehensive rule understanding and adaptation to behavioral changes, highlighting a bottleneck for embodied agents.

Abstract: Understanding humans over long horizons requires agents to infer not only what people need in the moment, but also how routines form, why they repeat, and when they change. We introduce SimLife, a scalable platform for simulating long-term household life with rich visual observations, ground-truth action logs, and synthetic dialogues with audio. Built on SimLife, SimLife-BP evaluates long-context pattern understanding: the ability to infer latent behavioral rules from weeks or months of everyday observations. The benchmark contains 106 episodes averaging 15.49 hours and 38.57 in-game days, and 1,439 question-answer pairs. Each task probes direct, counterfactual, noisy, and inverse reasoning under different levels of rule hints. Evaluating frontier models and architectures, we find that current models often achieve surface-level prediction without comprehensive rule understanding, rely on frequency-based heuristics rather than if-then reasoning over evidence, and struggle to adapt when behavioral patterns change. These findings suggest that long-context pattern understanding remains a major bottleneck for future embodied agents, while SimLife opens a broader space for studying memory, personalization, adaptation, and long-horizon planning in everyday human-AI interaction.

摘要（中文）：长期理解人类行为要求智能体不仅能够推断人们当下的需求，还要洞察日常习惯如何形成、为何重复，以及在何时发生改变。为此，我们提出了SimLife——一个可扩展的平台，用于模拟长期家庭生活，提供丰富的视觉观察、真实动作日志以及带有音频的合成对话。基于SimLife，我们构建了SimLife-BP基准，用于评估长上下文模式理解能力，即从数周或数月日常观察中推断潜在行为规则的能力。该基准包含106个片段，平均每个片段涵盖15.49小时及38.57个游戏内日，并配有1,439对问答。每个任务在不同规则提示层级下考察直接推理、反事实推理、噪声推理和逆向推理。对前沿模型与架构的评估结果显示，当前模型往往仅能达到表层预测，缺乏对规则的全面理解，依赖基于频率的启发式策略而非基于证据的条件推理，并且在行为模式发生变化时难以适应。这些发现表明，长上下文模式理解仍是未来具身智能体面临的主要瓶颈，而SimLife为研究日常人机交互中的记忆、个性化、适应及长时程规划开辟了更广阔的空间。
